news.impact: Charbonnet continues to make his way back from offseason knee surgery. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

news.head: Zach Charbonnet (knee) gets in some 'light work' on field
news.body: Zach Charbonnet was seen getting in some "light work" on the field during practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Per Smith, it hasn't been four months since Charbonnet's surgery, and this type of work typically happens in the 4.5-5 month range, so he appears to be ahead of schedule. His status will need to continue to be monitored heading into training camp.

news.head: Jameson Williams sees nine targets in Week 1 win
news.body: Jameson Williams caught four of his nine targets for 45 yards in the Lions' 31-30 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 1.
news.impact: Williams would have offered even more of an explosive impact if not for a couple of deep throw drops on passes from quarterback Jared Goff. The wideout remains a high-impact, explosive pass-catching option for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 2 road contest against the Buffalo Bills.

news.head: Jameson Williams (shoulder) returns to practice
news.body: Jameson Williams resumed practicing on Wednesday.
news.impact: Williams missed the Lions’ last two practices. He made his way back on Wednesday.

news.head: Jameson Williams catches six passes in Week 18
news.body: Jameson Williams hauled in six passes for 74 yards during Detroit's 19-16 win over Chicago in the final game of the year.
news.impact: It was the sixth time this season that Williams caught at least six balls in a game. The third-year wideout continues to improve production as he established career-highs in receptions (65) and receiving yards (1,117) while tying a career-best with seven receiving touchdowns.

news.head: Jameson Williams sees three targets in Week 17 loss
news.body: Jameson Williams hauled in two of his three targets for 37 yards in the Lions' 23-10 Week 17 loss to the Vikings.
news.impact: Williams was one of many underperforming options in the Detroit offense, finishing with less than five receptions and nine targets for the first time in his last five games. The speedy wideout remains one of quarterback Jared Goff's primary pass-catching options, with a Week 18 contest against the Chicago Bears up next.

news.head: DeVonta Smith catches three passes in Week 1 win
news.body: DeVonta Smith caught three of his six targets for 53 yards in the Eagles’ 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
news.impact: The wideout was mostly held in check despite leading the team in targets, finishing behind tight end Dallas Goedert and No. 2 wideout Dontayvion Wicks in receiving yards on the win. The wideout remains one of the more explosive options in the Philadelphia passing attack, with an opportunity to get back on track against the Tennessee Titans in Week 2 up next.

news.head: DeVonta Smith practicing fully on Monday
news.body: Devonta Smith (hamstring) is practicing fully on Monday for the first time in three weeks. He returned in a limited fashion recently, but he is back to fully participating.
news.impact: It’s great news for Smith as he works his way back from a hamstring injury. This should be the all the confidence boost fantasy managers needed to continue targeting him highly in drafts.

news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) officially limited Thursday
news.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Smith is still in the process of recovering from a hamstring injury, but he was able to take part in Thursday's joint practice with New England in a limited capacity. It seems like his recover is going well, and unless there's a setback of some kind, it looks like he will be fully healthy in time for the season opener.

news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) returns to practice Monday
news.body: DeVonta Smith returned to practice on Monday as he continues to deal with a hamstring injury.
news.impact: This is an encouraging sign for Smith, who has missed the last two weeks of camp with a hamstring injury. While he will likely return in a limited capacity early this week, he should be monitored to see how his hamstring responds to being back at practice.

news.head: Tank Bigsby sees one touch in Week 1
news.body: Tank Bigsby rushed one time for three yards in the Eagles’ 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
news.impact: Bigsby was more of an afterthought in the Philadelphia ground attack, finishing last on the team in carries. The running back remains more of a handcuff option for No. 1 running back Saquon Barkley ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

news.head: Tank Bigsby (toe) returns to practice Wednesday
news.body: Tank Bigsby returned to practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Bigsby missed some practice time with the toe issue. He is slated to open the season backing up Saquon Barkley.

news.head: Tank Bigsby finds the end zone in Week 18
news.body: Tank Bigsby carried the ball 16 times for 75 yards and one touchdown and added a 31-yard reception in a 24-17 loss to the Commanders in Week 18.
news.impact: Bigsby operated as the Eagles' lead back with the team resting Saquon Barkley in the regular-season finale. Bigsby will revert to a reserve role next week in a Wild-Card round home matchup against the 49ers.

news.head: Tank Bigsby runs in long score in win over Washington
news.body: Tank Bigsby ran four times for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Eagles' 29-18 win over Washington on Saturday.
news.impact: Bigsby played mop-up duty for Saquon Barkley once the game was essentially won for the Eagles, making a nice 22-yard touchdown scamper in the process. His primary value comes from being the handcuff, as he's not startable for fantasy unless Saquon is out.

news.head: Jake Bates picks up seven points in Week 1
news.body: Jake Bates converted all four of his extra point attempts as well as his lone field goal attempt to finish with seven points in the Lions' 31-30 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 1.
news.impact: Bates made the most of his opportunities behind a Detroit offense that battled consistency issues in the season opener. The kicker should once again be in line for plenty of opportunities in what should be a high-scoring Week 2 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.head: Jake Bates tendered by Lions
news.body: The Lions tendered exclusive rights free agent K Jake Bates.
news.impact: Bates took a slight step back last season, but he has still been a stable kicker for the Lions. He'll remain a strong option for fantasy managers next season.

news.head: Jake Bates kicks game-winning field goal in Week 18
news.body: Jake Bates kicked a 42-yard field goal with no time left on the clock to lift the Lions to a 19-16 win over the Bears in their final game of the regular season. Bates booted four field goals on the day and added an extra point.
news.impact: Bates went 4-for-5 on field goal attempts, with his four field goals tying a career-high. Bates was successful from 34, 30, 25, and 42 yards, and his lone miss came from 53 yards out to close the first half. Bates finished his second season going 27-of-34 on field goal attempts and 54-of-56 on extra points.

news.head: Jake Bates perfect in Week 17
news.body: Jake Bates converted his only field goal attempt as well as his lone extra point attempt to finish with four points in a 23-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 17.
news.impact: Bates fell victim to playing behind a turnover-prone Detroit offense Thursday, finishing with less than six points for the first time in six games. The kicker will look to close the season out on a positive note against the Chicago Bears in Week 18.

news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. sees 16 touches in Week 1 loss to Lions
news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. rushed nine times for a team-high 46 yards while also hauling in seven of his nine targets for 32 yards in the Saints' 31-30 Week 1 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.impact: Etienne Jr. made the most of his carries out of the backfield for a New Orleans offense that had trailed 21-0 at one point, averaging 5.1 yards per carry in the loss. The running back offers fantasy managers more potential in PPR formats, with a Week 2 contest against the Baltimore Ravens up next.

news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. splits first-team reps with Alvin Kamara Wednesday
news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. split first-team reps with Alvin Kamara in practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Etienne is likely to be the 1A in the Saints backfield with the contract he got in free agency. This will be a situation to monitor throughout training camp.

news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. signing with Saints
news.body: The Saints are signing RB Travis Etienne Jr. to a four-year, $52 million deal.
news.impact: The future of Alvin Kamara in the Saints backfield is uncertain as Etienne joins the group. The status of Kamara will need to be monitored the rest of the offseason. Either way, Etienne should be stepping into the lead role. He'll be on the low-end RB1/high-end RB2 radar for fantasy managers.

news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. gets 15 touches in win
news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. ran 14 times for 32 yards and caught a single pass for six yards in the Jaguars' 41-7 win over the Titans.
news.impact: Etienne had a bit of a quiet day despite the offensive onslaught by the Jaguars. He should be a favorite candidate to be the Jaguars' RB1 in 2026 after a bounce-back season.

news.head: Tucker Kraft totals 65 yards Sunday
news.body: Tucker Kraft caught 3-of-6 targets for 65 yards in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
news.impact: Kraft was playing in his first game back from his torn ACL. He was on a snap count in his first game back. He remains a TE1 heading into next week against the Jets.

news.head: Tucker Kraft signs four year, $75 million deal with Packers
news.body: Tucker Kraft has agreed to a four-year, $75 million deal with the Green Bay Packers. The deal is worth up to $92 million.
news.impact: Kraft was on his way to a massive season in 2025 before going down with a torn ACL. He gets his payday as the Packers lock in their emergeing star for the long haul.

news.head: Tucker Kraft (knee) off injury report for Week 1
news.body: Tucker Kraft (knee) is off of the injury report for Week 1's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.impact: Kraft has been rehabbing from a major knee injury all offseason, but it appears that he is finally close to full health again, as he carries no injury designation prior to the team's season opener on Sunday. He could be limited for his first few weeks back, but the team hasn't indicated that, meaning that he could be seeing a full workload in the very near future.

news.head: Tucker Kraft (knee) to participate in 11-on-11 drills in joint practice
news.body: Tucker Kraft will participate in 11-on-11 drills in the Packers joint practice with Cardinals.
news.impact: Kraft returned to team drills earlier in August. He remains on track to be good to go for Week 1 in September.

news.head: Bucky Irving active in passing game Sunday
news.body: Bucky Irving ran for 45 yards and a touchdown on eight carries in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday. He also caught 7-of-7 targets for 48 yards receiving.
news.impact: Irving took advantage of the gamescript in the passing game with Tampa Bay falling behind 21-3 early. He also lost a fumble, but otherwise performed well. He will be an RB2 play next week against the Browns.

news.head: Bucky Irving will be full-go to begin training camp
news.body: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Bucky Irving is “full-go” to begin training camp.
news.impact: Bowles said Irving looked good in practice on Wednesday. He is not being eased into anything. The question going into training camp will be what the split will be between him and Kenneth Gainwell.

news.head: Bucky Irving could see reduced workload to be more effective
news.body: Buccaneers beat reporter Scott Reynolds suggested the team may want to reduce Bucky Irving's workload to allow him to be more effective this season.
news.impact: Reynolds notes that there's a reason why Bucs head coach Todd Bowles has called Irving and Kenneth Gainwell 1A and 1B. The Bucs gave Gainwell a two-year, $14 million deal in free agency and he has reportedly impressed new offensive coordinator Zac Robinson. Gainwell emerged in a big way with the Steelers last season and it appears he could be in line for another similar role in the backfield for Tampa Bay. Irving is expected to be good to go in training camp, but he missed time earlier in the teams offseason program recovering from a shoulder injury.

news.head: Bucky Irving (shoulder) says he will be good to go for training camp
news.body: Bucky Irving said he expects to be "good to go" for training camp.
news.impact: Irving made the statement at his annual youth football camp. He has been limited to start the offseason program working his way back from offseason shoulder surgery after he played through a shoulder injury last season. The Bucs backfield will be a situation to monitor in training camp following their free agency addition of Kenneth Gainwell.

news.head: De’Zhaun Stribling (ankle) out at least one month
news.body: De’Zhaun Stribling (ankle) will miss at least one month for the San Francisco 49ers according to Ian Rapoport.
news.impact: Stribling leaves an already shorthanded 49ers receiving group even more undermanned early in the season after an impressive preseason for the rookie, with veteran Mike Evans now tasked with remaining healthy as the No. 1 wideout for quarterback Brock Purdy early in the season.

news.head: De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) suffers ankle injury Thursday, Achilles is OK
news.body: De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) suffered an ankle injury on Thursday against the Rams, but his Achilles is intact. Before leaving the Niners' 27-7 win, Stribling failed to record a stat.
news.impact: While the rookie failed to put up anything in the box score, he was playing the majority of the offensive snaps before he left due to the injury. He will likely miss time, but his usage early on is encouraging, and it will be interesting to see how the team treats him when he returns.

news.head: De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) ruled out for rest of game Thursday
news.body: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling has been ruled out for the rest of Thursday’s game against the Rams.
news.impact: Stribling was quickly ruled out after being carted back to the locker room, which is not good. There should be a further update after Thursday’s game or by this weekend.

news.head: De'Zhaun Stribling carted to locker room
news.body: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling was carted to the locker room on Thursday.
news.impact: Stribling appeared to suffer a non-contact injury running a route. There will be a further update provided on his status when available.

news.head: Packers D/ST totals three sacks Sunday
news.body: The Packers D/ST allowed 39 points on 239 total yards with three sacks and one interception.
news.impact: Green Bay held its own early despite still being without Micah Parsons. The Packers draw Geno Smith and the Jets next week.

news.head: Green Bay Packers hire Jonathan Gannon as DC
news.body: The Green Bay Packers are hiring Jonathan Gannon as their new Defensive Coordinator.
news.impact: Gannon was fired after an unsuccessful head coaching tenure in Arizona, but he lands in Green Bay with a promising unit led by Micah Parsons, who looks to return from injury during the middle of the 2026 season if not sooner.

news.head: Green Bay Packers D/ST quiet in Week 18
news.body: The Green Bay Packers D/ST recovered one fumble and had two sacks during Sunday's 16-3 loss to Minnesota.
news.impact: The Packers' defense allowed 363 yards of offense to the Vikings, forcing just one turnover, and collecting only two sacks on the day. Green Bay will return to its regular starting lineup next weekend in the Wild Card round.

news.head: Green Bay Packers D/ST struggles to stop Ravens rushing onslaught
news.body: The Green Bay Packers D/ST managed a single sack with no turnovers in the Packers' 41-24 loss to the Ravens.
news.impact: The Packers got punished in this game by the Ravens ground attack, surrendering 41 points to the team starting a backup QB who threw for just over 100 yards. It was not their best moment, and even though they are down some players, including star Micah Parsons, they can not let games like this happen and expect to make a deep playoff run.

news.head: Seahawks D/ST stellar in win Wednesday
news.body: The Seahawks' D/ST logged three sacks and three interceptions while allowing just ten points in Wednesday night's win over the New England Patriots.
news.impact: Seattle's defense put up a fantastic showing on Wednesday night. They not only held New England's strong offense to just ten points on the night, but they also recorded three interceptions, including one on the final drive of the game to seal the win. This unit is expected to be elite over the course of the season, assuming all of their key players remain healthy and on the field.

news.head: Seattle Seahawks D/ST shuts down 49ers offense Saturday
news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST held the high-powered 49ers offense to just 173 total yards on Saturday night as Seattle clinched the NFC West and the top seed in the NFC with a 13-3 victory.
news.impact: The Seahawks' defense was swarming all night, limiting the 49ers to just nine first downs and 173 total yards for the game. Seattle sacked Brock Purdy three times and also got a huge interception from Drake Thomas at the Seahawks' three-yard line early in the fourth quarter. San Francisco was 2-of-9 on third downs and averaged only 4.1 yards per play on the night.

news.head: Seahawks D/ST dominates Panthers passing attack Sunday
news.body: The Seahawks D/ST allowed 10 points on 139 total yards with two sacks, one interception and one fumble recovery on Sunday.
news.impact: The Seahawks held Tetairoa McMillan to just one catch all game. They allowed one touchdown with the field goal coming on short yardage following a Sam Darnold fumble. They draw a 49ers offense on fire in Week 18 with the division and No. 1 seed on the line.

news.head: Seahawks D/ST struggles Thursday night
news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST struggled on Thursday night, allowing 581 yards of total offense, while not recording a sack and not forcing a turnover during their 38-37 overtime victory.
news.impact: One of fantasy's best defenses during the season, the Seahawks have posted back-to-back low point totals despite two victories. Seattle has forced only one turnover and collected one sack during the two weeks. The Seahawks will look to rebound next Sunday in another crucial matchup at Carolina.

news.head: Gunnar Helm catches four passes in Week 1
news.body: Gunnar Helm caught four of his five targets for 28 yards in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
news.impact: Helm tied for second with four catches while finishing third on the team in receiving yards. The veteran tight end will be a TE3 heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Eagles.

news.head: Gunnar Helm (toe) ruled out for Week 18
news.body: Gunnar Helm has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
news.impact: Helm will be sidelined to finish the season. He closes his rookie year having caught 44 passes for 357 yards and two touchdowns.

news.head: Gunnar Helm does little in Week 17 loss
news.body: Gunnar Helm caught 1 of 2 targets for only one yard in Sunday's loss to the Saints.
news.impact: Helm had found a pretty nice groove in the passing game from Week 11 to 15, but he is not finishing up strong here in his rookie season. The fourth-round pick out of Texas has now caught just 3 of 5 looks for a mere 10 yards over the past two games.

news.head: Gunnar Helm (toe) removed from injury report for Week 17
news.body: Gunnar Helm was removed from the injury report for Week 17 against the Saints.
news.impact: Helm has shown flashes throughout his rookie season. He figures to continue to split snaps with Chig Okonkwo.

news.head: Cam Little has nice day against Browns
news.body: Cam Little made both of his field goal attempts and all four of his PATs in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.impact: Little should be a nice kicker for those in need of one, or for those who have him, thanks to the firepower the Jags offense possesses. He will look to keep up his success next week against Denver.

news.head: Cam Little racks up 11 kicking points in win
news.body: Cam Little made all five of his PATs and both of his field goal attempts in the Jaguars' 41-7 win over the Titans.
news.impact: Little had a great game with the Jaguars putting up a scoring onslaught against the Titans. He's now put up 10+ kicking points in each of his last five games.

news.head: Cam Little makes all five kicks Sunday
news.body: Cam Little connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: Little has connected on 28-of-32 field goals overall. He should be in line for plenty of opportunities in Week 18 against the Titans.

news.head: Cam Little totals ten points Sunday
news.body: Cam Little went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made both of his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 34-20 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Little did his job on Sunday, making all six of his kicks in a big win over the Broncos. He should continue to be a good fantasy option over the last couple games of the regular season.

news.head: Steelers D/ST scores TD in Week 1 win
news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 13 points while scoring a touchdown, forcing two turnovers, and notching four sacks in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
news.impact: Pittsburgh took advantage of the Falcons being forced to start their third-string QB in Cooper Rush. T.J. Watt dominated the whole afternoon as he sealed the game with a 35-yard pick-six in the fourth quarter while also logging two sacks. The Steelers will have a tougher test in Week 2 against the Patriots.

news.head: Steelers hiring Mike McCarthy as head coach
news.body: The Pittsburgh Steelers are working on a deal to sign Mike McCarthy as the organization's next head coach.
news.impact: McCarthy will succeed Mike Tomlin as the head man for the Steelers. Like Tomlin, McCarthy is one of the winningest coaches in NFL history, with a career record of 60.8% and 174 wins (15th). The Steelers value stability, and McCarthy brings that, along with ties to the city.

news.head: Steelers head coach Mike Tomlin stepping down
news.body: After 19 seasons at the helm of the Pittsburgh Steelers, head coach Mike Tomlin is stepping down as the Steel City’s head man.
news.impact: Tomlin was the longest-tenured active head coach in the NFL for one of the steadiest organizations in the league. The Steelers have had just three coaches since 1969, becoming a pillar of institutional stability. Tomlin never had a losing record as a head coach. However, after failing to win a playoff game since 2016, the Super Bowl champion head coach has informed the organization that he will step down, which will heavily impact Pittsburgh’s offseason plans.

news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 24 points in Week 18 win
news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 24 points while notching three sacks and forcing one turnover in a 26-24 win over the Ravens in Week 18.
news.impact: The Steelers played just well enough to knock off the Ravens. They were boosted by the return of T.J. Watt from injury. Pittsburgh will now host the Texans in the Wild-Card round of the playoffs while the Ravens will go home.

news.head: Emeka Egbuka totals 63 yards Sunday
news.body: Emeka Egbuka caught 5-of-6 targets for 63 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
news.impact: Egbuka entered Sunday fully healthy after coming off a toe injury. He got off to a strong start in the first half, but he was not targeted in the second half despite the Bucs trailing. He remains a WR2 heading into Week 2.

news.head: Emeka Egbuka (toe) cleared for Week 1
news.body: Emeka Egbuka (toe) is cleared to play in Week 1 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers against the Cincinnati Bengals according to Greg Auman.

news.head: Emeka Egbuka (toe) practicing again Friday
news.body: Emeka Egbuka (toe) participates fully in Friday's practice session.
news.impact: It certainly seems that Egbuka will have no limitations for Sunday's season opener against the Bengals. The second-year wideout will lead the Buccaneers' receiving corps for quarterback Baker Mayfield.

news.head: Emeka Egbuka (toe) logs another full practice Thursday
news.body: Emeka Egbuka remained a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Egbuka has now posted back-to-back full practices, leaving him well on track to be good to go for Week 1. He is an upside WR2 heading into the season and could be part of one of the higher-scoring games of the week on Sunday against the Bengals.

news.head: Travis Kelce solid in win Monday
news.body: Travis Kelce caught 3-of-5 targets for 71 yards in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Kelce wasn't very involved for much of Monday night's game, but he was able to haul in a big catch at one point that helped to leave him with a solid 71 yards on the night. Fantasy managers should be pleased with his performance in this matchup but should not expect him to be a TE1 on a week-to-week basis for the foreseeable future, especially with Kansas City seemingly wanting to operate as a run-heavy team this season.

news.head: Travis Kelce officially re-signs with Chiefs on three-year deal
news.body: The Chiefs re-signed TE Travis Kelce to a three-year, $54.735 million contract.
news.impact: Kelce was reported to have signed a one-year contract, but it is now a three-year deal. He caught 76 passes for 851 yards and five touchdowns last season, and will remain in Kansas City for three more seasons.

news.head: Travis Kelce officially agrees to deal with Chiefs
news.body: Travis Kelce and the Chiefs have now officially agreed to terms on a new deal.
news.impact: It was reported Monday morning and it is now official. Kelce will be returning for a 14th season with Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs.

news.head: Travis Kelce expected to return to Chiefs for 2026 season
news.body: Travis Kelce is expected to return to the Chiefs for a 14th season.
news.impact: Kelce had been deciding on his future with even reports coming out of him potentially signing with another team, but he'll instead return for another year in Kansas City. He hasn't been what he once was production wise the past few seasons, but he has still been very serviceable for the Chiefs. He'll still be on the fantasy radar despite not holding the upside he once had.

news.head: Mack Hollins leads team in receiving Wednesday
news.body: Mack Hollins caught 4-of-5 targets for 51 yards in Wednesday's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.impact: Hollins was one of the lone bright spots for New England on Wednesday night. He stepped up and led the team in receiving in the absence of A.J. Brown (ankle), and he made several important plays which helped to keep them in the game up until the very end. He isn't likely to be fantasy relevant moving forward but should continue to play an important role for the team.

news.head: Mack Hollins (abdomen) listed as questionable for Super Bowl
news.body: Mack Hollins is listed as questionable for the Super Bowl next Sunday against the Seahawks.
news.impact: Hollins closed the week with a full practice on Friday. He should be good to go heading into next Sunday.

news.head: Mack Hollins (abdomen) limited in practice Thursday
news.body: Mack Hollins was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Hollins returned from the injured reserve for the AFC Championship. He should be a full-go for the Super Bowl next week.

news.head: Mack Hollins (abdomen) activated from IR
news.body: The Patriots activated WR Mack Hollins from injured reserve.
news.impact: Hollins is set to return after being listed as questionable. He'll be back in a depth role in the Patriots wide receiver room.

news.head: Mark Andrews sees six targets in Week 1 win
news.body: Mark Andrews hauled in four of his six targets for 49 yards in the Ravens' 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.impact: Andrews received sizeable volume in the Baltimore passing attack, finishing tied for first in targets in the win. The veteran tight end remains a reliable option ahead of a Week 2 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.

news.head: Mark Andrews catches two passes in Week 18
news.body: Mark Andrews caught two of his three targets for 14 yards in a 26-24 loss to the Steelers in Week 18.
news.impact: Andrews was quiet as the Ravens lost the AFC North and will miss the playoffs. The veteran tight end wraps up his 2025 season with 48 catches for 422 yards and five touchdowns while appearing in all 17 of the Ravens' games. Andrews' days as an elite tight end appear to be over as the team did not prioritize getting him the ball in 2025.

news.head: Mark Andrews snags four passes in win
news.body: Mark Andrews caught all four of his targets for 28 yards in the Ravens' 41-24 win over the Packers.
news.impact: You would think Andrews would have a better game given the number of points the Ravens put up, but it was almost all done on the ground. He's tough to trust for fantasy at this point.

news.head: Mark Andrews quiet in loss Sunday
news.body: Mark Andrews caught 2-of-3 targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the New England Patriots.
news.impact: Andrews didn't have a productive game on Sunday. He caught just two passes against the Patriots and nearly had a costly fumble close to halftime, although it didn't hold up. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the last couple games of the season.

news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson totals 95 yards Wednesday
news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed the ball 18 times for 51 yards and caught five passes for 44 yards in Wednesday night's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.impact: Stevenson was New England's workhorse running back on Wednesday night with TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) out of the lineup. He ran at an inefficient clip of 2.8 yards per carry on the night, but his fantasy total was saved by the fact that he caught five passes. He will be more efficient than this in the future but will lose passing work to Henderson when he's back, so he will likely continue to be touchdown dependent on a week-to-week basis.

news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (eye) questionable to return Sunday
news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson is questionable to return to Sunday's Divisional Round game against the Texans.
news.impact: Stevenson left the game early with a eye injury. TreVeyon Henderson should see more snaps in the Patriots backfield while he is sidelined.

news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson dominant in Week 18 win
news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed the ball seven times for 131 yards and two touchdowns and caught two passes for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.impact: Stevenson saw just nine touches over the course of the afternoon on Sunday, but that was all that he needed. He logged 150+ total yards and three touchdowns against Miami, which left him with a dominant fantasy total in that matchup. He is set to return to New England next season and will continue to be featured in a two-headed backfield with TreVeyon Henderson.

news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson scores twice in Week 17 win
news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed for 47 yards and a touchdown on eight carries in the Patriots 42-10 win over the Jets. He caught all five of his targets for 55 yards and a touchdown.
news.impact: Stevenson found the end zone on a one-yard rush and a 22-yard reception in the first half to help pace the Patriots to a route of the Jets. Stevenson saw less carries than TreVeyon Henderson, but earned more targets in the passing game. Fantasy managers should expect both to continue to split time in Week 18 against Miami.

news.head: Dallas Goedert hauls in two touchdowns in Week 1 win over Commanders
news.body: Dallas Goedert hauled in four of his five targets for 77 yards and two touchdowns in the Eagles’ 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
news.impact: Goedert made the most of his involvement in the Philadelphia passing attack in the season opener, leading the team in receiving yards in the win. The tight end offers fantasy managers a steady TE1 option entering a favorable Week 2 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

news.head: Dallas Goedert returning to Eagles on one-year deal
news.body: Dallas Goedert and the Eagles have agreed on a one-year deal to keep the star tight end in Philadelphia for another season.
news.impact: Goedert played 15 games last year and caught a career-high 60 passes for 591 yards and a career-best 11 touchdowns. The 31-year-old has spent his entire eight-year career with Philadelphia and has totaled 409 catches for 4,676 yards and 35 touchdowns in 108 games. His status has been in limbo during the offseason and, with the Eagles signing Grant Calcaterra and Johnny Mundt, it appeared that Goedert's days in Philadelphia were coming to an end. That, however, is not the case as Goedert will take his rightful place as the starting tight end with the Eagles for a ninth season. He should be one of the first tight ends drafted in fantasy leagues in 2026.

news.head: Dallas Goedert not a free agent just yet
news.body: Dallas Goedert was reportedly not listed as a free agent by the league.
news.impact: Goedert's void date has been pushed back to Friday. It is still possible the two sides can work out a contract extension as a result.

news.head: Dallas Goedert 'moving on' from Philly
news.body: TE Dallas Goedert is likely to part ways with the Eagles this offseason.
news.impact: Goedert is coming off career highs in both receptions and touchdowns. Depending on his landing spot, he could be a mid-to-low-end TE1 in 2026.

news.head: Ladd McConkey (rib) to be monitored this week
news.body: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is dealing a rib injury and he’ll be monitored throughout the week.
news.impact: McConkey was further evaluated on Monday for his injury. His status is uncertain heading into Week 2 against the Raiders.

news.head: Ladd McConkey (rib) undergoing testing
news.body: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey will undergo testing to determine the severity of his rib injury.
news.impact: There should be an update provided on McConkey later this week. He caught five passes for 82 yards and a touchdown before taking an ugly hit on Sunday. His status is uncertain for Week 2 against the Raiders.

news.head: Ladd McConkey (undisclosed) exits early Sunday
news.body: Ladd McConkey (undisclosed) exited early for the Los Angeles Chargers against the Arizona Cardinals Sunday.
news.impact: McConkey headed to the medical tent after suffering an undisclosed injury, hauling in five of his seven targets for 82 yards and one touchdown for head coach Jim Harbaugh.

news.head: Ladd McConkey (hamstring) expects to be "full go" for training camp
news.body: Ladd McConkey said he expects to be "full go" for the entirety of Chargers training camp.
news.impact: McConkey was limited in spring action due to a hamstring injury, but a few months of rest and recovery seem to have been beneficial. The wideout is coming off a bit of a disappointing sophomore campaign after bursting on the scene with 1,149 receiving yards as a rookie. He will look to find more success with Mike McDaniel now calling the plays in LA.

news.head: Jalen Coker (ankle) in walking boot, not expected to miss time this week
news.body: Jalen Coker was in a walking boot on Monday, but he is not expected to miss time this week.
news.impact: Coker rolled his left ankle in the first quarter on Sunday. He still went on to have a career day. His status will have to be monitored this week, but he is currently expected to be good to go for Week 2.

news.head: Jalen Coker leads pass-catchers in Week 1 loss to Bears
news.body: Jalen Coker hauled in eight of his team-leading nine targets for 138 yards and two touchdowns in the Panthers' 59-37 Week 1 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.impact: Coker capitalized on sizeable involvement in the Carolina passing attack, averaging 17.3 yards per reception while leading the team in receiving yards in the loss. The wideout forms a dynamic duo with Tetairoa McMillan for head coach Dave Canales, with a Week 2 contest against the Atlanta Falcons up next.

news.head: Jalen Coker agrees to 3-year, $35 million extension with Panthers
news.body: Jalen Coker has come to an agreement with the Carolina Panthers on a contract extension of 3-years, $35 million with incentives that could drive it up to $41 million.
news.impact: The former UDFA has shown some promising moments in his tenure with the Panthers, notably having a 100 yard game in their playoff showdown against the Rams last season and has brought home quite the bag. He should find himself as the presumed WR2 for the offense.

news.head: Jalen Coker signs exclusive rights tender with Panthers
news.body: Jalen Coker inked his exclusive rights free agent tender on Monday to remain in Carolina for the 2026 season.
news.impact: Coker was tendered by Carolina in early March and made his return to the team official on Monday. The wideout, who will enter his third NFL season in 2026, caught 33 passes for 394 and three touchdowns in 11 games last season - very similar to the 32-478-2 line he posted as a rookie in 2024, also in 11 games. However, in last year's Wild Card round loss to the Rams, Coker hauled in nine passes for 134 yards and a score, which could signal another step forward in 2026 as he and quarterback Bryce Young continue to grow and get on the same page together.

news.head: DK Metcalf leads Steelers with 10 targets in Week 1
news.body: DK Metcalf caught four of his 10 targets for 40 yards in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
news.impact: Metcalf didn't do much damage but his usage was encouraging as he easily led the Steelers in targets while newcomer Michael Pittman Jr. saw just three looks from Aaron Rodgers. Metcalf will be a high-end WR3 in fantasy heading into Week 2 against the Patriots.

news.head: DK Metcalf off injury report for Week 1
news.body: DK Metcalf is off of the injury report for Week 1's matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.impact: Metcalf was dealing with an undisclosed injury earlier, but it's not an issue for him anymore and he is off of the injury report entirely ahead of Week 1. He goes into the season as the projected top target for the Steelers this season.

news.head: DK Metcalf practices Monday
news.body: DK Metcalf practiced on Monday.
news.impact: Metcalf missed time during training camp with an undisclosed injury. He remains on track to be good to go for Sunday's season opener against the Falcons.

news.head: DK Metcalf will be available Week 1
news.body: Steelers GM Omar Khan announced WR DK Metcalf will be available for Week 1.
news.impact: Metcalf has been dealing with an undisclosed injury, but appears to be good to go. He is a strong flex play against the Falcons in Week 1.

news.head: Chris Boswell makes two FGs in Week 1
news.body: Chris Boswell made two of his three field-goal tries while adding two extra points in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
news.impact: Boswell made field goals from 43 and 28 yards out in the win. The veteran kicker will now get ready to take on the Patriots in Week 2.

news.head: Chris Boswell signs four-year extension with Steelers
news.body: The Steelers signed K Chris Boswell to a four-year, $28 million extension.
news.impact: Boswell will earn $7 million per year which puts him tied with Brandon Aubrey for the highest in league history at the position. The new deal keeps him under contract with the Steelers through 2030.

news.head: Chris Boswell makes two FGs in Week 18
news.body: Chris Boswell made both of his field-goal attempts and added two extra points in a 26-24 win over the Ravens in Week 18.
news.impact: Boswell hit field goals from 57 and 25 yards out in the win, which gave Pittsburgh the AFC North title. The veteran wraps the 2025 regular season with 27 field goals on 32 attempts and 42 extra points. He will now prepare to face the Texans at home in the Wild-Card round next week.

news.head: Chris Boswell accounts for six points in Week 17 loss
news.body: Chris Boswell made 2-of-3 field goal attempts in the Steelers 13-6 loss to the Browns.
news.impact: Boswell connected from 40 and 44 yards out in the second quarter to account for the Steelers only points Sunday. His lone miss came on a 54-yard attempt early in the fourth quarter. Boswell and the Steelers will take on the Ravens in a matchup to decide the winner of the AFC North.

news.head: Braelon Allen sees 10 carres in backup role in Week 1
news.body: Braelon Allen carried the ball 10 times for 40 yards and failed to corral his lone target in a 23-10 win over the Titans in Week 1.
news.impact: Allen mixed in as the backup behind Breece Hall, who handled 22 carries and caught two passes. The Jets will continue to utilize Allen to spell Hall throughout the season, but the former only has fantasy value as a handcuff for the time being. He will take on the Packers at home in Week 2.

news.head: Braelon Allen 'looks spry' in practice Thursday
news.body: Jets reporter Ryan Dunleavy said Braelon Allen "looked spry" in practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Dunleavy added that Allen bounced a couple long runs to the outside. He is working his way back from a season-ending injury and figures to remain in his 1B/backup role behind Breece Hall.

news.head: Braelon Allen (knee) to miss 8-12 weeks
news.body: Braelon Allen (knee) will be out at least eight weeks.
news.impact: The news gets worse regarding Allen's prognosis after he was placed on IR earlier this week. The second-year running back suffered an MCL sprain while returning a kick this past Monday night in Miami, and it was announced Friday morning that he will be out of action for multiple months. Isaiah Davis will likely step into the top backup role behind starting RB Breece Hall for the Jets.

news.head: Braelon Allen (knee) placed on injured reserve
news.body: Braelon Allen (knee) is being placed on injured reserve and will be out for at least the next four weeks, although his absence is likely to extend beyond that.
news.impact: Allen recently suffered a knee injury of some kind. It is at least a mildly serious issue, as the team will be placing him on injured reserve because of it. He will have to remain sidelined for at least four weeks, but the team is expecting his absence to extend beyond that, although no official timetable has been determined. Breece Hall and Isaiah Davis are both primed to see a bigger share of the work in New York's backfield as a result of his extended absence.

news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. snags touchdown in win
news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. caught six of seven targets for 48 yards and a touchdown in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday. He also carried the ball once for 12 yards.
news.impact: Samuel looks to have come back to his old role on the 49ers, lining up everywhere and getting the ball put in his hands to make plays. He even had over 70 kick return yards. Samuel just might be a draft-day steal if they are going to use him like this throughout the season.

news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. starting against Chargers
news.body: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel Sr. will play against the Chargers in the preseason
news.impact: Thursday night's contest could offer a closer look at the type of role Samuel will have in the 49ers' offense this season.

news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. participates in team drills Saturday
news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. was participating in team drills at practice on Saturday.
news.impact: Samuel returns to the practice field two days after returning to the 49ers on a one-year deal. He will be a player to continue to monitor throughout training camp heading into the season.

news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. not practicing Friday
news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. will not practice on Friday.
news.impact: Samuel made his return to the 49ers on a one-year contract late Friday night. He should start practicing with the team soon.

news.head: Josh Allen dismantles Houston defense in big win
news.body: Josh Allen completed 20-of-29 passes for 334 yards with two touchdowns with an additional 23 yards and two scores on the ground on six carries in the Bills’ 36-31 win over the Texans on Sunday.
news.impact: Allen was in complete control on Sunday, carving up what should have been a difficult Texans defense on his way to a four touchdown performance. He will have another nice matchup against Detroit on Thursday who just allowed a 30-point game to the Saints.

news.head: Josh Allen won't play Thursday
news.body: Josh Allen won't play in Thursday night's preseason finale against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.impact: Allen saw some action earlier on in the preseason, but he is set to be sidelined for the team's final preseason game on Thursday night. He is fully healthy at this point and looks primed for another huge season from a fantasy perspective.

news.head: Josh Allen will play in preseason opener
news.body: Bills HC Joe Brady said starters will play against the Panthers in the preseason opener.
news.impact: Allen and the starters will have an opportunity to knock off any lingering rust while building momentum for the regular season.

news.head: Josh Allen (foot) enters offseason program without any limitations
news.body: Josh Allen said his surgically repaired foot feels good and has no limitations.
news.impact: Allen was present at the start of the Bills offseason program. He underwent foot surgery in the offseason, but he's entering camp fully healthy.

news.head: Brandon Aubrey misses one kick Sunday
news.body: Brandon Aubrey went 2-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.impact: Aubrey didn't have a good night on Sunday night. He scored just two points in the team's loss to New York, and he even missed one of his extra-point attempts late in the game. He should bounce back and return to being a good fantasy option sometime in the near future.

news.head: Brandon Aubrey signs four-year extension with Cowboys
news.body: The Cowboys signed K Brandon Aubrey to a four-year, $28 million contract extension.
news.impact: Aubrey becomes the first kicker to ever earn $7 million per year and receive $20 million guaranteed. He has established himself as the top kicker in the NFL.

news.head: Brandon Aubrey has until Friday to sign offer sheet with another team
news.body: Cowboys restricted free agent kicker Brandon Aubrey has until Friday to sign an offer sheet with another team.
news.impact: If Aubrey does not sign an offer sheet with another team by Friday, Dallas retains his rights for the 2026 season. He appears likely to remain with the Cowboys.

news.head: Brandon Aubrey says he wants to sign extension with Cowboys
news.body: Brandon Aubrey said he wants to sign a contract extension with the Cowboys.
news.impact: Aubrey added that "something will happen eventually.” The Cowboys placed a second-round tender on Aubrey that would pay him $5.76 million in 2026 after the two sides couldn't come to an agreement on an extension.

news.head: Jalen Hurts tosses three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Commanders
news.body: Jalen Hurts completed 14-of-25 pass attempts for 203 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing seven times for 46 yards in the Eagles’ 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
news.impact: Hurts made the most of an inconsistent season-opening performance behind center, averaging 14.5 yards per completion in the win. The quarterback will look to reward fantasy managers with more explosive dual-threat production in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

news.head: Jalen Hurts expected to sit out season finale
news.body: The Eagles are expected to rest QB Jalen Hurts in Week 18 against the Commanders
news.impact: Philadelphia is expected to rest most of its starters in the season finale. Third-year QB Tanner McKee will get the start against a struggling Washington defense and could be a serviceable DFS option. Jalen Hurts will turn his focus to the postseason, while also looking ahead to 2026 as a high-end fantasy QB1.

news.head: Jalen Hurts: Eagles starters uncertain for Week 18
news.body: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni said “we’re still thinking through” whether the team would play their starters in Week 18.
news.impact: The Eagles still have a chance to move up to the No. 2 seed in the NFC in the playoffs. There should be more clarity by Wednesday or Thursday on who will be starting for the Eagles.

news.head: Jalen Hurts struggles in wet conditions, throws 25th TD in win
news.body: Jalen Hurts battled accuracy issues in rainy conditions during Sunday's 13-12 victory over Buffalo, completing just 13 of 27 passes for 110 yards and a touchdown. The dual-threat quarterback added only five rushing yards on three carries, resulting in his lowest scrimmage yardage total through 16 starts this season.
news.impact: Despite the statistical struggles, Hurts avoided a fantasy disaster by connecting with Dallas Goedert for a touchdown in the first quarter—his career-best 25th passing score of the year. He will look to sharpen his play before the playoffs when the Eagles host the Commanders in the Week 18 regular-season finale.

news.head: Malik Willis underwhelms behind center in Week 1 loss to Raiders
news.body: Malik Willis completed 15-of-27 pass attempts for 220 yards and one interception while also rushing six times for 39 yards and one touchdown in the Dolphins' 27-13 Week 1 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.impact: Willis struggled to stay upright in the season opener, falling victim to five sacks in the Week 1 loss. The quarterback remains a sneaky option behind center due to his ability to use his feet for positive plays, with a Week 2 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

news.head: Malik Willis agrees three year, $67 million deal with Miami Dolphins
news.body: Malik Willis has agreed to a three year, $67 million deal with the Miami Dolphins that includes $45 million guaranteed.
news.impact: Miami won the Malik Willis sweepstakes. Now it’s up to him and the coaching staff to see if he can truly become the QB they want and believe he can be. Jaylen Waddle and De’Von Achane will still be the top targets in the offense, but likely at a lower volume of passes than they would otherwise see since Willis is not known for his volume of passes per game.

news.head: Malik Willis rumored to have interest from Browns, Dolphins
news.body: Malik Willis is expected to be an intriguing name in free agency this offseason with the Cleveland Browns and Miami Dolphins already showing interest.
news.impact: Willis has never held a starting role in the NFL and has appeared in 22 career games, with six starts, in his four seasons. Willis has played for both the Titans and Packers and has thrown for 1,322 yards and six touchdowns while completing 67.7% of his passes. He has also run for an additional 405 yards and four scores. If Willis lands a starting role, he would be an interesting target for 2026 fantasy drafts due to his dual threat ability.

news.head: Malik Willis (shoulder/hamstring) expected to be available in Wild Card
news.body: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said that he expects backup quarterback Malik Willis to be available.
news.impact: Willis missed the Packers regular season finale last week. He should be available to backup Jordan Love.

news.head: Eddy Pineiro racks up 9 kicking points in win
news.body: Eddy Pineiro made two of three field goal attempts and all three of his PAT's in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams.
news.impact: Pineiro had a solid game overall, though I'm sure he wishes that he could go back and have another try at the one he missed. As long as he is healthy and active and the Niners' offense keeps this up, he should be just fine for fantasy.

news.head: Eddy Pineiro signs four-year deal with 49ers
news.body: Eddy Pineiro and the San Francisco 49ers have agreed on a four-year, $17 million contract. The deal includes $10 million in guaranteed money.
news.impact: In his first season in the Bay Area, Pineiro finished 28-of-29 on field goal attempts and was 34-of-38 on point after tries. He tied for the league lead in field goal percentage (96.6%) and was 14th in the NFL in points with 118. Pineiro ranks second among active kickers in career field goal percentage (89.7%) as he has converted 139-of-155 field goal attempts in his six-year career. He is as steady as they come among NFL kickers and he should be a safe bet for 100+ points again next season.

news.head: Eddy Pineiro accounts for San Francisco's only points Saturday
news.body: Eddy Pineiro kicked a 48-yard field goal with just over a minute left in the first half to account for San Francisco's only points in its 13-3 loss to Seattle on Saturday.
news.impact: That was the only attempt of the night for Pineiro as Seattle's defense kept the 49ers' offense at bay for a majority of the game. Pineiro has missed only one field goal attempt all season (28-of-29) and he is 34-of-38 on point after attempts. Saturday was the only game this season that Pineiro did not attempt a point after.

news.head: Eddy Pineiro perfect in Week 17
news.body: Eddy Pineiro converted all six of his extra point attempts to finish with six points in the 49ers' 42-38 win over the Bears in Week 17.
news.impact: Pineiro continues a productive stretch, logging six or more points in each of his last four games. The kicker will look for more success in a Week 18 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.head: Cam Skattebo leads team in rushing Sunday
news.body: Cam Skattebo rushed the ball 18 times for 81 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 28-20 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: Skattebo looked pretty solid in his first game back from an injury that ended his 2025 season early. He led the team in rushing yards and scored a touchdown against the Cowboys, and he was clearly the team's top RB in terms of carries, outnumbering the next closest back three to one in that area. He didn't see a single target or catch over the course of the night, however. If Devin Singletary and Tyrone Tracy Jr. continue to serve as the team's primary receiving backs, Skattebo's fantasy ceiling could be capped by that on a week-to-week basis.

news.head: Cam Skattebo practices Saturday
news.body: Cam Skattebo participated in Saturday’s practice.
news.impact: Raanan noted that Skattebo was limited, but seemed fine. He left practice early on Friday following a collision, but it had appeared to be precautionary.

news.head: Cam Skattebo suffers apparent injury during practice Friday
news.body: Cam Skattebo left practice early on Friday.
news.impact: Skattebo went down after a collision with LB Arvell Reese. He remained on the sideline, but didn't return to practice. The Giants will be cautious with him.

news.head: Cam Skattebo (leg) "good to go" for first day of training camp
news.body: Giants general manager Joe Schoen said Cam Skattebo is "good to go" for the first day of training camp on Wednesday.
news.impact: This was expected, but it is a good sign to see Skattebo seemingly fully healthy heading into the beginning of training camp. The 24-year-old rushed for 410 yards and five touchdowns in eight games last season and should be the undisputed lead running back for the Giants heading into this year.

news.head: Jordan Love throws for 387 yards Sunday
news.body: Jordan Love completed 21-of-42 passes for 387 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
news.impact: Love tossed both touchdowns to Christian Watson as those two connected all afternoon. He did lose a fumble as the struggles began in the second half against the Vikings defense. He will face the Jets next week.

news.head: Jordan Love, Packers starters to see some snaps Friday
news.body: Jordan Love and the Packers starters will see some snaps again in Friday's preseason game against the Broncos.
news.impact: They are expected to play at least one drive again after they also played in the preseason opener against the Steelers.

news.head: Jordan Love (concussion) cleared but will not start Week 18
news.body: Jordan Love has cleared concussion protocol but will not start the Packers' Week 18 matchup against the Vikings as announced by head coach Matt LaFleur and reported by Adam Schefter.
news.impact: Love was a full participant at Wednesday's practice and has cleared concussion protocol, but LaFleur announced that he will be starting Clayton Tune on Sunday in the regular-season finale. With the Packers locked into the seventh-seed in the NFC, Love will get another week to recuperate and get himself ready for the Wild Card round. It's probably best to avoid Green Bay's quarterback and wide receiver situation if your fantasy league is still playing this week.

news.head: Jordan Love to practice Wednesday, remains in concussion protocol
news.body: Jordan Love will practice on Wednesday, but remains in concussion protocol.
news.impact: Packers coach Matt LaFluer confirmed that the Packers plan on resting some of their starters in Week 18. It is unclear if they'll try to get Love in for a quarter or so to knock off some rust after he missed last week.

news.head: Nico Collins turns in strong season debut
news.body: Nico Collins grabbed 7-of-10 targets for 75 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills.
news.impact: Nico Collins played his typical go-to role for QB C.J. Stroud on Sunday. Collins led the team in receptions, targets, and yards. He also found the end zone for the first time this season, hitting paydirt on a 12-yard play just before halftime. Collins is a WR1 for fantasy purposes.

news.head: Nico Collins sits out 11-on-11 drills in practice Thursday
news.body: Nico Collins did not participate in 11-on-11 drills at Texans practice on Thursday.
news.impact: It is too early to be concerned for Collins, but it's something to monitor nonetheless heading into minicamp.

news.head: Nico Collins agrees to a two-year adjusted contract with Texans
news.body: Nico Collins has agreed to a two-year adjustment to his contract with the Texans, getting more guaranteed money over the next two seasons. He is scheduled to be a free agent in 2028.
news.impact: The contract gives Collins a raise as well, not a bad deal at all. He should be in line for plenty of targets as the top wideout for QB CJ Stroud over the next two seasons, and don’t be surprised if the Texans try to extend him when the time comes.

news.head: Nico Collins, teams have called Texans to check on WR
news.body: Jordan Schultz reports that teams have called the Texans to check on WR Nico Collins.
news.impact: Collins is due for another contract as he is set to make $20.6 million this season when the wide receiver market is double that. It still seems highly unlikely he is traded, but it's a situation to monitor nonetheless.

news.head: Keenan Allen hauls in six receptions in Week 1 loss
news.body: Keenan Allen hauled in all of his team-high six targets for 32 yards in the Colts' 41-23 loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Week 1.
news.impact: Allen was unable to find much room despite leading the team in receptions, averaging 5.3 yards per reception in the Week 1 loss. The veteran wideout will look to offer head coach Shane Steichem more sizeable impact against a difficult Kansas City Chiefs defense in Week 2.

news.head: Keenan Allen will play in Week 1
news.body: Colts GM Chris Ballard said Keenan Allen will play in Indianapolis’ Week 1 game against the Ravens.
news.impact: Allen was arrested for DWI and DWI endangering a person on Sunday morning. He'll be in the WR4 range for fantasy managers heading into the season.

news.head: Keenan Allen facing two DUI charges after arrest early Sunday morning
news.body: Keenan Allen is facing two DUI charges after being arrested early Sunday morning.
news.impact: The veteran receiver was a badly needed addition to the Colts roster, and now he could find himself suspended for a game or two should the NFL find that action appropriate. It's also possible he will only face fines. Still, it's worth monitoring the vet's situation, as he was an interesting late-round sleeper in drafts.

news.head: Keenan Allen to begin practicing Thursday
news.body: Keenan Allen will begin practicing with the Colts on Thursday.
news.impact: Allen agreed to a contract with the Colts earlier this week. He'll add depth to a depleted Colts wide receiver room.

news.head: Ray Davis sees single carry in win
news.body: Ray Davis had a single carry for three yards in the Bills’ 36-31 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also returned two kicks for 51 yards.
news.impact: Davis is operating as the RB2 behind James Cook and one of the Bills primary special teams returners, which is a good sign of trust. While he didn’t see much of anything on offense this week, should anything happen to Cook, Davis will be a high priority pickup.

news.head: Ray Davis eclipses 100 rushing yards in Week 18 win
news.body: Ray Davis rushed for 151 yards on 21 carries in the Bills 35-8 win over the Jets. He caught 2-of-2 targets for 23 yards and a touchdown.
news.impact: Davis saw plenty of opportunities with the Bills resting there usual starters on offense. Davis found the end zone on a two-yard pass in the second quarter to help pace the Bills pace the Jets. Davis will enter the 2026 season under contract with the Bills, likely as the primary backup to James Cook.

news.head: Ray Davis gets five touches in win over Browns
news.body: Ray Davis ran three times for 14 yards and caught both of his targets for 20 yards in the Bills' 23-20 win over the Browns.
news.impact: Davis operated as a change of pace back for the Bills, and was in a two-way tie for second among the Bills in receptions. He's been putting up return yards as well, for what it's worth, helping out those in leagues that reward return yardage.

news.head: Ray Davis does not see a touch Sunday
news.body: Ray Davis did not see a touch Sunday.
news.impact: Ty Johnson saw four touches behind James Cook. Davis remains off the fantasy radar.

news.head: Juwan Johnson catches touchdown in Week 1 loss
news.body: Juwan Johnson caught three of his seven targets for 54 yards and one touchdown in the Saints' 31-30 loss to the Detroit Lions in Week 1.
news.impact: Johnson was impactful as the No. 1 tight end for head coach Kellen Moore, averaging 18.0 yards per reception in the loss. the tight end remains a stable option in all formats with plenty of upside in the New Orleans passing attack moving forward, with a Week 2 contest against the Baltimore Ravens up next.

news.head: Juwan Johnson restructures contract with Saints
news.body: The Saints restructured the contract of TE Juwan Johnson.
news.impact: Johnson was one of three players to restructure his contract with the Saints as they look to open cap space. He earned 100 targets last year.

news.head: Juwan Johnson totals 61 yards in Week 18
news.body: Juwan Johnson caught 3-of-5 targets for 61 yards in the Saints 19-17 loss against the Falcons.
news.impact: Johnson led the Saints in receiving in the season finale. He totaled a career-high in yards this year. He should be on the TE1 radar heading into next season.

news.head: Juwan Johnson sets new career high in receiving yards
news.body: Juwan Johnson secured all four of his targets for 95 yards in Sunday's win over the Titans.
news.impact: It was a big-play day for Johnson, as the veteran TE set a new career high with 95 receiving yards. This effort came a week after tying a career best with eight receptions. In his sixth NFL season, Johnson has enjoyed quite a breakout for the Saints.

news.head: Romeo Doubs fails to log catch Wednesday
news.body: Romeo Doubs didn't haul in any of his three targets in Wednesday night's 10-13 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.impact: Doubs did not get off to a good start with his new team on Wednesday night. He failed to haul in even a single catch against a tough Seattle defense, and he had a costly drop on a very important play late in the game. He should bounce back in the near future and may be a worthwhile fantasy option short-term with A.J. Brown (ankle) expected to miss a bit of time due to injury.

news.head: Romeo Doubs (undisclosed) does not practice Thursday
news.body: Patriots WR Romeo Doubs did not practice on Thursday.
news.impact: It is unclear what Doubs is dealing with as he did not practice on Wednesday either. It should not be a concern this early in training camp.

news.head: Romeo Doubs signs with Patriots
news.body: The Patriots have signed WR Romeo Doubs.
news.impact: The Patriots had a huge hole at wide receiver, especially after releasing Stefon Diggs. They have been in trade talks for AJ Brown, but now land Doubs in free agency. He'll have a chance to potentially step into the No. 1 wide receiver role for Drake Maye and New England. He'll hold more upside for fantasy managers than what he had in a crowded Packers offense.

news.head: Romeo Doubs drawing interest from Broncos
news.body: The Broncos have reportedly shown interest in free agent WR Romeo Doubs.
news.impact: Doubs was expected to go off the board early on Monday, but he is still available. Denver had shown interest in Kendrick Bourne, who landed in Arizona with the Cardinals.

news.head: Tank Dell restructures contract with Texans
news.body: The Texans agreed to terms with Tank Dell on a one-year, $1.7 million contract restructure.
news.impact: The move saves Houston $2 million against the cap. Dell is nearing his return from a gruesome knee injury he suffered late in the 2024 season.

news.head: Tank Dell (knee) is 'close' but 'not quite there'
news.body: Texans GM Nick Caserio said Tank Dell is “close” but “not quite there.”
news.impact: Dell was placed on injured reserve, so he’ll miss the first four games of the season. It is unclear when he'll be activated.

news.head: Tank Dell (knee) placed on IR, designated to return
news.body: Tank Dell (knee) has been placed on IR and will miss at least the first four games of the season.
news.impact: Dell last played in an NFL game all the way back in 2024. The 26-year-old wideout has been practicing for the Texans, but he will be given a bit more time to get fully back up to speed. The earliest Dell could see the field is now Week 5.

news.head: Tank Dell misses practice Tuesday
news.body: Tank Dell did not practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Dell remains on a schedule during training camp as he works his way back to full health.

news.head: Texans defense struggles to contain Bills in Week 1
news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 36 points on 409 yards of total offense while coming up with two sacks and no takeaways in Sunday's loss to the Bills.
news.impact: The Texans should feature a solid defensive unit this season, but they ran into a potent Bills' offense in Week 1. Powered by QB Josh Allen, the Bills shredded the Texans' pass defense, totaling 334 yards and a couple of scores through the air. Houston did come up with a couple of sacks, but Allen mostly had his way. The Texans will face another top-tier QB when Joe Burrow and the Bengals visit Houston in Week 2.

news.head: Texans D/ST recovers two fumbles in Week 18
news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 30 points on 354 total yards with one interception, one sack and fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Colts.
news.impact: Houston sat its starters in the second half. They remain one of the top defenses in the NFL. They'll take on Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers in the Wild Card round.

news.head: Houston Texans D/ST force three turnovers in win
news.body: The Houston Texans D/ST forced two fumbles, an interception, and racked up five sacks in the Texans' 20-16 win over the Chargers.
news.impact: The Texans put up a dominant performance once again, showing why they are one of the best units in the league. Both star linemen Danielle Hunter and Will Anderson added sacks to their impressive season totals in the win. They're on a hot streak entering the final week of the NFL regular season.

news.head: Texans D/ST scores touchdown in win Sunday
news.body: The Texans' D/ST logged three sacks, one interception, and one touchdown while allowing 21 points in Sunday's win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.impact: Houston's defense was slightly disappointing on Sunday by allowing Las Vegas' dismal offense to score 21 points, but they were able to make up for that by scoring a pick-six early on in the game. This is one of the league's best units and should continue to play pretty well for the remainder of the regular season.

news.head: Ravens D/ST stifles Colts in Week 1 win
news.body: The Ravens D/ST recorded two sacks, one fumble recovery, and one interception in a Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.impact: The defense stood tall in the season opener for first-year head coach Jesse Minter, allowing less than 275 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look to take advantage of a favorable Week 2 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.head: Baltimore Ravens hire Jesse Minter as Head Coach
news.body: The Baltimore Ravens are hiring former Los Angeles Chargers DC Jesse Minter as their new head coach.
news.impact: It was reported Minter turned down the Browns second interview as he saw better opportunity elsewhere, and this certainly fits the bill. He’ll look to take over the mantle of John Harbaugh and get the Ravens back into the playoff race in 2026 with Lamar Jackson at the helm of the offense and a talented defense to boot.

news.head: Baltimore Ravens parting ways with John Harbaugh
news.body: The Baltimore Ravens are reportedly parting ways with head coach John Harbaugh after 18 seasons. He was the second-longest-tenured head coach in the NFL.
news.impact: Harbaugh and the Ravens missed the playoffs this year, and there seemed to be some tension that was not present in recent seasons. Now, the Ravens are resetting with the coach in charge, a massive change for an organization that was 180-113 with Harbaugh at the helm. Harbaugh is a Super Bowl champion and should immediately be one of the top candidates for current vacancies.

news.head: Ravens D/ST allows 26 points in Week 18
news.body: The Ravens D/ST allowed 26 points while notching two sacks in a 26-24 loss to the Steelers in Week 18.
news.impact: Baltimore allowed the Steelers to gain 390 yards of total offense in the loss, which caused the Ravens to miss the playoffs. The Ravens struggled on defense in 2025 and will look to address that unit this offseason.

news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. runs for 31 yards in Week 1
news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. carried the ball nine times for 31 yards in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1.
news.impact: Robinson mixed in as the backup behind Bijan Robinson in the close loss. The veteran running back will continue to see some work as a breather back moving forward but he won't have much fantasy value outside of being a handcuff option. He will take on the Panthers in Week 2.

news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. signs with Falcons
news.body: The Falcons signed RB Brian Robinson to a one-year, $2.5 million contract.
news.impact: Robinson becomes the second "B. Robinson" in the Falcons backfield. With Tyler Allgeier in Arizona, Brian will serve as the backup to Bijan.

news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. drawing interest from 49ers
news.body: The 49ers have reportedly shown interest in bringing back Brian Robinson Jr.
news.impact: Robinson was moved to San Francisco in a trade last season. His market has been quiet as he potentially seeks a new opportunity where he can see more touches. He is purely a handcuff for fantasy managers if he returns to the 49ers.

news.head: Brian Robinson Jr. sees two carries in Week 18
news.body: Brian Robinson Jr. had two carries for nine yards in San Francisco's 13-3 loss to Seattle on Saturday.
news.impact: Robinson Jr. had a string of eight consecutive games with at least four carries before Saturday's effort. The veteran running back still serves as a security blanket for the 49ers in the event Christian McCaffrey goes down.

news.head: Omarion Hampton finds the end zone in Week 1 loss
news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed for 43 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.impact: A first-round pick in 2025, Hampton carried quite a bit of hype coming into his second NFL season, as did the Chargers' offense as a whole. At least some of that hype immediately died down after a disappointing season debut against a suspect Arizona defense, but it is only one game under new OC Mike McDaniel. Hampton found the end zone on an eight-yard run in the opening quarter, and this Chargers' attack will find its footing at some point. The Raiders are up next.

news.head: Omarion Hampton (ankle) will not practice Wednesday
news.body: Omarion Hampton is not practicing on Wednesday.
news.impact: Hampton is “working through it” and “doing everything he can” to get the ankle better that sidelined him in Week 18. He should still play in the Wild Card round against the Patriots, but it is possible he's still fighting through the injury.

news.head: Omarion Hampton (ankle) ruled out for Week 18
news.body: Omarion Hampton has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
news.impact: Hampton will be one of several starters sitting for the Chargers. Kimani Vidal could lead the backfield if he is cleared.

news.head: Omarion Hampton (ankle) misses practice Thursday
news.body: Omarion Hampton did not practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Hampton is likely to sit the regular season finale on Sunday. Kimani Vidal could open the game as the lead back, but it remains unclear how long he may play.

news.head: Denzel Boston snags bomb touchdown in loss
news.body: Denzel Boston caught two of four targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.impact: Boston had the Browns' only touchdown, though sadly it was in garbage time. His four targets tied with Jerry Jeudy for second on the team, an encouraging sign for his future usage as he gets further acclimated to the NFL game.

news.head: Denzel Boston to practice with first-team offense
news.body: Browns coach Todd Monken said rookie WR Denzel Boston will move into first-team offense.
news.impact: Boston continues to show out early on in training camp. He is slated to compete for an immediate starting role.

news.head: Denzel Boston selected No. 39 by Cleveland Browns
news.body: The Cleveland Browns have selected WR Denzel Boston with the No. 39 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.
news.impact: Boston becomes the second wide receiver taken by the Browns in the first two rounds of the 2026 Draft as they double up after selecting KC Concepcion in the first round Thursday. Boston is a much larger receiver (6-3, 212) out of Washington and led the Huskies in receiving yards last season. He did not run a 40-yard dash at the combine and doesn't display top speed to create separation. But, he does have excellent hands and he was very tough to bring down at the collegiate level. It's a little surprising that the Browns took another receiver with a need for offensive line help. But, Cleveland is looking for playmakers to improve the offense in 2026 and Boston should help with that as part of the receiver rotation.

news.head: Denzel Boston to visit Panthers Thursday
news.body: The Panthers are hosting Washington WR Denzel Boston for a top-30 visit on Thursday.
news.impact: Carolina holds the No. 19 pick as it looks to potentially add another wide receiver. Boston played for Jedd Fisch for his final two seasons in college, the same system that OROY Tetairoa McMillan played in under Fisch for two seasons at Arizona.

news.head: Trey McBride starts season with strong performance
news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 9-of-13 targets for 95 yards and one touchdown in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Chargers.
news.impact: McBride is arguably the league's top fantasy asset at tight end, and he certainly looked the part in Week 1. Coming off back-to-back seasons with more than 100 receptions and 1,100 yards, McBride was QB Jacoby Brissett's favorite target on Sunday, getting five more looks than the next-closest Arizona pass catcher.

news.head: Trey McBride hauls in seven passes in Week 18 win
news.body: Trey McBride caught 7-of-8 targets for 65 yards in the Cardinals 37-20 loss to the Rams.
news.impact: McBride was tied for the team lead in targets and led the team in receptions Sunday. Despite a shaky quarterback situation, McBride will be one of the top tight ends drafted by fantasy managers in 2026.

news.head: Trey McBride hauls in 10 passes Sunday
news.body: Trey McBride caught 10-of-13 targets for 76 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals 37-14 loss against the Bengals.
news.impact: McBride hauled in a garbage time touchdown from Jacoby Brissett in the final minutes with Arizona down 37-7. It was a huge bounce back week for him. He should be in line for another big game in Week 18 against the Rams.

news.head: Trey McBride quiet in loss Sunday
news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 4-of-8 targets for just 27 yards in Sunday's 26-19 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
news.impact: McBride has been dominant this season, but he had probably his worst game of the season on Sunday. He was held to just 27 yards against the Falcons and finished with his lowest reception total out of any game this season with just four catches. He should bounce back in the near future, but this performance was untimely for any fantasy managers who were relying on him in their playoffs.

news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) considered week-to-week
news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. is considered week-to-week after sustaining an ankle sprain in Sunday's game.
news.impact: Cooper had an MRI on Monday, which showed his ankle injury was not severe. The rookie first-rounder caught his only target for a 30-yard gain before exiting the Jets' Week 1 win over the Titans. He is probably a long shot to play in Week 2, but Cooper should return sometime in the next couple of weeks.

news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) ruled out with an ankle injury jury
news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) has been ruled out for the remainder of the Jets game against the Titans.
news.impact: Cooper had a nice 30 yard snag in this game, but was taken off the field on a cart. Fantasy managers will need to monitor his situation as details come through.

news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. signs rookie contract with Jets
news.body: The Jets signed WR Omar Cooper Jr. to his rookie deal.
news.impact: Cooper lands his rookie contract with the Jets in the middle of OTAs. He signed a fully guaranteed four-year, $17.5 million rookie contract. The deal also includes a $9.1 million signing bonus and an option for a fifth season.

news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. selected No. 30 by New York Jets
news.body: The New York Jets have selected WR Omar Cooper Jr. with the No. 30 overall pick in the 2026 NFL draft.
news.impact: The Jets traded back into the first round to select Cooper to pair him with Garrett Wilson at wide receiver heading into 2026. Cooper led Indiana with 69 receptions and 937 receiving yards in 16 games. Between Cooper and Kenyon Sadiq, the Jets have instantly made their offense better.

news.head: Lions D/ST stands tall in Week 1 win
