news.impact: The veteran wideout was again limited on Thursday as he continues to recover from a thumb injury of some kind. He is already expected to play this weekend, although he may still be left with an injury designation heading into the weekend if he doesn't practice in full on Friday.

news.head: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) in non-contact jersey in practice
news.body: Jakobi Meyers was in a non-contact jersey during practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Meyers remains up in the air for Sunday's season opener. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

news.head: Eagles D/ST registers one sack in Week 1
news.body: The Eagles D/ST registered one sack while failing to force any turnovers in a 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
news.impact: The unit left plenty to be desired in the season-opening win, allowing 296 offensive yards and three touchdowns on the day. The defense will look for more disruptive results for fantasy managers against an underwhelming Tennessee Titans offense in Week 2.

news.head: Eagles D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 18
news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 24 points while forcing two turnovers in a 24-17 loss to the Commanders in Week 18.
news.impact: Philadelphia's defense struggled to contain Washington's offense in the loss, although they did manage one interception and recovered one fumble. They will now prepare to face the 49ers at home in the Wild-Card round next week.

news.head: Philadelphia Eagles D/ST comes up clutch against Bills Sunday
news.body: The Philadelphia Eagles D/ST used a dominant first-half performance to hang on for a 13-12 road victory over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
news.impact: The Bills had a chance to win at the end of the game but a failed two-point conversion allowed the Eagles to escape with the one-point victory. Philadelphia had five sacks of Josh Allen on the day, at least two of which knocked the Bills out of field goal range. One of the sacks was a fumble recovery that led to an Eagles touchdown. Philadelphia closes out the regular season on Sunday at home against Washington.

news.head: Philadelphia Eagles D/ST contain Washington offense in win
news.body: The Philadelphia Eagles managed two sacks and an interception in the Eagles' 29-18 win over the Commanders.
news.impact: The Eagles defense played better than their fantasy counting stats would suggest. They held the Commanders to just 10 points until garbage time, and frankly, dictated the game for the most part. They'll be tough to trust against a healthy and explosive Buffalo offense next week, however.

news.head: Jaylen Waddle disappoints in Broncos debut Monday
news.body: Jaylen Waddle caught 1-of-3 targets for just two yards in Monday night's 31-10 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.impact: There has been a lot of hype for the veteran wideout after the Broncos traded for him this offseason, but he got off to a poor start with his new team on Monday night. He caught one pass for just two yards over the course of the game, which burned any fantasy manager who risked starting him in this matchup. Denver's offense as a whole struggled heavily against Kansas City's defense, however, so there's a good chance that he and the rest of the offense bounce back and return to solid fantasy production in easier matchups moving forward.

news.head: Jaylen Waddle (leg) in full pads at practice Tuesday
news.body: Jaylen Waddle is in full pads at practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: It is another positive sign for Waddle following his return to practice on Monday. He remains on track to be good to go for the start of the regular season.

news.head: Jaylen Waddle (leg) returns to practice Monday
news.body: Jaylen Waddle returned to practice on Monday after dealing with a leg muscle strain.
news.impact: Waddle missed practice all of last week, but has now returned to action at the start of this week. The wideout should still be monitored throughout the week to see if an injury pops back up.

news.head: Jaylen Waddle (muscle strain) not practicing Wednesday
news.body: Jaylen Waddle remained absent from practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Waddle is likely to miss practice all week. He is sidelined with a muscle strain.

news.head: Joe Burrow not at best Sunday
news.body: Joe Burrow completed 25-of-35 passes for 254 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.impact: While Cincinnati won the game, Burrow did not have the most inspiring of performances for fantasy managers. That included a pick-six. He will face the Texans defense in Week 2.

news.head: Joe Burrow, Bengals starters will not play in preseason finale
news.body: The Bengals starters will not play in Friday’s preseason finale against the Eagles.
news.impact: We will see Joe Burrow and the starters for Cincinnati back on the field in Week 1 against the Bucs.

news.head: Joe Burrow, Bengals starters set to be sidelined Saturday
news.body: Joe Burrow and Cincinnati's starters are set to be sidelined for Saturday's preseason game against the Chicago Bears.
news.impact: Burrow and many of Cincinnati's starters played in the team's first preseason game last week, but they are going to be sidelined for this week's game against the Bears. It remains to be seen if their starters will take the field for the team's third and final preseason game on August 28.

news.head: Joe Burrow, Bengals starters to play in preseason opener
news.body: The Bengals starters will play in their preseason opener against the Lions.
news.impact: It likely won't be more than one or two series for the starters, but we'll at least get a glimpse at seeing them play.

news.head: Caleb Williams posts four touchdowns in Week 1 win over Panthers
news.body: Caleb Williams completed 21-of-29 pass attempts for 269 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing 10 times for 65 yards and two touchdowns in a 59-37 Week 1 win over the Carolina Panthers.
news.impact: Williams was electric behind center to begin the season for head coach Ben Johnson, recording multiple touchdowns through the air and on the ground in the win. The dual-threat quarterback will look to offer fantasy manager a dynamic option in a favorable Week 2 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.head: Caleb Williams throws two TD passes in Week 18
news.body: Caleb Williams completed 20-of-33 passes for 212 yards and two scores in Chicago's 19-16 loss to Detroit on Sunday. He was picked off once.
news.impact: Williams had touchdown passes to Colston Loveland and Jahdae Walker in the three-point loss. Williams closes out his sophomore season with 3,942 passing yards and 27 touchdowns to just seven interceptions as he leads the NFC North Champions into Wild Card Weekend against the Packers.

news.head: Caleb Williams surpasses 300 yards in Week 17 loss to 49ers
news.body: Caleb Williams completed 25-of-42 pass attempts for 330 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing five times for 18 yards in the Bears' 42-38 Week 17 loss to the 49ers.
news.impact: Williams continues a productive stretch behind center, throwing two or more touchdowns in five of his last six games. The dynamic signal-caller remains a versatile dual-threat option ahead of a Week 18 matchup against the Detroit Lions.

news.head: Caleb Williams tosses two touchdowns in Week 16 win over Packers
news.body: Caleb Williams completed 19-of-34 pass attempts for 250 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing three times for 30 yards in the Bears' 22-16 Week 16 win over the Packers.
news.impact: Williams turned around an otherwise pedestrian performance with two touchdown passes late in the fourth quarter and in overtime in a comeback victory. The quarterback faces an injury-ravaged San Francisco 49ers defense in Week 17.

news.head: Kenny Gainwell uninvolved Sunday
news.body: Kenny Gainwell ran for 15 yards on five carries in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday. He also caught his line target for three yards receiving.
news.impact: This felt like the perfect time for Gainwell to make an impact with Tampa Bay falling behind 21-3 early, but it was Bucky Irving in the passing game out of the backfield who caught seven passes. Gainwell is a risky flex play for now in PPR leagues until we see him more involved.

news.head: Kenny Gainwell (personal) not practicing Friday, expected back Sunday
news.body: Kenny Gainwell is not practicing on Friday due to personal reasons.
news.impact: It is an excused absence for Gainwell, who is expected to be back on Sunday. He is competing for a complimentary role alongside Bucky Irving.

news.head: Kenneth Gainwell referred to as '1B running back' by HC Todd Bowles
news.body: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles referred to Kenneth Gainwell as the team’s 1B running back.
news.impact: The hype on Gainwell has continued since early in the Bucs offseason program. He was also only more noticeable early on with Bucky Irving recovering from an offseason procedure. This will remain a situation to monitor heading into training camp.

news.head: Kenneth Gainwell signs two-year deal with Bucs
news.body: Former Pittsburgh Steelers running back Kenneth Gainwell signed a two-year deal with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers worth $14 million.
news.impact: With Rachaad White's time in Tampa, Fla., likely over, the Buccaneers added another pass-catching back to play behind Bucky Irving. Gainwell had career-high marks in nearly every stat last season, with 1,023 yards and eight touchdowns from scrimmage. He should serve as a strong complement to the Buccaneers' offense.

news.head: Quinshon Judkins quiet in blowout loss to Jaguars
news.body: Quinshon Judkins ran 12 times for 33 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also caught both of his targets for 17 yards.
news.impact: Judkins was held back by the Browns inept offensive showing, as everyone except Deshaun Watson and Denzel Boston was held under 10 PPR points, and those two got over that because of a bomb touchdown in garbage time. Judkins is the lead back, but his fantasy value is highly questionable unless something changes.

news.head: Quinshon Judkins returns to team drills
news.body: Quinshon Judkins returned to team drills during practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Judkins missed two practices last week and was limited to individual work on Monday. He was back full-go on Tuesday.

news.head: Quinshon Judkins not seen at practice Thursday
news.body: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins was not seen at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Judkins missed practice on Wednesday due to a "minor issue." He remains day-to-day.

news.head: Quinshon Judkins not at practice Wednesday due to 'minor issue'
news.body: The Browns say RB Quinshon Judkins is not at practice on Wednesday due to a "minor issue."
news.impact: It is unclear what Judkins is dealing with specifically. It doesn't appear to be a serious concern.

news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. quiet in win over Browns
news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. ran six times for 23 yards in the Jaguars' 34-10 Week 1 win over the Browns.
news.impact: Rodriguez wasn't involved much in the blowout win, carrying the ball only six times. It's possible the team wanted to see more of Tuten today than CRod, but that's purely speculation. As for now, it's hard to start Rodriguez until we know more about what his workload could look like on a weekly basis.

news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (foot) off injury report for Week 1
news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (foot) is off of Jacksonville's injury report ahead of the season opener against the Cleveland Browns.
news.impact: Rodriguez is set to be a full go in Week 1 after battling with a foot injury throughout the preseason. He is likely to play a substantial role in Jacksonville's backfield this season, although the exact distribution of work will remain obscure until after the first game or two, which makes him hard to trust as a fantasy option in the season opener.

news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (foot) expects to be back for Week 1
news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. told reporters he plans to be back for Week 1.
news.impact: Rodriguez is currently participating in individual drills at training camp after not being on the field earlier in the offseason program. He is continuing to be managed early in camp as he works his way back to full health.

news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (foot) back at practice Wednesday
news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. was back on the field in practice to begin training camp.
news.impact: Rodriguez missed time earlier in the Jaguars offseason program with a foot injury. He will be competing for an immediate role alongside Bhayshul Tuten.

news.head: Baker Mayfield loses three fumbles Sunday
news.body: Baker Mayfield completed 23-of-28 passes for 216 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
news.impact: Mayfield did not throw a touchdown or interception, but he did lose three fumbles. He was able to run for 30 yards and a touchdown, but struggled through the air and with ball security. He was playing his first game since landing a three-year extension. He'll look to bounce back against the Browns next week.

news.head: Baker Mayfield signs three-year extension with Bucs
news.body: Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers reached agreement today on a three-year contract extension.
news.impact: This move comes out of no where as reports suggested talks between the two sides on an extension weren't going to continue this season. Mayfield lands his extension right before the start of the season.

news.head: Baker Mayfield: No immediate plans to re-open contract talks
news.body: Buccaneers GM Jason Licht said there are no immediate plans to re-open contract talks with Baker Mayfield.
news.impact: The expectation was that Mayfield would play this upcoming season on the final year of his contract. This will remain a situation to monitor all year.

news.head: Baker Mayfield expected to play Saturday
news.body: Baker Mayfield is expected to play in Saturday's preseason game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.impact: Mayfield was held out of Tampa Bay's first preseason game last week, but it looks like he is going to suit up and play in Saturday's preseason matchup against the Chiefs. It remains to be seen how many snaps the team will let him play, but it remains unlikely that he will see the field for much more than a quarter of the game.

news.head: Parker Washington snags touchdown in win
news.body: Parker Washington caught five of six targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns.
news.impact: Washington answered the call of all the offseason hype with flying colors. He scored on a 30-yard bomb from Trevor Lawrence early on in the game and kept showing up to make plays afterwards. Expect Washington to continue to be a focal point in the offense, especially if Brian Thomas Jr. were to miss any time.

news.head: Parker Washington, Jaguars remain in contract talks
news.body: The Jacksonville Jaguars are "not going to stop talking" to wide receiver Parker Washington as both sides iron out a potential contract extension, says general manager James Gladstone.
news.impact: Gladstone said the team would not hesitate to carry contract discussions into the regular season as they aim to finalize a deal with their breakout wideout. Washington had 58 receptions for 847 yards and five touchdowns last season and carries an expert consensus ranking of WR29, according to FantasPros, into his fourth NFL season.

news.head: Parker Washington (undisclosed) participating in practice Tuesday
news.body: Parker Washington (undisclosed) is participating in Jacksonville's practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Washington has been battling an undisclosed injury of some kind for a little while now, but he was back and participating at practice on Tuesday. That's a good sign that he is close to full health, especially considering that it was a joint practice with the Buccaneers. He seems to be fully on track to play in Week 1 and remains an intriguing late-round dart throw if healthy.

news.head: Parker Washington (undisclosed) expected to return to practice next week
news.body: Jaguars WR Parker Washington is expected to return to practice next week.
news.impact: Washington was absent from practice on Tuesday due to an undisclosed injury. He should be back on the field next week.

news.head: Quentin Johnston does little in Week 1 loss
news.body: Quentin Johnston came up with only 2-of-6 targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.impact: Johnston has finished each of the last two seasons with more than 50 grabs, over 700 yards, and exactly eight touchdowns. Some have him pegged to take the next big step up in his fourth season, but some of that hype will be quelled with this season-opening disappointment. The Chargers' offense just had a difficult time getting much going at all in their first game under new OC Mike McDaniel. Johnston should still produce some valuable stats, and he may have just become a nice buy-low option for fantasy purposes.

news.head: Quentin Johnston not expected to miss much time
news.body: Chargers WR Quentin Johnston is not expected to miss much, if any, practice time.
news.impact: Johnston limped off the field during practice on Tuesday. He is day-to-day for now.

news.head: Quentin Johnston suffers apparent lower body injury
news.body: Quentin Johnston left practice early on Tuesday with an apparent lower body injury.
news.impact: Johnston came up limping after an attempting to make a leaping catch on the sideline. There should be an update provided on his official status when available.

news.head: Quentin Johnston has fifth-year option picked up by Chargers
news.body: The Chargers exercised the fifth-year option of Quentin Johnston.
news.impact: Johnston will remain under contract with the Chargers through the 2027 season. He'll remain in the WR3/WR4 range for fantasy managers.

news.head: TreVeyon Henderson returning to practice on Monday
news.body: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) is returning to practice on Monday.
news.impact: Henderson missed the Patriots game against Seattle on Wednesday, but is hopefully going to make his return to the field for Week 2. Should he play, it will be interesting to see how things are divvied up between him and Rhamondre Stevenson. Stevenson wasn't particularly efficient at first glance, but looking deeper, he had to do a lot of work after contact, so his box score might not be as bad as thought.

news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) ruled out for Week 1
news.body: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) has been ruled out for Week 1 for the New England Patriots against the Seattle Seahawks according to Ari Meirov.
news.impact: Henderson will miss the season opener after being unable to practice to begin the week for head coach Mike Vrabel. Rhamondre Stevenson will see as many touches as he can handle against a strong Seattle front seven Wednesday night.

news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) officially misses practice Monday
news.body: TreVeyon Henderson missed practice again on Monday.
news.impact: Henderson continues to trend towards missing Wednesday’s season opener.

news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) not seen practicing Monday
news.body: TreVeyon Henderson was not seen practicing on Monday.
news.impact: Henderson continues to trend towards likely being sidelined for Wednesday’s season opener. Rhamondre Stevenson should open the season in a workhorse role.

news.head: Rashod Bateman sees one target in Week 1
news.body: Rashod Bateman failed to catch his lone target in the Ravens' 41-23 win over the Indianapolis Colts in Week 1.
news.impact: Bateman operated as more of an afterthought in a Baltimore passing attack that lost both Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) to injury, but could be in line for increased usage if either of the pass-catchers misses time ahead of a Week 2 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.head: Rashod Bateman back at practice Thursday
news.body: Rashod Bateman returned to practice for Baltimore on Thursday.
news.impact: Bateman had missed the previous two days of practice for the Ravens.

news.head: Rashod Bateman (personal) has not been at Ravens OTAs
news.body: Ravens WR Rashod Bateman hasn't been at voluntary workouts since the first week of offseason program.
news.impact: "He's dealing with some personal things and so he hasn't been here for a little bit," OC Declan Doyle said. The Ravens don't seem to be too worried.

news.head: Rashod Bateman (illness) inactive for Week 18
news.body: Rashod Bateman (illness) is inactive for Week 18 for the Baltimore Ravens against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.impact: Bateman will not suit up for head coach John Harbaugh, with DeAndre Hopkins, Devontez Walker, and Tylan Wallace likely to make up for the wideout’s absence. The pass-catcher finishes with 19 receptions for 224 yards and two touchdowns in 13 games this season for the Ravens.

news.head: Emmett Johnson totals 68 yards in NFL debut Monday
news.body: Emmett Johnson rushed the ball eight times for 24 yards and caught two passes for 44 yards in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: The rookie looked good in his NFL debut on Monday night, totaling 68 yards on ten opportunities against one of the NFL's best defensive fronts. Kenneth Walker III is clearly the bellcow running back on this offense, but it looks like Johnson has solidified himself as the RB2 and will continue to play an important depth role for the Chiefs over the course of the season.

news.head: Emmett Johnson signs rookie contract with Chiefs
news.body: The Chiefs signed RB Emmett Johnson to his rookie deal.
news.impact: Johnson was a fifth-round pick of Kansas City. He will compete for a depth role in the Chiefs backfield.

news.head: Emmett Johnson selected No. 161 by Kansas City Chiefs
news.body: The Kansas City Chiefs have selected RB Emmett Johnson with the No. 161 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.
news.impact: The Kansas City Chiefs made a massive splash in free agency, signing Kenneth Walker III. However, the depth behind him was extremely thin, with Brashard Smith as the next man up. Emmett Johnson should be the Chiefs' No. 2 running back and has fantasy upside, especially given Walker's injury history.

news.head: Evan McPherson connects on seven kicks Sunday
news.body: Evan McPherson made 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 20, 55, 58 and 32 yards out. He should remain a fairly reliable weekly play for fantasy managers.

news.head: Evan McPherson shut out in loss
news.body: Evan McPherson failed to hit either of his PATs in the Bengals' 20-18 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
news.impact: McPherson's failed PATs put the Bengals on the backfoot, forcing them to take a 2-PT conversion attempt that ultimately failed. He's been solid and actually finished with the best FGM % of his career. He should be a good bet for fantasy relevance next season.

news.head: Evan McPherson makes all but one kick Sunday
news.body: Evan McPherson made his lone field goal and 4-of-5 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: McPherson made his lone field goal from 57 yards out. He did miss one extra point attempt, but it did not matter in the blowout win for the Bengals.

news.head: Evan McPherson perfect in win Sunday
news.body: Evan McPherson went 6-for-6 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.impact: McPherson made all seven of his kicks against the Dolphins, six of which were extra points. He should continue to be a decent fantasy option at the kicker position over the last couple games of the season.

news.head: Chase Brown finds the end zone Sunday
news.body: Chase Brown ran for 56 yards and a touchdown on 16 carries in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 5-of-6 targets for 22 yards receiving.
news.impact: Brown did not have the most efficient afternoon, but it still got the job done for fantasy managers. He draws a tougher matchup in Week 2 against the Texans.

news.head: Chase Brown, Bengals in talks on extension
news.body: The Bengals and RB Chase Brown are reportedly in talks on an extension.
news.impact: Brown finished the season strong this past year after a rough first half. He is entering the final year of his rookie contract next season, which would make sense for both sides.

news.head: Chase Brown catches touchdown in loss
news.body: Chase Brown ran 13 times for 72 yards and caught four of six targets for 18 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 20-18 loss to the Browns.
news.impact: Brown closed the 2025 season with a nice fantasy day, totaling 90 scrimmage yards and a score. He struggled early on this season but rounded into form as time went on, and should be a low-end RB1, high-end RB2 for 2026.

news.head: Chase Brown (illness) returns to practice
news.body: Chase Brown (illness) was back at practice on Friday.
news.impact: Brown missed the previous two days of practice due to being under the weather, but the Bengals lead ball carrier returned Friday. He should be ready to roll for Sunday's seas finale against the Browns.

news.head: Jayden Daniels tosses two touchdowns in Week 1 loss to Eagles
news.body: Jayden Daniels completed 18-of-34 pass attempts for 164 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing five times for 31 yards on the Commanders’ 24-22 Week 1 loss to the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.impact: Daniels was unable to find much success against a stout Philadelphia defense in the season opener, completing 53% of his pass attempts in the loss. The quarterback will look to offer more impactful results against a Dallas Cowboys defense that struggled in Week 1 against the New York Giants.

news.head: Jayden Daniels expected to play against Lions
news.body: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels is set to start against the Lions on Saturday.
news.impact: Daniels had a very underwhelming sophomore campaign, largely due to injury. He and the starters will have an opportunity to build chemistry and momentum ahead of the regular season.

news.head: Jayden Daniels: OC David Blough expected to run QB friendly offense
news.body: Commanders GM Adam Peters said he believes the David Blough offense will be more QB friendly for Jayden Daniels.
news.impact: Peters added he believes Daniels will have more options in the new offense under Blough. He'll be looking to bounce back after he was limited to just seven games due to injuries last season.

news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) to miss final three games
news.body: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will be shut down for the remainder of the season.
news.impact: With Daniels sidelined, Marcus Mariota is expected to start the final three games. Mariota has 11 total touchdowns across seven starts this season and has been a serviceable fantasy option. Daniels will now turn his focus toward a full recovery and preparing for the 2026 season.

news.head: Calvin Ridley not targeted in Week 1
news.body: Calvin Ridley was not targeted in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
news.impact: Ridley was on the field but did not record any stats in the lopsided loss to New York. The entire Titans offense struggled in the contest, but Ridley's lack of participation is still highly concerning going forward. He can be cut in shallow leagues heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Eagles.

news.head: Calvin Ridley (illness) returns to practice Thursday
news.body: Calvin Ridley was back at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Ridley missed one day of practice due to an illness. His role in the Titans wide receiver room remains uncertain.

news.head: Calvin Ridley (illness) misses practice Wednesday
news.body: Calvin Ridley is not practicing on Wednesday due to a stomach bug.
news.impact: Ridley is expected to be back at practice on Thursday. He is day-to-day.

news.head: Calvin Ridley restructures contract with Titans
news.body: The Titans agreed to terms on a restructured contract with WR Calvin Ridley.
news.impact: Ridley is coming off missing the back half of last season due to a broken fibula. He'll remain in Tennessee despite rumors of him potentially being released.

news.head: Terry McLaurin quiet in Week 1 loss to Eagles
news.body: Terry McLaurin caught two of his four targets for 14 yards in the Commanders’ 24-22 Week 1 loss to the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.impact: McLaurin was one of the more underwhelming options as part of a disappointing Washington aerial attack in the season opener, averaging 7.0 yards per reception in the loss. The wideout will look to get back on track in Week 2 against a Dallas Cowboys that struggled to slow down the New York Giants in Week 1.

news.head: Terry McLaurin expected to play against Lions
news.body: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin is set to start against the Lions on Saturday.
news.impact: McLaurin enters the fantasy football season as a top-50 selection. He and Jayden Daniels will have an opportunity to build momentum ahead of the regular season.

news.head: Terry McLaurin catches four passes in season finale
news.body: Terry McLaurin caught all four of his targets for 57 yards in a 24-17 win over the Eagles in Week 18.
news.impact: McLaurin finished as the Commanders' receiving leader in the season-ender. The veteran did not live up to expectations in 2025, appearing in just 10 games due to injury. He wound up with just 38 catches for 582 yards and three touchdowns along the way. McLaurin is a candidate to post a bounce-back season for Washington in 2026.

news.head: Terry McLaurin hauls in five receptions in Week 17 loss to Cowboys
news.body: Terry McLaurin hauled in five of his seven targets for 63 yards in the Commanders' 30-23 Week 17 loss to the Cowboys.
news.impact: McLaurin has made an impact in the Washington passing attack when called upon, logging six or more targets in three of his last five games. The wideout will look to finish an injury-riddled season on a positive note in Week 18 against the Philadelphia Eagles.

news.head: Mike Evans snags touchdown in 49ers debut
news.body: Mike Evans caught six of seven targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in the 49ers' 27-7 blowout win over the Rams on Thursday.
news.impact: Evans had a nice end zone fade touchdown over a Rams DB who was draped all over him, as well as plenty of third-down usage. He's looking like a potential draft-day steal if his momentum keeps up. This is especially true if De'Zhaun Stribling misses extended time with an ankle injury.

news.head: Mike Evans (adductor) returns to practice
news.body: Mike Evans returned to practice Wednesday.
news.impact: Evans was back on the field after being sidelined for most of training camp. He should be good to go for the season opener next week.

news.head: Mike Evans (adductor) hopeful to return to practice next week
news.body: 49ers GM John Lynch said he hopes Mike Evans will practice next week.
news.impact: Evans has been absent from practice for much of the past few weeks. He will likely need to log multiple practices early next week to have a good chance of playing in Week 1 against the Rams.

news.head: Mike Evans (groin) planning to play Week 1
news.body: Mike Evans is planning to play in Week 1 as he continues to deal with a groin injury.
news.impact: Evans' groin injury is being described as "minor" after missing back-to-back practices this week. The veteran's status should be monitored leading up to the opening week of the regular season.

news.head: Emari Demercado claimed off waivers by Cowboys
news.body: The Cowboys claimed RB Emari Demercado off waivers.
news.impact: Javonte Williams and Malik Davis were the two lone running backs to make the initial 53-man roster for Dallas. Demercado will add depth behind them.

news.head: Emari Demercado signs with Chiefs
news.body: The Chiefs signed RB Emari Demercado to a one-year contract.
news.impact: Demercado spent his time in Arizona as a depth player in the Cardinals backfield. He will remain in a similar role in the Chiefs backfield.

news.head: Emari Demercado to become free agent
news.body: The Cardinals will not tender restricted free agent RB Emari Demercado, making him a free agent.
news.impact: Demercado has been with Arizona since he signed with them as undrafted free agent. He will likely seek a depth role on another team.

news.head: Emari Demercado quiet in Week 18 loss
news.body: Emari Demercado rushed for 29 yards on two carries and caught his lone target for 28 yards in the Cardinals 37-20 loss to the Rams.
news.impact: Demercado was used sparingly Sunday, with Michael Carter seeing the bulk of the carries Sunday. The 26-year-old is set to be a restricted free agent.

news.head: Brandon Aiyuk remains on left squad list
news.body: 49ers GM John Lynch said Brandon Aiyuk remains on the left squad list.
news.impact: Lynch declined to say anything about the Aiyuk other than: “I’m personally, and we as an organization, are going to focus on the players who are here,” Lynch said. “We wish him well, we wish his family well.”

news.head: Brandon Aiyuk: has warrant issued for speeding
news.body: Brandon Aiyuk has had a warrant for his arrest issued in Northern California due to misdemeanor charge for speeding. This comes after an investigation into a video posted by Aiyuk showing him speeding near Levi Stadium.
news.impact: It’s yet another feather in Aiyuk’s trouble making cap. Whether he comes under discipline by the NFL, and how, remains to be seen. Either way, this will hurt his stock even further; if any team was holding out interest in trading for him, that has likely taken a hit. He was already on the outs with the 49ers, he might have played himself, off the field that is, out of the league. That’s certainly an extreme stance, regardless, things aren’t looking any better for the talented but troubled receiver.

news.head: Brandon Aiyuk expected to be released or traded by 'summer's end'
news.body: Cam Inman of The Mercury News' reported that 49ers WR Brandon Aiyuk “is expected to be released if not traded by summer’s end.”
news.impact: The news on Aiyuk as of late has been fairly quiet. It is possible he could be released by next week if he doesn't show up to the 49ers first organized team activities session on May 27th.

news.head: Brandon Aiyuk, 49ers have discussed trade with other teams
news.body: 49ers GM John Lynch said the team has discussed a possible Brandon Aiyuk trade with teams.
news.impact: Lynch didn't rule out the possibility of Aiyuk being traded during the NFL Draft this week, but he also didn't completely rule it out. The 49ers don't have to be in a rush to make a move as they have until the start of September when they would have to start paying him. This will remain a situation to monitor to see if a deal can get done this week.

news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) will be limited this week, hopeful for Denver
news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) will be limited in practice this week, per HC Liam Coen. However, Coen noted that the reciever should be good to go against Denver.
news.impact: It’s great news for fantasy managers who were hoping to see more from BTJ before he exited early in what ended up being a blowout win. Thomas is looking to bounce back after a down sophomore season, but facing Denver while coming off of injury is a much harder task than facing Cleveland’s secondary.

news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) questionable to return
news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) is questionable to return for the Jacksonville Jaguars against the Cleveland Browns.
news.impact: Thomas Jr. suffered the apparent shoulder injury in the second quarter of the Week 1 contest, hauling in all three of his targets for 40 yards prior to exiting.

news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) without injury designation for Sunday
news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
news.impact: The young wideout's shoulder injury is no longer an issue and he carries no injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns. He won't be limited at all, but it remains to be seen how big of a role he will play in Jacksonville's offense in 2026.

news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) practicing in full
news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) has been practicing in full this week.
news.impact: Thomas has been limited by a shoulder injury recently, but he was back to full practice activity on Tuesday. The third-year wideout should be good to go for Week 1.

news.head: MarShawn Lloyd sees 13 carries Sunday
news.body: MarShawn Lloyd ran for 37 yards on 13 carries in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings. He did not catch his lone target.
news.impact: Lloyd was the lead back in the Packers backfield without Josh Jacobs. He was very inefficient as he averaged less than three yards per carry. He'll be a flex play next week against the Jets.

news.head: MarShawn Lloyd will play in preseason
news.body: Packers OC Adam Stenavich confirmed that MarShawn Lloyd will play in the preseason.
news.impact: Stenavich said every day Lloyd is able to practice, he gets more confident his injury issues are fully behind him. He is competing the backup role in the Packers backfield.

news.head: MarShawn Lloyd to be ramped up in training camp
news.body: MarShawn Lloyd is expected to be ramped up early in training camp.
news.impact: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Lloyd doesn't necessarily have a rep count in camp, but learning from past the plan is to "gradually" ramp him up for season. He'll compete for the backup role in training camp.

news.head: MarShawn Lloyd receives second-team reps Tuesday
news.body: MarShawn Lloyd received reps with the second-team in practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Josh Jacobs was back with the team taking first-team reps at practice on Tuesday. Lloyd was back after he was absent last week.

news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. finishes with one grab in season opener
news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught only 1-of-3 targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Chargers.
news.impact: Aside from one big play, Harrison did not make much of a mark for the Cardinals in Sunday's win. Quarterback Jacoby Brissett looked Harrison's way just three times, which was good for only fifth on the team. After finishing well behind fellow wide receivers Kendrick Bourne (8) and Michael Wilson (7) in targets, Harrison might be best viewed as a wait-and-see bench stash for now.

news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. dealing with cramps
news.body: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Marvin Harrison Jr. was dealing with cramps.
news.impact: Harrison had to stop practicing a couple times on Sunday. It is a positive sign it isn't a leg or hamstring injury he is dealing with.

news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. expected to play role as X-receiver
news.body: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Marvin Harrison Jr. will play the Davante Adams role as the team’s X-receiver.
news.impact: LaFleur has spent the past three years as the Rams offensive coordinator and figures to bring a lot of what he learned under Sean McVay to the Cardinals offense. This could benefit Harrison's involvement in the red zone the most as we saw from Adams last season in the same spot.

news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. (heel) placed on IR
news.body: The Cardinals placed Marvin Harrison Jr. on injured reserve.
news.impact: Harrison had already been ruled out for Sunday's season finale. He finishes his second season having caught 41 passes for 608 yards and four touchdowns across 12 games.

news.head: Bhayshul Tuten racks up 66 yards on the ground in win
news.body: Bhayshul Tuten ran 15 times for 66 yards in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also caught his only target for 22 yards.
news.impact: Tuten led the Jags in rushing attempts in the win, but didn't have much to show in terms of fantasy scoring in half- or full-PPR formats. But to be fair, he was efficient in his touches, and it's likely that better days are ahead for the apparent Jags RB1.

news.head: Bhayshul Tuten expected to ‘have a big year’ per HC Coen
news.body: Bhayshul Tuten is expected to “have a big year” according to HC Liam Coen. Coen praised the second year back in an interview, noting his explosive ability and the growth in his game.
news.impact: Tuten is the favorite for RB1 duties in Jacksonville with his do-it-all skillset, while Chris Rodriguez dealing with an injury this offseason and LeQuint Allen is primarily a pass blocking and catching specialist. He’s still a bit of an unknown since Travis Etienne handled the majority of backfield work in 2025, but his upside should things work out is tantalizing.

news.head: Bhayshul Tuten gets five touches in return
news.body: Bhayshul Tuten ran five times for 23 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 41-7 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.impact: Tuten didn't touch the ball much in his return to play, but it's important to note that he was the RB2 of the offense, putting LeQuint Allen back in his special teams role.

news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (finger) off injury report for Week 18
news.body: Bhayshul Tuten is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Titans.
news.impact: Tuten is set to return after missing the past two weeks. He should return to his change-of-pace role behind Travis Etienne.

news.head: Woody Marks gets 10 touches in Week 1
news.body: Woody Marks rushed for 42 yards on nine carries and caught his only target for a two-yard loss in Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills.
news.impact: Marks was certainly involved in the offense behind new workhorse back David Montgomery on Sunday. Marks averaged close to 5.0 yards per carry on his nine attempts. He'll remain a useful handcuff to Montgomery for now.

news.head: Woody Marks: Texans HC DeMeco Ryans seeing year two jump
news.body: Texans coach Demeco Ryans said he is seeing a “year two jump” from Woody Marks.
news.impact: Ryans noted specifically that Marks is looking faster and making better decisions compared to his rookie season. The Texans traded for David Montgomery who is expected to lead the backfield, but Marks should play a role behind him.

news.head: Woody Marks (shoulder) questionable to return Sunday
news.body: Woody Marks is questionable to return to Sunday's Divisional Round game on Sunday against the Patriots.
news.impact: The Texans offense is dropping like flies. Nico Collins was ruled out before Sunday's game with Dalton Schultz ruled out during the game. Nick Chubb will be among the players to see more run in the backfield for Houston.

news.head: Woody Marks sees 10 carries in Week 18
news.body: Woody Marks ran for 48 yards on 10 carries in the Texans 38-30 win over the Colts.
news.impact: Marks was pulled with the starters at halftime. He figures to lead the backfield heading into the second half.

news.head: Isaiah Likely hauls in two touchdowns in win Sunday
news.body: Isaiah Likely caught eight passes for 78 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday night's 28-20 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: Likely exceeded expectations in his first game as a Giant on Sunday. He led the team in receptions, receiving yards, and touchdowns on the night, scoring twice in what turned out to be a huge win over the Cowboys. His involvement on this offense looks great right now and he will likely be one of the hot waiver additions this week in any league he's not already rostered in.

news.head: Isaiah Likely signs three-year deal with Giants
news.body: The Giants are signing Isaiah Likely to a three-year, $40 million contract.
news.impact: The deal is worth to $47.5 million as Likely reunites with John Harbaugh. He should take on a bigger role with the Giants than what he had in Baltimore. He will be on the TE1 radar for fantasy managers.

news.head: Isaiah Likely to draw interest from Giants
news.body: The Giants are expected to show interest in free agent TE Isaiah Likely.
news.impact: Likely has history with new Giants head coach John Harbaugh. New York will be looking to bring in more offensive weapons to help the development of Jaxson Dart as they're likely losing Wan'Dale Robinson in free agency. Likely is one of the top tight ends available in free agency.

news.head: Isaiah Likely catches two passes in Week 18
news.body: Isaiah Likely caught both of his targets for 32 yards in a 26-24 loss to the Steelers in Week 18.
news.impact: Likely was the Ravens' third-leading receiver in the costly loss which caused Baltimore to miss the playoffs. The veteran tight end finishes 2025 with 27 catches for 307 yards and one touchdown in 14 games. An unrestricted free agent this offseason, Likely's production could explode if he lands with a team that makes him their starter. His landing spot will be an interesting story to monitor this offseason.

news.head: George Kittle snags two passes in win
news.body: George Kittle caught two of five targets for 12 yards in the 49ers' 27-7 demolition of the Rams on Thursday.
news.impact: Kittle was involved, that's for sure, but his small output won't cut it for fantasy managers who are relying on him. As he continues to ramp up and recover from his Achilles tear, he should see his involvement tick upwards.

news.head: George Kittle off injury report, active for Thursday
news.body: George Kittle is off the 49ers injury report and is active for their game against the Rams in Melbourne.
news.impact: Kittle is a day under nine months since his Achilles tear, and now will complete his improbable comeback by playing in the Niners season opener. Expect him to have a decent workload, though don’t be surprised if the Niners limit his snaps a bit. He’s crucial for their long term success, so they’ll need to keep him fresh and available.

news.head: George Kittle (Achilles) limited again Wednesday
news.body: George Kittle (Achilles) was limited at practice again on Wednesday.
news.impact: The star tight end was once again limited at practice on Wednesday. He seems to have a good chance to play on Thursday night, but he will probably be limited even if active. The team's official injury report should shed more light on his status when it comes out.

news.head: George Kittle (Achilles) limited in practice Tuesday
news.body: George Kittle was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
news.impact: Kittle remains on track to be good to go for Thursday’s season opener coming off an Achilles tear. It is unclear if he'll be facing any sort of snap count on Thursday.

news.head: Jared Goff tosses two touchdowns in Week 1 win over Saints
news.body: Jared Goff completed 26-of-39 pass attempts for 206 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing twice for two yards in the Lions' 31-30 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 1.
news.impact: Goff took what the New Orleans defense allowed, relying on dynamic running back Jahmyr Gibbs to carry a rusty Detroit starting offense in the Week 1 win. The veteran signal-caller remains a stable mid-tier option with QB1 upside ahead of a Week 2 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.head: Jared Goff will not play Saturday
news.body: Jared Goff will not play in the Lions second preseason game on Saturday against the Commanders.
news.impact: Goff could see some reps in the final preseason game. It will be Josh Dobbs starting with Luke Altmyer seeing reps behind him.

news.head: Jared Goff will not play in preseason opener
news.body: Jared Goff won't be playing in the preseason opener against Cincinnati this week.
news.impact: While Goff won't be playing, head coach Dan Campbell said he may play some starters in the second preseason game against the Commanders.

news.head: Jared Goff restructures contract with Lions
news.body: The Lions restructured QB Jared Goff’s contract.
news.impact: The move allows the Lions to get under the salary cap before Wednesday’s deadline. It lowers Goff’s 2026 salary cap hit from $55 million to just $15 million and adds a void year in 2030.

news.head: Cameron Dicker puts just two points on the board in Week 1
news.body: Cameron Dicker did not attempt a field goal and made 2-of-2 PATs in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.impact: Widely viewed as one of the best fantasy options among kickers, Dicker was not given much of an opportunity to contribute on Sunday. The Chargers drastically underperformed expectations, totaling only 268 yards of offense and being dominated in time of possession. Dicker will have better games, but this one was a huge disappointment for fantasy managers.

news.head: Cameron Dicker makes lone kick Sunday
news.body: Cameron Dicker made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 19-3 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Dicker was only given one opportunity on Sunday, but he was able to make it and finished with three points in the team's loss to the Broncos. That capped off what was another fantastic season for him, finishing as a top-four kicker in most fantasy league formats and distinguishing himself as one of the league's most consistent kickers in real life.

news.head: Cameron Dicker struggles in loss to Houston
news.body: Cameron Dicker connected on one of his two PATs as well as just one of his two FG attempts in the Chargers' 20-16 loss to the Texans.
news.impact: Dicker's misses were the difference between a Chargers loss and a potential overtime. But it was just not meant to be. He should bounce back next time out with the Chargers, as he's had 10+ kicking points in each of his last three games thanks to the offense that's been rolling.

news.head: Cameron Dicker connects on six kicks Sunday
news.body: Cameron Dicker connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: Dicker made field goals from 37 and 27 yards out in the second half. He has made 36-of-38 on the season.

news.head: Xavier Worthy quiet in win Monday
news.body: Xavier Worthy caught 3-of-6 targets for 18 yards in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Worthy was Kansas City's most targeted player on Monday night, but he wasn't able to do much with his opportunities, finishing with just three catches for 18 yards against the Broncos. He isn't expected to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.head: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) active for Week 1
news.body: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) is active for Week 1 for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Worthy will suit up after being able to practice throughout the week for head coach Andy Reid, joining fellow wideout Rashee Rice (knee) in offering quarterback Patrick Mahomes a full complement of weapons against a strong Denver defense Monday night.

news.head: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) listed as full participant Thursday
news.body: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) was listed as a full participant at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: To no surprise, Worthy seems to be over his shoulder injury and was able to practice in full on Thursday. He should be a full go for Week 1 but doesn't project to be a strong fantasy option in a matchup against the Broncos.

news.head: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) returns to practice Monday
news.body: Xavier Worthy was back practicing at Chiefs training camp on Monday.
news.impact: Worthy missed time during practice last week. The Chiefs had their full wide receiver room on the field on Monday.

news.head: Justin Herbert starts new season with mediocre performance
news.body: Justin Herbert connected on 17-of-27 passes for 209 yards with one touchdown and one interception, adding 29 yards on five carries in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.impact: Herbert and the Chargers' offense definitely disappointed under new OC Mike McDaniel on Sunday. This was expected by many to be an opening act for a dynamic offense against a sub-par defensive unit. It turned out to be anything but that. Herbert was sacked three times and picked off once while just clearing 200 yards on 27 throws. He did find top receiver Ladd McConkey for an eight-yard TD toss in the third quarter, but that was it as far as putting points on the board through the air. Herbert should still be viewed as a solid QB 1 going into a matchup with the Raiders, but if he disappoints again, the seventh-year pro will drop like a rock.

news.head: Justin Herbert, starters will play Thursday
news.body: Justin Herbert and most of Los Angeles' starters will play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.impact: HC Jim Harbaugh told reporters that Herbert and most of the team's starters are going to play in their final preseason game on Thursday night, with the exception of a few veterans. It remains unlikely that the starting unit will see more than a quarter or two of action, however.

news.head: Justin Herbert, Chargers starters to play one series Thursday
news.body: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said the starters will play one series on Thursday against the 49ers.
news.impact: We will get our first look at the Chargers offense under new OC Mike McDaniel.

news.head: Justin Herbert focusing on footwork and anticipatory throwing
news.body: Chargers OC Mike McDaniel has Justin Herbert focusing on footwork and anticipatory throwing.
news.impact: McDaniel is continuing to try to help Herbert improve and focus on certain areas of his game this offseason. The hype will remain high on the Chargers offense heading into this season.

news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. held in check on Sunday
news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. caught two of three targets for 21 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.impact: Fannin was held in check on Sunday, along with the rest of the Browns' offense. He will hope for better days next week against the Buccaneers.

news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (personal) does not practice Friday
news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. missed practice on Friday for personal reasons.
news.impact: It is not an injury related absence for Fannin. He'll likely be back at practice soon.

news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. cleared for training camp activities
news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) has been cleared to participate in the Browns training camp after undergoing offseason surgery.
news.impact: It turns out Fannin was cleared two weeks ago, it’s just seemingly been kept under wraps. There is much to be decided among the Browns receivers pecking order sharing the field with him, but he should be a favorite to be the Browns top target in the passing game, ala Brock Bowers or Trey McBride-lite.

news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. does not practice Wednesday
news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. did not practice at voluntary OTAs on Wednesday.
news.impact: Fannin was still with the Browns and watching from the sideline. It'll be worth monitoring to see if he returns to practice soon.

news.head: Ja'Marr Chase very quiet to open season
news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught 2-of-4 targets for 12 yards in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
news.impact: It was a Week 1 to forget for Chase fantasy managers to say the least. There shouldn't be too much of concern after one week, though he draws an even tougher matchup in Week 2 against the Texans.

news.head: Ja’Marr Chase (knee) cleared for Week 1
news.body: Ja’Marr Chase (knee) has been cleared to play in Week 1 for the Cincinnati Bengals against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Kelsey Conway.

news.head: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) logs full practice Thursday
news.body: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
news.impact: As expected, Chase was able to log yet another full practice session on Thursday. He is trending towards being a full go for the season opener on Sunday, assuming there are no unforeseen setbacks between now and then. He will be a top-tier fantasy option if active in Week 1 and beyond.

news.head: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) practices in full Wednesday
news.body: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.impact: Chase was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday and is considered close to full health, if not already fully healthy heading into Week 1. He should be a full go against the Buccaneers and projects to be an elite fantasy option in the season opener and beyond.

news.head: Devaughn Vele finds end zone in Week 1 loss to Lions
news.body: Devaughn Vele hauled in seven of his nine targets for 69 yards and one touchdown in the Saints' 31-30 Week 1 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.impact: Vele capitalized on a sizeable role in the New Orleans passing attack, finishing second in targets, receptions, and receiving yards in a losing effort. The wideout looks poised to offer head coach Kellen Moore another impactful pass-catching option in the New Orleans offense moving forward, with a Week 2 contest against the Baltimore Ravens up next.

news.head: Devaughn Vele (shoulder) placed on IR
news.body: The Saints placed Devaughn Vele on injured reserve.
news.impact: Vele will miss the rest of the season. He finishes the year having caught 25 passes for 293 yards and two touchdowns after being traded to the Saints mid-season.

news.head: Devaughn Vele (shoulder) out on Sunday against Jets
news.body: Devaughn Vele (shoulder) has been ruled out for the Saints game against the Jets on Sunday.
news.impact: Vele was having a bit of a breakout the last few weeks, but that is now on hold. Mason Tipton will likely fill the WR2 role in the offense, but the vacated targets will likely find their way to Chris Olave, Juwan Johnson, and the running backs than Tipton himself seeing a large bump in usage.

news.head: Devaughn Vele (shoulder) considered week-to-week
news.body: The Saints say WR Devaughn Vele is considered week-to-week with a shoulder injury.
news.impact: Vele avoided a major injury to his shoulder. It is unclear if he will return for the final three games this season.

news.head: Nick Folk misses two FGs in Week 1
news.body: Nick Folk hit two of his four field-goal attempts and added an extra point in a 20-13 loss to the Steelers in Week 1.
news.impact: Folk hit from 51 and 43 yards out in the close loss. It was a disappointing Falcons debut for the long-time NFL kicker who missed just one of 29 field-goal tries for the Jets in 2025. He will look to bounce back against the Panthers in Week 2.

news.head: Nick Folk signs with Falcons
news.body: The Falcons signed veteran K Nick Folk to a two-year contract.
news.impact: Folk returns for another season as had been reported. He made 28 of his 29 field goal attempts last season for the Jets

news.head: Nick Folk plans to play again next season
news.body: Nick Folk plans to play a 19th NFL season next year.
news.impact: Folk is expected to be one of the top options on the market at age 41. Over the past few seasons, he is the NFL's most accurate kicker (96.3 percent), missing just one field goal each season.

news.head: Nick Folk held without an attempt in Week 18
news.body: Nick Folk did not attempt a field goal or extra point in the Jets 35-8 loss to the Bills.
news.impact: Folk was excellent this season, converting on 28-of-29 field goal attempts and hitting all 22 of his extra point attempts. The 41-year-old is a free agent heading into the 2026 season,.

news.head: Carnell Tate catches four passes in Week 1
news.body: Carnell Tate caught four of his six targets for 38 yards in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
news.impact: Tate tied for the team lead in targets and receiving yards while finishing second in receptions in his NFL debut. The rookie receiver will surely have bigger games going forward, as the entire Tennessee offense struggled in the season opener. Tate will be a low-end WR3 heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Eagles.

news.head: Carnell Tate (stiffness) good to go for Sunday
news.body: Carnell Tate (stiffness) is off of the injury report and good to go for Week 1's matchup against the New York Jets.
news.impact: The rookie is no longer on Tennessee's injury report and is set to make his NFL debut on Sunday. Fantasy managers should pay close attention to his debut game to see if he has the talent and situation of a breakout fantasy player for this season.

news.head: Carnell Tate returns to practice Friday
news.body: Titans rookie WR Carnell Tate returned to practice on Friday.
news.impact: Tate missed practice time earlier this week due to "stiffness." The rookie could see some more reps in Sunday's preseason game against the Seahawks.

news.head: Carnell Tate misses practice due to stiffness
news.body: Carnell Tate did not practice on Wednesday due to stiffness.
news.impact: It doesn't about to be a serious concern. Tate is day-to-day heading into Thursday.

news.head: George Holani sees nine opportunities in win Wednesday
news.body: George Holani rushed the ball eight times for 29 yards and failed to haul in his lone target in Wednesday night's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
news.impact: Holani saw solid involvement on Wednesday, receiving nine total opportunities over the course of the game. He didn't do much with them, but the fact that he had a pretty even split with rookie RB Jadarian Price is a bit concerning for Price's fantasy value moving forward. It's too soon to make any definitive judgements about this offense, however, as they were without their starting quarterback for almost the entire game on Wednesday.

news.head: George Holani tendered by Seahawks
news.body: The Seahawks tendered RB George Holani.
news.impact: Holani got some more snaps in the postseason this past year after Zach Charbonnet tore his ACL. He will remain in a depth role in the Seahawks backfield for at least one more season.

news.head: George Holani (hamstring) activated from IR
news.body: The Seahawks activated RB George Holani from injured reserve.
news.impact: Holani was a full participant in practice. He'll be available for Sunday’s NFC Championship game against the Rams behind Kenneth Walker in the Seahawks backfield.

news.head: George Holani (hamstring) logs full practice Thursday
news.body: George Holani was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Holani logged his second straight full practice. He'll have a chance to be activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's NFC Championship game against the Rams.

news.head: Tyler Shough electrifies late in Week 1 loss to Lions
news.body: Tyler Shough completed 35-of-56 pass attempts for 410 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions while also rushing four times for eight yards in the Saints' 31-30 Week 1 overtime loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.impact: Shough carried the New Orleans offense late in the contest after trailing 21-0 at one point, throwing three second-half touchdowns to force overtime in the Week 1 loss. The second-year signal-caller faces a stiff test in Week 2 against a tough Baltimore Ravens defense next.

news.head: Tyler Shough throws for 259 yards in Week 18
news.body: Tyler Shough completed 23-of-35 passes for 259 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Saints 19-17 loss against the Falcons.
news.impact: Shough added another 34 yards on the ground. The rookie closed the season on a high note with New Orleans. He should remain the starter heading into next season for the Saints.

news.head: Tyler Shough continues to impressive play in Sunday's win
news.body: Tyler Shough completed 22 of 27 passes for 333 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions in Sunday's 34-26 win over the Titans.
news.impact: Shough continues to impress for the Saints. Over the last three weeks, the rookie QB has completed 72.2% of his passes, averaging better than 300 yards with a 4-0 TD/INT ratio. Shough has led the Saints to four straight wins and five in their last seven games. He will try to finish the season strong in Atlanta next week.

news.head: Tyler Shough goes for 308 yards in win over Jets
news.body: Tyler Shough completed 32-of-49 passes for 308 yards with a touchdown in the Saints' 29-6 win over the Jets. He also ran twice for 8 yards.
news.impact: Shough has led the Saints to three straight wins, with four total touchdowns and just one interception in that span. He should be an interesting option against the Titans on next week.

news.head: Malik Nabers hauls in six passes Sunday
news.body: Malik Nabers hauled in 6-of-9 targets for 69 yards in Sunday night's 28-20 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: Sunday night marked Nabers' first game back after being off the field for nearly a year due to a serious knee injury. He looked pretty good in his first game back, totaling 69 yards and leading the team in targets en route to a big win over the Cowboys. Fantasy managers should be optimistic that he will return to full form in the near future, assuming he suffers no further setbacks.

news.head: Malik Nabers (knee) active for Week 1
news.body: Malik Nabers (knee) is officially active for Week 1 for the New York Giants against the Dallas Cowboys according to Mike Garafolo.

news.head: Malik Nabers (knee) game-time decision for Week 1
news.body: Malik Nabers (knee) will be a game-time decision for the Week 1 contest between the New York Giants against the Dallas Cowboys Sunday night according to Adam Schefter.
news.impact: Nabers continues to work back from a severe knee injury suffered during the 2025-26 season and could potentially leave head coach John Harbaugh without his top pass-catching option in a key Week 1 divisional matchup. Fantasy managers will need to have another option ready to plug into lineups whether it be in one of the earlier kickoff windows Sunday or an available option in the Monday night contest between the Kansas City Chiefs and Denver Broncos.

news.head: Malik Nabers (knee) officially questionable Sunday
news.body: Malik Nabers is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Cowboys.
news.impact: The reports all week have suggested Nabers is expected to be good to go for Sunday's season opener. He should be on the favorable side of questionable going into the weekend.

news.head: Malachi Fields catches two passes Sunday
news.body: Malachi Fields caught 2-of-4 targets for 25 yards in Sunday night's 28-20 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: The rookie saw the field a decent amount on Sunday night. He wasn't able to put up big numbers from a fantasy perspective, however, totaling just 25 yards on two catches against the Cowboys. His debut was a solid performance overall but fantasy managers shouldn't have high hopes for him for the foreseeable future.

news.head: Malachi Fields works with trainer on side field Wednesday
news.body: Malachi Fields went to a side field and worked with a trainer early in Wednesday's practice.
news.impact: Fields had a limited workload on Tuesday. The rookie remains day-to-day.

news.head: Malachi Fields selected No. 74 by New York Giants
news.body: The New York Giants have selected WR Malachi Fields with the No. 74 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.
news.impact: Fields will add some size to the Giants wide receiver room standing in at 6'5. He'll have the chance to compete for an immediate role, while also adding depth in the Giants wide receiver room.

news.head: Davante Adams quiet in loss to 49ers
news.body: Davante Adams caught just three of six targets for 26 yards in the Rams' 27-7 loss to the 49ers on Thursday.
news.impact: Adams could just not get much going against the Niners. On the bright side, his six targets were second on the team, so he's still earning opportunities. It just wasn't his day, as was the story for most of the team. He will try to improve next time out.

news.head: Davante Adams expected to be back with Rams next season
news.body: Rams coach Sean McVay said he “absolutely” expects to have Davante Adams back next season.
news.impact: Adams has one more year left on his contract as he comes off a year where he led the league in receiving touchdowns. The Rams are expected to run it back with Adams, Puka Nacua and Matthew Stafford after falling just short of the Super Bowl this year.

news.head: Davante Adams (hamstring) off injury report
news.body: Davante Adams (hamstring) has been removed from the Rams' injury report.
news.impact: Adams has been fully active at Rams' practice this week and will be ready to go for Saturday's playoff matchup with the Panthers. Adams missed the final three weeks of the regular season after hauling in 60 passes, including a league-leading 14 touchdown grabs, over 14 games.

news.head: Davante Adams (hamstring) logs full practice Tuesday
news.body: Davante Adams was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Adams is expected to return in the Wild Card round this weekend. He was estimated as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough.

news.head: Dontayvion Wicks finds end zone in Week 1 win
news.body: Dontayvion Wicks hauled in two of his four targets for 73 yards and one touchdown in the Eagles’ 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
news.impact: Wicks made the most of his modest target share in the season opener, averaging 36.5 yards per reception in the win. The wideout offers head coach Nick Sirianni another explosive pass-catching option moving forward, with a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans up next.

news.head: Dontayvion Wicks on track to be Eagles WR2
news.body: Dontayvion Wicks is trending towards opening the season as the No. 2 wide receiver for the Eagles to open the season.
news.impact: Wicks continues to impress during training camp, while rookie Makai Lemon misses time with a hamstring injury. He was able to show flashes in Green Bay and could see more consistent opportunity with the Eagles. He'll remain a player to monitor for fantasy managers as well as the health of Lemon.

news.head: Dontayvion Wicks not at Eagles OTAs Wednesday
news.body: Dontayvion Wicks was absent Wednesday at Eagles OTAs.
news.impact: Wicks was acquired by the Eagles in a trade this offseason. He will figure to compete for an immediate role in the Eagles wide receiver room.

news.head: Dontayvion Wicks traded to Philadelphia Eagles
news.body: Dontayvion Wicks has been traded to the Philadelphia Eagles for a 2026 fifth round pick and a 2027 sixth. Wicks will sign a $12.5 million extension with the Eagles.
news.impact: $12.5 million is not nothing, and his addition is an interesting transaction given the AJ Brown trade rumors. It doesn’t preclude the Eagles from taking a receiver in the NFL Draft, but his contact seems to signal a decent amount of involvement in the Eagles upcoming plans.

news.head: Broncos D/ST dismal in loss Monday
news.body: The Broncos' D/ST logged two sacks and one interception while allowing 31 points in Monday night's blowout loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.impact: Denver's defense is supposed to be among the best in the entire NFL, but they didn't look the part on Monday night. They allowed Patrick Mahomes II to lead Kansas City to 31 points on the night, despite the fact that this was his first game back from a major injury and was missing one of his starting tackles. This unit should return to elite form at some point this season, but they have a rocky schedule coming up for the next 4-6 weeks and should not be considered an elite fantasy option at the position for that stretch of games.

news.head: Broncos D/ST scores touchdown in Week 18 win
news.body: The Broncos' D/ST logged four sacks, one interception, one fumble recovery, and a touchdown while allowing just three points in Sunday's win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.impact: Denver's defense has been among the best in the league all season long, and they had a suitable performance to end the regular season on Sunday. They logged four sacks and two turnovers against the Chargers, one of which they were able to take to the house for a touchdown. This unit will make life hard for any team they end up playing in the postseason.

news.head: Denver defense dominates on Christmas Day
news.body: The Broncos defense surrendered 13 points on only 139 yards of total offense, registering one sack in Thursday's win over the Chiefs.
news.impact: This Christmas, the Broncos defense was given the gift of a struggling Chiefs offense led by a third-string QB making his first career start. The Denver unit took full advantage, shutting down the Chiefs on the ground and through the air. The Broncos feature a strong defense, but the task will be more difficult against the Chargers in Week 18.

news.head: Broncos D/ST struggles in loss Sunday
news.body: The Broncos' D/ST logged five sacks and allowed 34 points in Sunday's loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.impact: Denver's defense had a bad game on Sunday. Jacksonville put up the most points on them out of any team this season with 34, and the Broncos weren't able to log any big turnovers to help turn the tide of the game. This unit should bounce back and have a good game against the Chiefs on Christmas Day, however.

news.head: Los Angeles Rams D/ST run over by 49ers
news.body: The Los Angeles Rams' D/ST was completely destroyed by the 49ers' offense, and it didn't help that the Rams' offense was equally outmatched, making the final result all the more stark.
news.impact: The Rams still have plenty of star talent on this side of the ball, so don't overreact to one week of football. They should be just fine as the season rolls along once they find their footing.

news.head: Rams D/ST allows 20 points in Week 18 win
news.body: The Rams D/ST allowed 238 passing yards, 79 rushing yards, and 20 points in a 37-20 win over the Cardinals.
news.impact: The Rams' defense tallied one interception, one fumble, and six sacks in the win. The Rams will head on the road to take on the NFC South champion Carolina Panthers in the first round of the playoffs.

news.head: Los Angeles Rams D/ST has huge touchdown in loss
news.body: The Los Angeles Rams D/ST allowed 27 points with no sacks or turnovers in the Rams 27-24 loss to the Falcons. They did however score a touchdown.
news.impact: The special teams unit came up big late in the loss to the Falcons thanks to a blocked field goal turned touchdown, getting the team back on the board and swinging momentum their way. But it wasn’t enough, as the offense still continued to have its struggles despite some success, and the defense struggled to stop Bijan Robinson all night. It’s a tough loss, but they will look to rebound next week and into the NFL playoffs.

news.head: Rams D/ST records four sacks and forces three turnovers Thursday
news.body: Despite dropping a heartbreaking 38-37 overtime loss in Seattle on Thursday night, the Rams D/ST sacked QB Sam Darnold four times and forced three Seahawks' turnovers in the high-scoring contest.
news.impact: Los Angeles picked off Darnold twice and forced a fumble from former teammate, Cooper Kupp, late in the first half. The Rams also registered four sacks and broke up four passes on the night. Next up is a Monday Night matchup in Atlanta against the Falcons.

news.head: Kenyon Sadiq rushes for TD in Week 1
news.body: Kenyon Sadiq caught all three of his targets for 21 yards and added a three-yard rushing touchdown in a 23-10 win over the Titans in Week 2.
news.impact: Sadiq turned in a quiet outing in the passing attack but he scored the Jets' first TD of the season on his three-yard carry in the first quarter. The team's willingness to use the first-round rookie in the running game is an encouraging development for his fantasy value moving forward. Sadiq will be a solid TE2 in Week 2 against the Packers.

news.head: Kenyon Sadiq (groin) without injury designation for Sunday
news.body: Kenyon Sadiq (groin) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
news.impact: The rookie will be available to make his NFL debut on Sunday. He is fully over his groin injury at this point and should have no major limitations in this matchup against the Titans. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him in this matchup, however.

news.head: Kenyon Sadiq (groin) practices in full Wednesday
news.body: Kenyon Sadiq (groin) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.impact: The first-round rookie missed part of the offseason while recovering from a hernia, but he is back now and was able to put up a full practice session on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Week 1 but is unlikely to be a high-impact fantasy player at the start of the season.

news.head: Kenyon Sadiq (hernia) expected to be ready for Week 1
news.body: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn told reporters TE Kenyon Sadiq will be ready for Week 1.
news.impact: This was the expectation when Sadiq first went down with the injury. He likely won't make an immediate impact for fantasy managers after missing most of training camp.

news.head: Brock Bowers (knee) considered day-to-day
news.body: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said Brock Bowers is day-to-day.
news.impact: Bowers did not play in Sunday’s season opener after undergoing a meniscus trim. His status remains uncertain for Week 2.

news.head: Brock Bowers (knee) to miss 'a game or two'
news.body: Brock Bowers underwent a minor meniscus trim operation on Tuesday and is set to be sidelined for 'a game or two' as a result.
news.impact: Bowers reportedly got 'banged up' during training camp last week, and the team made the decision to have him undergo a minor procedure to trim his meniscus. This is especially concerning considering that he missed much of last year due to a nagging knee injury, and the team already expects him to be sidelined for at least a game or two while he recovers from this one. This is an alarming situation that fantasy managers should keep close tabs on, as this injury could linger if there are any setbacks in his recovery. Michael Mayer will step in as the team's top tight end in his absence, with Tre Tucker and Jalen Nailor both also likely to see an increase in opportunities in the star tight end's absence.

news.head: Brock Bowers: Raiders 'concocting multiple ways' to get TE involved
news.body: The Raiders are reportedly "concocting multiple ways" to get Brock Bowers involved in the offense
news.impact: Per Edwards, the Raiders believe Bowers' versatility is his "greatest weapon." He will remain one of the top tight ends in fantasy football alongside Trey McBride.

news.head: Brock Bowers says he 'feels great' in OTAs
news.body: Brock Bowers told reporters he "feels great" being back on the field.
news.impact: Bowers missed time last season with a knee injury he suffered in Week 1. He is entering camp fully healthy as one of the top tight ends in the NFL.

news.head: Puka Nacua goes for 74 yards in loss
news.body: Puka Nacua caught five of nine targets for 74 yards in the Rams' 27-7 loss to the Niners on Thursday.
news.impact: Puka was the only Ram who had more than 26 receiving yards, and most of those yards came on a nice catch and run early on in the game. His final total was respectable, but fantasy managers will hope for more next time he's out on the field.

news.head: Puka Nacua not listed on Rams first injury report
news.body: Puka Nacua is not listed on the Rams initial injury report for Week 1.
news.impact: Puka has been dealing with a psoas injury for a little over a week, but his absence on the injury report is a big indication that barring a setback, he will play on Thursday. The star receiver should be a full go and lock into fantasy lineups.

news.head: Puka Nacua (psoas) expected to play in Week 1
news.body: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is expected to play in Week 1 against the San Francisco 49ers as the team travels to Australia, says head coach Sean McVay.
news.impact: Nacua has been dealing with a psoas injury but returned to practice about a week ago.
