With the opening game in Melbourne, the Rams are being smart with their players given the toll of travel. However, their WR1 should be good to go. Nacua also still faces a potential suspension "under the NFL’s personal conduct policy," says Adkins.

news.head: Puka Nacua (psoas) returns to practice
news.body: Puka Nacua returned to practice Sunday.
news.impact: Nacua had missed practice for much of the past couple of weeks with psoas soreness. The injury appears to be behind him and he is expected to avoid the commissioner’s exempt list, meaning he should be good to go for Week 1.

news.head: Devin Singletary finds end zone in win Sunday
news.body: Devin Singletary rushed the ball six times for 16 yards and caught four passes for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 28-20 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: New York's offense looked great on Sunday night, and Singletary certainly played a role in that. He totaled 38 yards and was able to get into the end zone on one of his four receptions. He was the only RB on the team to receive targets in the passing game, so it looks likely that he will be utilized as their primary receiving back moving forward, which is bad news for the fantasy value of Cam Skattebo.

news.head: Devin Singletary restructures contract with Giants
news.body: The Giants restructured RB Devin Singletary’s contract.
news.impact: Singletary will remain in a reserve role in the Giants backfield. They are also reportedly looking to add another back in free agency or the NFL Draft. Singletary will remain off the fantasy radar.

news.head: Devin Singletary finds the end zone in Week 18
news.body: Devin Singletary rushed for 26 yards and a touchdown on nine carries in Sunday's win over the Cowboys.
news.impact: Singletary hit paydirt for the second straight week and the fifth time over the last seven games Sunday. The veteran ball carrier has shown that he can still be a capable backup with his work this season.

news.head: Devin Singletary finds the end zone Sunday
news.body: Devin Singletary ran for 45 yards and a touchdown on eight carries in the Giants 34-10 win over the Raiders. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 25 yards receiving.
news.impact: It was Tyrone Tracy who dominated the first two drives before he and Tracy split the snaps the rest of the way. He'll be a touchdown dependent RB2/flex play in Week 18 against the Cowboys.

news.head: Brock Purdy dismantles Rams defense in statement win
news.body: Brock Purdy completed 25-of-34 passes for 205 yards, three touchdowns, and a pick in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday. He also ran five times for 29 yards.
news.impact: Purdy was great in this game aside from a couple of hiccups, namely the interception. However, he did what he needed to and got the Niners into scoring position and helped them take advantage of the several short fields they inherited. Purdy should be a solid asset moving forward for fantasy.

news.head: Brock Purdy shut down by Seattle defense Saturday
news.body: Brock Purdy completed 19-of-27 passes for just 127 yards and one interception in the 49ers 13-3 loss to the Seahawks.
news.impact: Purdy was held to a season-low 127 yards and failed to reach 200 yards through the air in a game for just the third time in his nine starts. It was also his only start of the year without throwing a touchdown pass. He carried the ball twice for 21 yards and had San Francisco's longest run of the night (11 yards).

news.head: Brock Purdy accounts for five touchdowns in Week 17 win over Bears
news.body: Brock Purdy completed 24-of-33 pass attempts for 303 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing six times for 28 yards and two touchdowns in the 49ers' 42-38 Week 17 win over the Bears.
news.impact: Purdy continues an impactful stretch behind center, recording two or more touchdowns in each of his last four games (12 passing, three rushing) for the 49ers. The signal-caller remains a dynamic QB1 option despite a difficult Week 18 matchup against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.head: Brock Purdy lights it up on Monday Night Football
news.body: Brock Purdy completed 25 of 34 passes for 295 yards with five touchdowns and one interception, adding 11 yards on two carries in Monday's 48-27 win over the Colts.
news.impact: Purdy set a new career high in TD passes for a single game on Monday, as he has now posted an 8-1 TD/INT ratio over the last two weeks. He has also completed exactly 75% of his passes while throwing for 295 yards in each of those two contests. Purdy missed several games due to injury earlier this season, but he is completely locked in at the right time for the 49ers.

news.head: J.K. Dobbins underwhelming in loss Monday
news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed the ball eight times for 36 yards in Monday night's 31-10 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.impact: Dobbins wasn't able to get much going on Monday night, being left with just 36 scoreless yards in a loss to the Chiefs. The game script was entirely unfavorable to his role, however, with Denver quickly abandoning the run after falling behind early in the game. He should be more involved than this in most games moving forward.

news.head: J.K. Dobbins will maintain Denver's RB1 role in 2026
news.body: Running back J.K. Dobbins will "for sure" be the Denver Broncos' lead back this season, with three players set to have roles in the backfield, according to Zac Stevens of DNVR Sports.
news.impact: Dobbins was very successful in 2025 when he was healthy, averaging 5.0 yards per carry and rushing for 772 yards in 10 games. RJ Harvey and rookie Jonah Coleman will have roles, a regular trait for head coach Sean Payton's offenses. Due to injury risk and a congested backfield, Dobbins has a deflated ADP price as the half-PPR RB34, according to FantasyPros.

news.head: J.K. Dobbins (soft tissue) practices again Wednesday
news.body: J.K. Dobbins practiced for a second straight day on Wednesday.
news.impact: Dobbins is continuing to work his way through a soft tissue injury. It is unclear how much he has been doing in practice.

news.head: J.K. Dobbins (soft tissue) participates in individual drills Tuesday
news.body: J.K. Dobbins went through individual drills at practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Dobbins left practice on Monday with a soft-tissue injury. It appears to have just been precautionary.

news.head: Breece Hall finds the end zone in Week 1 win
news.body: Breece Hall carried the ball 22 times for 102 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for 16 yards in a 23-10 win over the Titans in Week 1.
news.impact: Hall dealt with a groin issue during camp, but he appeared to be at full health in the Week 1 win. The veteran running back handled the majority of the backfield carries, with Braelon Allen mixing in for 10 totes. Hall found the end zone for the first time of the season on a four-yard rush in the third quarter. He will slot in as a solid RB1 in fantasy heading into a Week 2 home matchup against the Packers.

news.head: Breece Hall (groin) off injury report for Sunday
news.body: Breece Hall (groin) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
news.impact: Hall is heading into the weekend entirely free of any injury designation ahead of the team's season opener against the Titans on Sunday. He shouldn't have any substantial limitations to his workload in this matchup, and he projects to be a high-quality fantasy asset in this game and beyond if he can stay healthy.

news.head: Breece Hall (groin) logs full practice Thursday
news.body: Breece Hall (groin) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
news.impact: Hall has been a full participant in two-straight practices to start the week. He told reporters earlier that will be good to go for Week 1, so fantasy managers shouldn't have any real hesitations with starting him ahead of the first game of the season.

news.head: Breece Hall (groin) says he is good to go Week 1
news.body: Breece Hall told reporters he’s good to go and can handle a full workload if necessary.
news.impact: Hall recently missed a couple of weeks with a strained groin. He added he feels fresh from the time off. He'll be an RB2 for fantasy managers heading into the season.

news.head: Jalen Nailor catches three passes in Week 1
news.body: Jalen Nailor caught three of his five targets for 27 yards in the Raiders' 27-13 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 1.
news.impact: Nailor was one of many that saw involvement in the Las Vegas passing offense, finishing as one of six to catch at least one pass in the win. The wideout will look to offer more impactful potential in a revamped Las Vegas offense as the season moves forward, with a Week 2 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.head: Jalen Nailor signs three-year deal with Raiders
news.body: The Raiders agreed to terms with WR Jalen Nailor on a three-year, $35 million contract.
news.impact: Nailor will receive $23 million in guaranteed money. He is looking to step into a bigger role after playing in a limited role in Minnesota. He will be a late-round flier in drafts for now.

news.head: Jalen Nailor expected to have 'robust market' in free agency
news.body: WR Jalen Nailor is expected to have a "robust market" in free agency.
news.impact: Nailor posted a 26/395/4 receiving line last season in Minnesota. His projected market value is $4.7M per year, and he's in line for a multi-year deal. He'll likely seek a WR3 role with another team.

news.head: Jalen Nailor catches three passes in Week 18
news.body: Jalen Nailor caught all three of his targets for 49 yards in Minnesota's 16-3 victory over Green Bay on Sunday.
news.impact: Nailor finished second on the team in receiving on Sunday and his three catches were his first since catching three passes at Dallas on December 14. Despite having gone catch-less in five games this season, Nailor finished with career-highs in receptions (29) and receiving yards (444) in his fourth season in Minnesota.

news.head: DJ Moore goes for 100 yards in win over Houston
news.body: DJ Moore caught 5 of 8 targets for 100 yards and a touchdown in the Bills’ 36-31 win over the Texans.
news.impact: Moore looked good and re-invigorated in this game, showing off some of his old self against a Houston defense that didn’t look like its normal self. His touchdown was a bit fluky, as the defensive back solely made a play on the ball and failed do to so, leaving no one around Moore while he walked in for a score. But, fantasy managers won’t be complaining. Next up for DJ are the Detroit Lions, who just allowed big days for Chris Olave and Devaughn Vele on Sunday.

news.head: DJ Moore avoids serious ankle injury Saturday
news.body: Bills coach Joe Brady said DJ Moore was “good to go” after suffering an ankle injury in Saturday’s preseason game against the Panthers.
news.impact: Moore appeared to have his ankle rolled up on after a catch and run. He hauled in 3-of-4 targets for 61 yards in his first official game with the Bills and Josh Allen.

news.head: DJ Moore will play in preseason opener
news.body: Bills HC Joe Brady said starters will play against the Panthers in the preseason opener.
news.impact: Moore has seemingly had an excellent camp. The WR will now have the opportunity to showcase it against his former team in the preseason alongside Josh Allen and the starters.

news.head: DJ Moore admits to 'growing pains' in Buffalo, confident it will be better
news.body: Bills WR DJ Moore admitted to "growing pains" in Buffalo early on, but he remains confident "it's gonna be perfect later."
news.impact: "I mean, it's gonna be perfect later on, but right now it's still growing pains," Moore said earlier in the week during OTAs. He was traded to Buffalo this offseason after three years in Chicago. He'll remain a player fantasy managers will want to monitor heading into minicamp and training camp.

news.head: Dalton Kincaid has breakout game against Texans
news.body: Dalton Kincaid caught five of six targets for 130 yards in the Bills’ 36-31 win over the Texans on Sunday.
news.impact: Kincaid had arguably his best game as a pro, acheiving a career-high 130 receiving yards in what should have been tough sledding against Houston. He tied with Khalil Shakir for second in targets on the Bills, but vastly outproduced Shakir in yards. His downfield usage was encouraging, and it’s a promising start to his fourth season. Now to see if it keeps up.

news.head: Dalton Kincaid gets fifth-year option picked up
news.body: The Buffalo Bills have exercised the fifth-year option on TE Dalton Kincaid.
news.impact: Kincaid, a former first-round pick, is coming off his most efficient NFL season. The 26-year-old tight end hauled in 39 receptions for 571 receiving yards and 5 touchdowns. His contract is now guaranteed through 2027 as he continues to operate as one of Josh Allen’s top pass-catching options.

news.head: Dalton Kincaid (knee) not expected to require offseason surgery
news.body: Dalton Kincaid said “does not anticipate” undergoing surgery this offseason.
news.impact: It came out after the season that Kincaid played the 2025 season with a torn PCL. As of now, he should be healthy heading into the Bills offseason program.

news.head: Dalton Kincaid believed to have played entire 2025 season with torn PCL
news.body: Dawson Knox said on on Monday Mornings with Mitch that Dalton Kincaid played the entire 2025 season with a torn PCL.
news.impact: It was also confirmed by Bills beat writer Ryan Talbot who noted that “a source close to Kincaid confirmed what Knox said” on the podcast. Kincaid was consistently on the injury report most of the season with a knee injury, but it was never reported to be as bad as a torn PCL. He will likely require surgery this offseason.

news.head: Kyle Monangai reaches 100 yards in Week 1 win
news.body: Kyle Monangai rushed 10 times for 100 yards and one touchdown while also catching both of his targets for 24 yards in a 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers in Week 1.
news.impact: Monangai made the most of limited touches highlighted by a 61-yard rushing touchdown in the win. The second-year running back will look to take advantage of a risky Minnesota Vikings defense in Week 2 for fantasy managers.

news.head: Kyle Monangai (knee) good to go for Week 1
news.body: Kyle Monangai (knee) is good to go for Week 1's game against the Carolina Panthers.
news.impact: Monangai will be good to go for the season opener on Sunday, despite recently dealing with a knee injury of some kind. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant with D'Andre Swift set to get the start and the bulk of the work for the Bears.

news.head: Kyle Monangai (knee) at practice Monday
news.body: Kyle Monangai was at practice on Monday.
news.impact: Monangai was considered week-to-week to end training camp. His presence at practice on Monday gives him a chance to be available for Sunday’s season opener.

news.head: Kyle Monangai (knee) remains week-to-week
news.body: The Bears say Kyle Monangai remains week-to-week.
news.impact: Monangai has been considered week-to-week for the past couple of weeks. It appears he won't be ready to go to begin the season, which should lead to a workhorse role for D'Andre Swift to open the year.

news.head: Tony Pollard held to 35 rushing yards in Week 1
news.body: Tony Pollard carried the ball seven times for 35 yards and lost one yard on his lone catch in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
news.impact: Pollard was quiet with the Titans playing from behind for most of the game. On the bright side, the veteran running back led the backfield with Tyjae Spears getting just three carries. Pollard will look to bounce back as a high-end RB3 in Week 2 against the Eagles.

news.head: Tony Pollard (foot) returns to practice Wednesday
news.body: Tony Pollard returned to practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Pollard missed two practices with a foot issue. He saw four carries in the Titans preseason opener.

news.head: Tony Pollard (foot) not seen practicing Monday
news.body: Tony Pollard did not practice on Monday.
news.impact: Pollard previously also missed practice on Saturday. He saw four carries for 22 yards and a touchdown in the team’s preseason opener.

news.head: Tony Pollard gets 17 touches in loss
news.body: Tony Pollard ran 14 times for 42 yards and caught all three of his targets for 17 yards in the Titans' 41-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.impact: Pollard capped off a tumultuous year in Tennessee with nearly 1,300 scrimmage yards and five touchdowns. He's under contract for one more year, but it's fair to wonder whether they will trade him this offseason as they look to rebuild the roster.

news.head: Hunter Henry hauls in three passes Wednesday
news.body: Hunter Henry caught three passes for 26 yards in Wednesday's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.impact: New England's offense wasn't very effective on Wednesday night, and Henry was no exception to that. He totaled just 26 scoreless yards against the Seahawks, which left him with a poor fantasy total. His value as a streaming option may be diminished this year with Eli Raridon seemingly primed to be more involved at the tight end position for the Patriots.

news.head: Hunter Henry agrees to two year extension with Patriots
news.body: Hunter Henry has agreed to a two year extension with the New England Patriots. He had one year left remaining on his contract, but is now locked in till the end of 2028.
news.impact: It’s great news for Henry managers, but bad news for Eli Raridon truthers. The rookie and promising young tight end could still break out as Henry ages out, but this certainly puts a damper on his prospects in the short term. But getting back to Henry, he should be a solid target later in fantasy drafts this year.

news.head: Hunter Henry (rest) listed as questionable for Super Bowl
news.body: Hunter Henry is listed as questionable for the Super Bowl next Sunday against the Seahawks.
news.impact: Henry closed the week with a full practice on Friday. He should be good to go heading into next week.

news.head: Hunter Henry (rest) limited in practice Thursday
news.body: Hunter Henry was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Henry is continuing to be managed in practice. He'll be a full-go heading into the Super Bowl next week.

news.head: Jonathan Brooks sees five touches in Week 1 loss
news.body: Jonathan Brooks rushed four times for 14 yards while also catching one of his two targets for 48 yards in the Panthers' 59-37 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 1.
news.impact: Brooks made the most of an otherwise underwhelming performance, with a 48-yard reception in the Week 1 loss. The running back will look to offer fantasy managers more impactful touches in a Week 2 divisional matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.head: Jonathon Brooks (groin) not expected to face snap count Sunday
news.body: The Panthers say RB Jonathon Brooks will not face a snap count on Sunday against the Bears.
news.impact: Brooks was able to practice three straight days this week. It remains unclear what the split between him and Chuba Hubbard will look like heading into the season.

news.head: Jonathon Brooks (groin) practicing for third straight day
news.body: Jonathon Brooks (groin) is in practice uniform today. This will mark his third consecutive day of practice.
news.impact: Brooks has steadily improved since suffering the groin injury and looks like he is on his way to playing in Week 1. His workload might be lessened, as the team is looking to keep him healthy for the long term. However, while he might be tough to start, he’s an interesting name to watch on opening week.

news.head: Jonathon Brooks (groin) limited again Thursday
news.body: Jonathon Brooks (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.impact: A groin injury left Brooks sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He said on Wednesday that he plans to play in Week 1, however, so it appears he is still trending towards suiting up against the Bears. The team could limit his workload if he's still managing an injury, though, so he may be a riskier start for the first game of the season.

news.head: Jake Ferguson quiet in loss Sunday
news.body: Jake Ferguson caught just two passes for six yards in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.impact: The veteran tight end didn't make an impact on Sunday night. He was held to just two catches and six total yards against the Giants, which was a symptom of Dallas' offensive struggles against their divisional rivals. Ferguson isn't expected to be fantasy relevant anytime in the foreseeable future.

news.head: Jake Ferguson restructures contract with Cowboys
news.body: The Cowboys restructured TE Jake Ferguson’s contract.
news.impact: Ferguson’s $7.25 million base salary was turned into a signing bonus. The Cowboys now have $33.2 million in salary cap space.

news.head: Jake Ferguson (personal) misses practice Saturday
news.body: Jake Ferguson missed practice on Saturday due to personal reasons.
news.impact: Ferguson was away from the team on Saturday.

news.head: Jake Ferguson catches just one pass Sunday
news.body: Jake Ferguson caught 1 of 2 targets for only five yards in Sunday's loss to the Giants.
news.impact: Ferguson did not do much in limited playing time Sunday, but he did reach 600 yards for the season to go with his 82 grabs and eight touchdowns. Mark down another productive campaign for the four-year pro.

news.head: Cooper Kupp totals 35 yards in win Wednesday
news.body: Cooper Kupp caught 2-of-3 targets for 35 yards in Wednesday night's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
news.impact: Kupp didn't end up with a strong statline in the box score on Wednesday, but he was an important player for the Seahawks in this matchup. He made multiple key plays for them and had a touchdown that got called back due to penalty. He isn't likely to be fantasy relevant moving forward, however, especially if QB Sam Darnold (hip) misses time.

news.head: Cooper Kupp quiet until final drive Saturday
news.body: Cooper Kupp caught two passes for 29 yards during the Seahawks' 13-3 victory over the 49ers on Saturday night to clinch the NFC West and the top seed in the NFC.
news.impact: Kupp was held without a catch until picking up two big catches for the Seahawks on their final drive of the game. Both of Kupp's catches converted third downs and helped Seattle kill more than eight minutes off the clock to essentially seal the win. While Kupp doesn't put up the numbers he used to, his veteran presence has helped a young Seahawks' receiving corps this season. He did finish second on the team in receiving yards with 593 on 47 receptions.

news.head: Cooper Kupp quiet Sunday
news.body: Cooper Kupp caught 1-of-3 passes for six yards in the Seahawks 27-10 win over the Panthers.
news.impact: Kupp had one drop that nearly led to an interception. He remains off the fantasy radar heading into Week 18 against the 49ers.

news.head: Cooper Kupp converts key two-point try in win
news.body: Facing his former team on Thursday night, Cooper Kupp caught three of his four targets for 39 yards in Seattle's narrow 38-37 overtime victory. Although he lost a fumble concluding a 17-yard reception in the first half, he contributed to the win by securing the first of the Seahawks' three successful two-point conversions.
news.impact: Kupp continues to work as the distant second option behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba, as no other Seahawks wide receiver recorded a catch in the contest. While teammate Rashid Shaheed found the end zone, his production came via a punt return and a rushing attempt rather than through the air. Kupp will look to clean up the ball security issues when he faces the Panthers in Week 17.

news.head: Bryce Young records four touchdowns in Week 1 loss to Bears
news.body: Bryce Young completed 23-of-37 pass attempts for 361 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing twice for 10 yards and one touchdown in the Panthers' 59-37 Week 1 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.impact: Young carried the Carolina offense for head coach Dave Canales, spreading the ball to seven different pass-catching options while also recording touchdowns on the ground and through the air in the Week 1 loss. The quarterback will look for another dynamic performance in a Week 2 divisional matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.head: Bryce Young, Panthers starters will not play Friday
news.body: The Panthers starters will not play in Friday’s preseason finale against the Texans.
news.impact: We will see Young and the starters for Carolina back on the field in Week 1 against the Bears.

news.head: Bryce Young expected to see 10-15 snaps in preseason opener Saturday
news.body: Bryce Young will plan 10-15 snaps on Saturday with the starters.
news.impact: Young will likely play two series as a result. He is looking to take another step forward under center for the Panthers this season.

news.head: Bryce Young, starters to play in preseason opener
news.body: Bryce Young and the starters will play in the Panthers preseason opener against the Bills on Saturday.
news.impact: We will get our first look at the Panthers starting offense this season. They likely won't play more than a couple of offensive series give or take.

news.head: Tyler Warren finds end zone in Week 1 loss
news.body: Tyler Warren hauled in three of his five targets for 13 yards and one touchdown in a 41-23 Week 1 loss to the Baltimore Ravens.
news.impact: Warren was mostly bottled up by a stiff Baltimore defense, averaging 4.3 yards per reception in the Week 1 loss. The tight end remains a primary pass-catching offense for head coach Shane Steichen ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.

news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) practices Tuesday
news.body: Tyler Warren was able to practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Warren has been working his way back from a minor groin issue. He should be good to go for Week 1 next week.

news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) not practicing Wednesday
news.body: Tyler Warren did not practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Warren remains likely to miss practice all of this week as he recovers from a groin injury. His status for Week 1 is not in danger yet if he can return to practice by next week.

news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) may miss practice this week
news.body: Tyler Warren (groin) may be sidelined at practice all week.
news.impact: Indianapolis' star tight end is in the process of recovering from a groin injury right now. It's possible that he will be sidelined at practice all week, but he is still expected to be a full go for Week 1, so fantasy managers shouldn't read too much into his status at this point.

news.head: Michael Mayer hauls in six receptions in Week 1 win
news.body: Michael Mayer hauled in six of his seven targets for 32 yards in the Raiders' 27-13 Week 1 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.impact: Mayer took advantage of the absence of No. 1 tight end Brock Bowers, leading the team in targets in the win. The tight end remains a steady option as long as Bowers remains sidelined for fantasy managers, with a Week 2 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers ahead.

news.head: Michael Mayer agrees to a three-year, $45 million deal with Raiders
news.body: Michael Mayer has agreed to a three-year, $45 million deal with the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.impact: Mayer is an all around contributor, making it well worth the investment for the Raiders. For fantasy, it means that he is behind Brock Bowers for the long term, but maybe the Raiders will employ more tight end sets so both can eat, as they are likely the two most talented pass catchers on the team at this point in time. Time will tell what his fantasy value will become.

news.head: Michael Mayer hauls in three passes in Week 18
news.body: Michael Mayer caught 3-of-5 targets for 47 yards in the Raiders 14-12 win over the Chiefs.
news.impact: Mayer led the team in yards and was tied for the team lead in receptions Sunday. Mayer will end the season with 328 receiving yards and one touchdown on 35 receptions.

news.head: Michael Mayer leads Raiders in receiving Sunday
news.body: Michael Mayer caught 9-of-10 targets for 89 yards in the Raiders 34-10 loss against the Giants.
news.impact: With Brock Bowers (knee) sidelined, Mayer took full advantage of the opportunity. He led the Raiders in targets, receptions and receiving yards. He'll remain a TE1 in Week 18 against the Chiefs.

news.head: Tee Higgins totals 59 yards Sunday
news.body: Tee Higgins caught 3-of-6 targets for 59 yards in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
news.impact: It could have been worse. You could have Ja'Marr Chase catching two passes for 12 yards. It wasn't the most inspiring start to the season for Higgins, but he still had a couple of big catches. He'll remain an upside WR2 heading into Week 2 against the Texans.

news.head: Tee Higgins (foot) cleared for Week 1
news.body: Tee Higgins (foot) is cleared to play in Week 1 for the Cincinnati Bengals against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Kelsey Conway.

news.head: Tee Higgins (foot) practices in full again Thursday
news.body: Tee Higgins (foot) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
news.impact: The Bengals will likely have Higgins for their season opener on Sunday, as he has been a full participant at two-straight practices to start the week. Fantasy managers should feel confident starting him if he's fully cleared to play prior to kickoff against the Buccaneers.

news.head: Tee Higgins (foot) fully participates in practice Wednesday
news.body: Tee Higgins (foot) fully participated in Cincinnati's practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Higgins is still listed on Cincinnati's injury report due to a nagging foot injury, but it's not a serious issue at this point and he was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Week 1 and projects to be a good fantasy option against the Buccaneers.

news.head: Pat Bryant leads team in receiving Monday
news.body: Pat Bryant caught 4-of-6 targets for 42 yards in Monday night's 31-10 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.impact: Bryant was one of the few Broncos who had a respectable showing on Monday night. He looked great at the start of the game but tapered off as it went on and as Denver continued to fall further and further behind on the scoreboard. He was the best out of Denver's receivers in this bad matchup, however, so the breakout potential seems to be there for the second-year wideout this season.

news.head: Pat Bryant (concussion) off injury report Sunday
news.body: Pat Bryant is off the injury report for Sunday's AFC Championship game against the Patriots.
news.impact: Bryant closed the week with two straight full practices. He'll be a full-go heading into Sunday.

news.head: Pat Bryant (concussion) limited Wednesday
news.body: Broncos WR Pat Bryant was a limited participant on Wednesday ahead of the AFC Championship.
news.impact: Bryant caught fire early in last week’s Divisional Round, hauling in three receptions in the opening quarter before suffering a concussion. Denver hopes the rookie can clear protocol ahead of Sunday.

news.head: Pat Bryant hauls in four passes Sunday
news.body: Pat Bryant hauled in 4-of-5 targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 19-3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.impact: Bryant was uncertain to play coming into the week due to a concussion that he was dealing with, but he was able to play through it and ended up racking up 31 total yards against the Chargers. He will continue to play a supporting role for Denver's offense as they head into the postseason.

news.head: Tre Tucker catches two passes in Week 1
news.body: Tre Tucker caught two of his four targets for 27 yards in the Raiders' 27-13 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 1.
news.impact: Tucker was one of six to catch at least one pass from Kirk Cousins in the season opener, averaging a team-high 13.5 yards per reception. The wideout remains one of many pass-catching options as part of a revamped Las Vegas offense, with a Week 2 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.head: Tre Tucker catches two passes in Week 18
news.body: Tre Tucker caught 2-of-6 targets for 30 yards in the Raiders 14-12 win over the Chiefs.
news.impact: Tucker led the team in targets, but was unable to do much with them Sunday. The 24-year-old will end the season with 696 yards and five touchdowns on 57 receptions.

news.head: Tre Tucker hauls in five passes Sunday
news.body: Tre Tucker caught 5-of-6 targets for 49 yards in the Raiders 34-10 loss against the Giants.
news.impact: Tucker was a safety blanket throughout the afternoon for Geno Smith. He'll be a WR4 in Week 18 against the Chiefs.

news.head: Tre Tucker catches four passes Sunday
news.body: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-5 targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 23-21 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.impact: Tucker was a solid contributor for the Raiders on Sunday. He caught four passes for 43 yards against the Texans, which wasn't enough to leave him with a good fantasy total in most league formats. He will likely continue to be the team's WR1 for the remainder of the season, though that's unlikely to lead to much success from a fantasy standpoint.

news.head: Jadarian Price totals 58 yards in NFL debut Wednesday
news.body: Jadarian Price rushed the ball ten times for 52 yards and caught two passes for six yards in Wednesday night's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
news.impact: The rookie had a decent performance in his NFL debut. He rushed for 52 yards at an efficient clip of 5.2 yards per carry, and he saw a bit of involvement in the passing game as well. From a fantasy perspective this was a disappointing game, but he showed promise in this game and will likely perform better in positive matchups moving forward.

news.head: Jadarian Price (leg) returns to practice
news.body: Seahawks RB jadarian Price returned to full participation in practice.
news.impact: Price is continuing to be eased back into practice. He remains on track to be good to go for the start of the season. The question remains what his immediate role will be. He should be the lead back, at least on paper. We'll see if he gets any work in the Seahawks second preseason game.

news.head: Jadarian Price (leg) goes through walkthrough Wednesday
news.body: Jadarian Price went through a walkthrough in practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Price makes his return for the first time in five practices. It is a positive sign for the rookie after he has been sidelined the past month.

news.head: Jadarian Price (leg) back in pads at practice Tuesday
news.body: Jadarian Price was back in pads at practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Price winds up missing just a few days of practice due to a leg injury. The rookie continues to earn his reps with the first-team during training camp.

news.head: Kyler Murray (concussion) status for Week 2 uncertain
news.body: The Vikings reportedly do not know if Kyler Murray will progress through concussion protocol in time to play in Week 2’s game against the Bears.
news.impact: Murray took an ugly hit in Sunday's game against the Packers. He will have to clear concussion protocol to be able to return for Week 2. Carson Wentz is seemingly likely to see the start for Minnesota as of now.

news.head: Kyler Murray (concussion) ruled out Sunday
news.body: Kyler Murray (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Week 1 for the Minnesota Vikings against the Green Bay Packers according to Adam Schefter.
news.impact: Murray suffered the apparent concussion in the first quarter after being hit by Green Bay safety Jevon Bullard, with backup Carson Wentz taking over behind center for head coach Kevin O’Connell.

news.head: Kyler Murray (concussion) questionable to return
news.body: Kyler Murray (concussion) is questionable to return for the Minnesota Vikings Sunday.
news.impact: Murray exited after being hit by Jevon Bullard in the first quarter of the Week 1 contest, completing 3-of-5 pass attempts for 18 yards and one interception while also rushing twice for nine yards before being replaced by backup Carson Wentz behind center.

news.head: Kyler Murray headed to locker room Sunday
news.body: Kyler Murray is headed to the locker room for the Minnesota Vikings according to Adam Schefter.
news.impact: Murray exited after suffering an apparent concussion, with veteran Carson Wentz replacing him behind center against the Packers.

news.head: Christian McCaffrey racks up 88 scrimmage yards in win
news.body: Christian McCaffrey ran 10 times for 68 yards and caught five of eight targets for 20 yards in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday.
news.impact: McCaffrey surprisingly had a split backfield with Kaelon Black, at least much more than expected. The veteran tied Black in touches, 15 to 15, but had the edge in opportunities, 18 to 15, thanks to receiving. It will be interesting to see if this is a Week 1 fluke or a recurring theme, as Black was involved throughout the game, not just when the game was well in hand. Still, CMC is a top-tier asset, and while today was fine, bigger days are ahead.

news.head: Christian McCaffrey would have practiced if it wasn't joint practice
news.body: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said RB Christian McCaffrey would have practiced on Tuesday if it wasn't a joint practice.
news.impact: Shanahan refuted the idea that McCaffrey isn't practicing because of a contract-related issue. McCaffrey remains day-to-day.

news.head: Christian McCaffrey remains absent from practice Sunday
news.body: Christian McCaffrey is still not practicing on Sunday.
news.impact: McCaffrey has been absent from practice this week due to tightness. It remains unclear how serious of an injury he is dealing with. His status will need to continue to be monitored in practice this week.

news.head: Christian McCaffrey still not practicing Tuesday due to tightness
news.body: Christian McCaffrey remains absent from practice on Tuesday due to tightness.
news.impact: It appears to be precautionary for McCaffrey. He remains day-to-day.

news.head: James Cook III goes for 69 yards in big win over Texans
news.body: James Cook III ran 13 times for 57 yards and caught three of four targets for 12 yards in the Bills’ 36-31 win over the Texans on Sunday.
news.impact: Cook was fine on his touches and was saved by his three receptions in PPR formats, but it fantasy managers will be hoping for more. He’s still a premium running back, and he will get his chance early this week as the Bills play the Lions on Thursday night.

news.head: James Cook will play in preseason opener
news.body: James Cook III and all Bills starters are set to play Saturday, per HC Joe Brady.
news.impact: Cook is reportedly expected to have a larger role as a pass catcher in 2026. Saturday's preseason opener against the Panthers could offer a preview of the Bills' plans for their RB1.

news.head: James Cook III nets two carries in Week 18 win
news.body: James Cook III rushed for 15 yards on two carries in the Bills 35-8 win over the Jets.
news.impact: Cook and the majority of the Bills' starters on offense were used sparingly in the win over the Jets. Cook turned in an excellent season, finishing with 1,621 rushing yards and 12 touchdowns on 309 carries this season. He will remain a highly sought after pick in fantasy drafts in 2026.

news.head: James Cook held in check by Eagles defense
news.body: James Cook rushed 20 times for 74 yards and caught one of his four targets for three yards during Sunday's 13-12 loss to Philadelphia. While the running back reached the 20-carry plateau for the sixth time this season, he was held under 100 rushing yards and averaged less than 4.0 yards per carry for just the fourth time in 2025.
news.impact: Despite the quiet outing, Cook has compiled an impressive season line of 307 carries for 1,606 yards and 12 touchdowns. He will look to finish the regular season strong in a favorable matchup against the Jets in Week 18.

news.head: Adonai Mitchell goes for 60 yards in Week 1
news.body: Adonai Mitchell caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in a 23-10 win over the Titans in Week 1.
news.impact: Mitchell finished second on the Jets in receiving yards, operating as the team's deep threat. He did most of his damage on a 40-yard pass from Geno Smith. While Mitchell will remain behind Garrett Wilson in the target pecking order, he has some boom/bust potential in a Jets offense that looked much improved from last year. Mitchell settles in as a flex option in Week 2 against Green Bay.

news.head: Adonai Mitchell held without a catch in Week 18
news.body: Adonai Mitchell did not record a reception on three targets in the Jets 35-8 loss to the Bills.
news.impact: Mitchell appeared in seven games with the Jets since being acquired in the trade that sent Sauce Gardner to the Colts. This was the first time the 23-year-old was held without a reception since the trade. Mitchell should factor into the Jets' offensive plans for 2026 and should benefit from the return of Garrett Wilson.

news.head: Adonai Mitchell hauls in three passes in Week 17
news.body: Adonai Mitchell caught 3-of-9 targets for 22 yards in the Jets 42-10 loss to the Patriots.
news.impact: Mitchell led the team in targets, seeing four more than the next option in the passing game. The 23-year-old has registered nine or more targets in three of his last six games as he clearly has worked himself into a prominent role in the Jets' offense. The Jets will take on Buffalo in Week 18.

news.head: Adonai Mitchell catches three passes in Week 16 loss to Patriots
news.body: Adonai Mitchell hauled in three of his six targets for 43 yards in the Jets' 29-6 Week 16 loss to the Saints.
news.impact: Mitchell has struggled despite increased involvement in the New York offense, finishing with less than 60 receiving yards despite six or more targets in five of his last six games. The wideout remains a risky pass-catching option in all formats ahead of a Week 17 contest against the New England Patriots.

news.head: Tyler Loop racks up 11 points in Week 1 win
news.body: Tyler Loop converted both of his field goal attempts as well as all five of his extra point attempts to finish with 11 points in a 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.impact: Loop capitalized on every opportunity for head coach Jesse Minter, finishing with a perfect stat line in the Week 1 win. The kicker will look to take advantage of another favorable matchup in Week 2 against the New Orleans Saints.

news.head: Tyler Loop misses potential game-winning FG in Week 18
news.body: Tyler Loop made one of his two field goals and all three of his extra points in a 26-24 loss to the Steelers in Week 18.
news.impact: Loop hit a 40-yard field goal but he missed a potential game-winning 44-yard attempt with two seconds left in the fourth quarter. It was a costly miss as the Ravens' loss gave the Steelers the AFC North title and caused Baltimore to miss the playoffs. Overall, it was a strong rookie season for Loop, who hit 30 of his 34 attempts and missed just two of his 46 extra points.

news.head: Tyler Loop busy in win over Green Bay
news.body: Tyler Loop made all five of his PATs and both of his FG attempts in the Ravens' 41-24 win over the Packers.
news.impact: Loop had 11 kicking points in this game, as many as he had in his previous two games combined. He should be a decent play next week for fantasy for those who need him.

news.head: Tyler Loop misses kick in loss Sunday
news.body: Tyler Loop went 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts and 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the New England Patriots.
news.impact: Loop left three points out on the field by missing one of his two field-goal attempts against the Patriots. They ended up losing the game by four points, however, so his miss isn't what secured the loss for them. He doesn't project to be a good fantasy option at the position moving forward.

news.head: Chiefs D/ST stellar in win Monday
news.body: The Chiefs' D/ST logged four sacks and one interception while allowing just ten points in Monday night's win over the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Kansas City was able to pick up a great win over their divisional rivals on Monday night. The performance of their defense had a lot to do with that, as they held Bo Nix and Co. to just ten points on the night and made numerous big plays to help out their offense. This is one of the league's best units at this point, and they will enjoy one of the league's easiest schedules over the next three weeks. They should be a waiver target in any league they are not currently rostered in.

news.head: Chiefs D/ST allows 14 points in Week 18
news.body: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 105 passing yards, 118 rushing yards, and 14 points in the 14-12 loss to the Raiders.
news.impact: The Chiefs' defense tallied three sacks, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the win. Despite a strong effort from the defense, the offense was unable to get enough points on the board to end the 2025 season with a win.

news.head: Chiefs defense fares well in close loss Thursday night
news.body: The Chiefs defense allowed 20 points on 303 yards of total offense, recording one sack and forcing one turnover in Thursday's loss to the Broncos.
news.impact: The Chiefs defense kept the contest close on Christmas night, but the KC offense ultimately could not do enough to pull off an upset. The unit has an attractive matchup waiting for the season finale in Las Vegas.

news.head: Chiefs D/ST struggles against run Sunday
news.body: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 26 points on 376 total yards with two sacks on Sunday against the Titans.
news.impact: Kansas City's offense didn't do its defense any favors. The defense did not force a turnover all day against Cam Ward and the Titans. They'll be off the fantasy radar next week against the Broncos.

news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) expected to undergo surgery, miss one month
news.body: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane is expected to undergo surgery in the coming days.
news.impact: Lane could undergo surgery as early as Wednesday. They are hopeful he'll only miss about one month.

news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) out for several weeks with broken wrist
news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) will miss the next several weeks with a broken wrist he suffered in the Ravens win against the Colts.
news.impact: Lane was seeing some promising usage before exiting with his injury, having a touchdown nullified by holding, another endzone target just out of his reach, and an 11-yard gain on his one reception. The Ravens are now short on receivers unless Zay Flowers, who also exited with an injury, can come back for next week's game. In his absence, expect more work for Rashod Bateman, Chris Moore, and potentially fellow rookie Elijah Sarratt.

news.head: Ja’Kobi Lane (wrist) ruled out Sunday
news.body: Ja’Kobi Lane (wrist) has been ruled out for the Baltimore Ravens against the Indianapolis Colts according to Ian Rapoport.
news.impact: Lane joins fellow wideout Zay Flowers (hamstring) on the sidelines for new head coach Jesse Minter, catching one of his three targets for 11 receiving yards prior to exiting. Rashod Bateman should command even more targets in the second half from quarterback Lamar Jackson in Week 1.

news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane expected to command immediate red zone role for Ravens
news.body: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said the team expects to "take advantage" of Ja'Kobi Lane's abilities in the red zone.
news.impact: Lane had the largest hands (10½ inches) and second-largest wingspan (80¾ inches) at the combine. "When you watch Ja'Kobi in the red zone make catches, that's a vision that our coaches were like, 'Man, we could really take advantage of that,'" Minter said. "So, I think you're always looking for the best players. Oftentimes, I do think size is a requisite to be a really good player." Baltimore hasn't had many true red zone threats for Lamar Jackson to utilize.

news.head: Saquon Barkley leads backfield attack in Week 1 win over Commanders
news.body: Saquon Barkley carried the ball 15 times for 83 yards while also catching one of his two targets for a loss of three yards in the Eagles’ 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
news.impact: Barkley made the most of what the Washington defense gave him, averaging 5.5 yards per carry in the win. The running back will look to offer fantasy managers a dynamic RB1 option in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

news.head: Saquon Barkley likely to rest in season finale
news.body: The Eagles may sit RB Saquon Barkley in Week 18 against the Commanders.
news.impact: Philadelphia is expected to rest its starters in Week 18, potentially including Barkley. The 28-year-old has rushed for 1,140 yards and scored nine total touchdowns this season, nearly half of what he managed last year, making it tough to project his ranking heading into 2026.

news.head: Saquon Barkley held to 68 yards in win over Bills
news.body: Saquon Barkley was limited to 68 yards on 19 carries during Sunday's 13-12 win over Buffalo, averaging just 3.6 yards per attempt against a stout defense. The running back saw his three-game scoring streak come to an end and failed to draw a target in the passing game for the first time this season.
news.impact: Despite the modest output, Barkley continued to dominate the backfield usage, handling 19 of Philadelphia's 23 rushing attempts. He carries a season line of 280 carries for 1,140 yards and seven touchdowns into the Week 18 regular-season finale against the Commanders.

news.head: Saquon Barkley goes for 132 yards in win
news.body: Saquon Barkley ran 21 times for 132 yards and a touchdown in the Eagles' 29-18 win over the Commanders. He failed to corral either of his two targets.
news.impact: Barkley now has a touchdown in three straight games and 100+ rushing yards in two of his last three. This is the Saquon Barkley we thought we would be getting when drafting him, and though it's taken a while, he's showing up at just the right time.

news.head: Titans D/ST struggles against Jets in Week 1
news.body: The Titans D/ST allowed 23 points while failing to record a sack or a turnover in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
news.impact: The Titans were unable to offer much resistance on defense in the lopsided loss. Things won't get any easier as they draw a tough Week 2 matchup against the Eagles. They will not be a recommended fantasy option for that contest.

news.head: Tennessee Titans D/ST gets run over by Jaguars
news.body: The Tennessee Titans D/ST got run over by the Jaguars on Sunday in their 41-7 loss. They did manage to get at least two sacks.
news.impact: The Titans were once again unusable for fantasy, a lack of talent putting them behind the 8-ball. They will look to improve this offseason by adding talent via free agency and the draft.

news.head: Titans defense struggles to slow Saints down
news.body: The Titans defense surrendered 423 yards of total offense, coming up with two sacks and one fumble recovery in Sunday's 34-26 loss to the Saints.
news.impact: The Saints got one touchdown on defense in Week 17, but the rest of their scoring came against the Titans defense. Rookie QB Tyler Shough had his way with the Tennessee unit, throwing for more than 330 yards and a couple of scores. The Titans have now given up at least 25 points in six straight games, and they will face the high-powered Jaguars in Week 18.

news.head: Titans D/ST records four sacks Sunday
news.body: The Titans D/ST allowed nine points on 133 total yards with four sacks on Sunday against the Chiefs.
news.impact: Kansas City was already without Patrick Mahomes, and also went on lose Gardner Minshew early. That led to the inexperienced Chris Oladokun starting most of the game, who took four sacks. The Titans face the Saints next week.

news.head: Kyren Williams punches in score in loss to Niners
news.body: Kyren Williams ran 11 times for 41 yards and the Rams' only touchdown. He also caught all three of his targets for 24 receiving yards.
news.impact: Williams' day was saved by the touchdown; otherwise it was fairly miserable. Blake Corum showed out in his opportunities, but he was limited to ground work only. Kyren appears to be in a committee now, but he at least has the edge in passing situations, giving him more appeal.

news.head: Kyren Williams sees 15 touches in Week 18 win
news.body: Kyren Williams rushed for 60 yards on 12 carries in the Rams 37-20 win over the Cardinals. He caught 3-of-5 targets for 21 yards.
news.impact: Williams and Blake Corum continued to split time in the backfield to close out the regular season. Both running backs have been effective in that role this season, so the Rams will likely continue that throughout their playoff run.

news.head: Kyren Williams (ankle) officially active for Week 18
news.body: Rams RB Kyren Williams (ankle) is officially active for Week 18.
news.impact: Williams was limited in practice this week, but is healthy enough to suit up against the Cardinals. Despite having a playoff spot locked up, the Rams are playing their starters in the final regular season game.

news.head: Kyren Williams (ankle) listed questionable for Week 18
news.body: Kyren Williams is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.impact: Williams was limited in practice throughout the week. Rams coach Sean McVay has said starters will play regardless of the Seahawks/49ers result on Saturday.

news.head: Blake Corum totals 54 yards in loss
news.body: Blake Corum ran 10 times for 54 yards in the Rams' 27-7 loss to the 49ers on Thursday.
news.impact: Corum was solid on the ground at 5.4 a carry, but that was about all he had going for him. Without a touchdown or receiving work to go along with his yardage, it was a disappointing fantasy performance. However, his usage is encouraging; the Rams at least trust him enough that they will split Kyren Williams' workload with Corum. It makes him a top-tier handcuff RB, and one that should be rostered in case anything happens to Kyren.

news.head: Blake Corum sees 14 touches in Week 18 win
news.body: Blake Corum rushed for 59 yards on 13 carries and caught his lone target for 10 yards in the Rams 37-20 win over the Cardinals.
news.impact: Corum and Kyren Williams continue to split time in the backfield for the Rams. With the Rams success this season in getting both running backs involved, it should be expected that the rotation continues throughout the team's playoff run.

news.head: Blake Corum (ankle) officially active for Week 18
news.body: Blake Corum (ankle) is officially active for Week 18.
news.impact: Corum exited Monday's game with an ankle injury and was considered questionable to play against Arizona. Corum will continue to work in a rotation with Kyren Williams in the final game of the regular season.

news.head: Blake Corum (ankle) listed questionable for Week 18
news.body: Blake Corum is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.impact: Corum had missed two straight practices to begin the week after leaving last Monday's game early. It would be a surprise if he plays on Sunday unless he is fully healthy.

news.head: Wan'Dale Robninson goes for 38 yards in Week 1
news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught five of his six targets for 38 yards in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
news.impact: Robinson tied for the team lead in targets and receiving yards while leading the way with his five catches. The entire Tennessee offense struggled to move the ball in Week 1, which cut into Robinson's final stats. He will look to bounce back as a decent flex option in PPR leagues heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Eagles.

news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson (head) off injury report for Week 1
news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson (head) is off of the injury report ahead of Week 1's matchup against the New York Jets.
news.impact: As expected, Robinson's head injury is no longer an issue and he carries no injury designation heading into Week 1. He should be a full go against the Jets and projects to be a worthwhile streaming option in PPR formats.

news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson expected to play on outside and in slot with Titans
news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson told reporters he expects to play on the outside as well as in the slot with the Titans.
news.impact: Robinson branched out from being a slot-only wide receiver last season. It resulted in him reaching 1,000 yards for the first time in his career. He should step in as the top target for Cam Ward and the Titans.

news.head: Wan’Dale Robinson agrees to deal with Titans
news.body: Wan’Dale Robinson has agreed four year, $78 million deal with the Tennessee Titans.
news.impact: Robinson was long rumored to go to the Titans, and those rumors have come true. He will rejoin former Giants HC Brian Daboll in Tennessee and operate as a primary target for Cam Ward in 2026. It’s wheels up for Wan’Dale, who has 140 targets and at least 92 receptions each of the past two years.

news.head: T.J. Hockenson hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.body: T.J. Hockenson caught 4-of-5 targets for 36 yards in the Vikings 39-22 win over the Packers.
news.impact: Hockenson caught one of the three touchdowns thrown by Carson Wentz. He could be on the TE1 radar in a favorable matchup next week against the Bears.

news.head: T.J. Hockenson restructures contract with Vikings
news.body: The Vikings restructured the contract of TE T.J. Hockenson.
news.impact: Hockenson is coming off one of the worst seasons of his career. He'll now be two years removed from a knee injury he suffered in 2024. The move saves $5 million against the cap for the Vikings.

news.head: T.J. Hockenson (shoulder) ruled out for Week 18
news.body: T.J. Hockenson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers.
news.impact: The season is officially over for Hockenson. He had a down year this season when he was healthy compared to his standards. It is unclear what his future looks like in Minnesota.

news.head: T.J. Hockenson (shoulder) misses practice Thursday
news.body: T.J. Hockenson did not practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Hockenson appears likely to remain sidelined in Sunday's season finale.

news.head: Jerry Jeudy catches two passes in loss
news.body: Jerry Jeudy caught two of four targets for 26 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.impact: Jeudy's four targets tied him with Denzel Boston for second on the team behind KC Concepcion, but he didn't have much to show for it. Cleveland struggled to move the ball all day, leading to many short drives and little opportunity for the offensive players to get any momentum. Hopefully, things will turn more in a positive direction next week against the Bucs.

news.head: Jerry Jeudy (hamstring) sits out of team drills Thursday
news.body: Jerry Jeudy did not participate in team drills on Thursday after tweaking his hamstring.
news.impact: Jeudy won't be rushed back off a hamstring injury. He should continue to be eased back heading into training camp.

news.head: Jerry Jeudy snags two passes in win
news.body: Jerry Jeudy caught two of six targets for 17 yards in the Browns' 20-18 win over the Bengals on Sunday.
news.impact: Jeudy had a severe lack of effort in this game. Despite coming up with a grab late in the Browns game when it was needed, even then, it was bobbled. He also had a lack of effort in play early on, failing to attempt to go up for a ball in what could have been a Bengals INT. He's tanked his fantasy and real-life stock this season given his attitude, making him a tough sell.

news.head: Jerry Jeudy hauls in five passes in Week 17 win
news.body: Jerry Jeudy caught 5-of-7 targets for 54 yards in the Browns 13-6 win over the Steelers.
news.impact: Jeudy led the team in receptions, yards, and targets in the win Sunday. His seven targets are the most he has seen in a game since Week 11 against the Ravens. Jeudy and the Browns will end the season with a Week 18 matchup with the Bengals.

news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) placed on IR
news.body: The Saints placed Jordyn Tyson on injured reserve.
news.impact: Tyson is expected to miss roughly two months with a hamstring injury. He has been dealing with hamstring issues since college at Arizona State.

news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) out for two months with hamstring injury
news.body: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is out for the next two months with a hamstring injury he suffered in training camp.
news.impact: It’s a tough blow to the Saints, who were hopeful to have their full complement of weapons to start the year. The timeline puts Tyson returning near the middle of October, and expect a ramp-up period for him once he returns. For those who haven’t drafted yet, expect his ADP to fall dramatically as he will be unusable foe the first several weeks of the season, if not longer.

news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) still being evaluated
news.body: Saints coach Kellen Moore said the hamstring injury Jordyn Tyson is dealing with is still being evaluated.
news.impact: It is not ideal for the rookie as he remains without a clear timetable to return. There should be a further update on Tyson at some point in the next week.

news.head: Jordyn Tyson dealing with right hamstring injury
news.body: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Jordyn Tyson is dealing with a right hamstring injury.
news.impact: Tyson left practice early on Thursday with the injury. It is believed to be a different hamstring injury than what the rookie was previously dealing with. Moore said the possibility of Tyson missing Week 1 can’t be ruled out. Not a good sign for the rookie right now.

news.head: Dalton Schultz hauls in four passes
news.body: Dalton Schultz secured 4-of-8 targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills.
news.impact: Schultz caught a career-high 82 passes last season, and he remains a steady presence in the Texans' offense. The veteran tight end finished second on the team with eight targets, trailing only Nico Collins' 10. Schultz has a limited ceiling, but he's almost always on the TE streaming radar.

news.head: Dalton Schultz signs one-year extension with Texans
news.body: The Texans and TE Dalton Schultz have agreed to terms on a one-year extension worth $12.6 million.
news.impact: Schultz will now earn $17.6 million guaranteed combining the 2026 and 2027 seasons. He was a safety blanket for CJ Stroud for much of last season and that will likely remain the case again this upcoming year.

news.head: Dalton Schultz (calf) ruled out for rest of game Sunday
news.body: Dalton Schultz has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's Divisional Round game against the Patriots.
news.impact: It is a tough break for a Texans offense already missing Nico Collins. Christian Kirk and Jayden Higgins will be among the players to step into bigger roles in the passing game for Houston.

news.head: Dalton Schultz (calf) questionable to return Sunday
news.body: Dalton Schultz is questionable to return to Sunday's Divisional Round game against the Patriots with a calf injury.
news.impact: Schultz was seen walking back to the locker room. It is a tough break for a Texans offense already without Nico Collins.

news.head: Malik Washington catches three passes in Week 1 loss
news.body: Malik Washington caught three of his eight targets for 53 yards in the Dolphins' 27-13 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 1.
news.impact: Washington made a modest impact despite leading the team in targets, finishing third on the team in receptions in the loss. The wideout remains another high-risk pass-catching option as part of a Miami offense searching to establish their identity as the season continues, with a Week 2 contest against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

news.head: Malik Washington scores touchdown in loss
news.body: Malik Washington caught three of four targets for six yards and a touchdown while also running twice for 22 yards in the Dolphins’ 38-10 loss to New England on Sunday.
news.impact: Washington failed to get much going as the de facto top target in the Miami offense. He’s did at least score a touchdown, but six yards on three receptions leaves a lot to be desired. He’s a depth option in deep dynasty leagues at best at this point, having failed to take advantage of his opportunities in 2025.

news.head: Malik Washington quiet despite Waddle injury
news.body: Malik Washington was limited to just one reception for four yards on three targets during Sunday's win over the Buccaneers. The wide receiver also added a single carry for one yard but failed to see increased involvement in the passing attack even as Jaylen Waddle missed time with a rib injury.
news.impact: Washington's most notable contribution came on special teams, where he delivered a 47-yard kick return late in the third quarter. He will look to build better chemistry with quarterback Quinn Ewers in the Week 18 regular-season finale against the Patriots.

news.head: Malik Washington finds end zone Sunday
news.body: Malik Washington caught one pass for 23 yards and rushed the ball one time for nine yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.impact: Washington saw just a couple of touches on Sunday, but he was able to make the most out of them and still finished the 32 total yards and a touchdown. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him for the remainder of the season, however.

news.head: Tre' Harris finishes with three receptions in Week 1
news.body: Tre' Harris caught 3-of-6 targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.impact: Harris was at least significantly involved in the passing game Sunday, as the second-year wideout tied a career high in targets set in Week 18 of last season. Harris did not do much with those targets, however, totaling only 20 yards with a long of 11. The second-round pick from 2025 is a fringe redraft option at present.

news.head: Tre Harris inefficient in loss Sunday
news.body: Tre Harris caught 2-of-6 targets for 28 yards in Sunday's 19-3 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Harris saw plenty of opportunities on Sunday with six targets, but he wasn't able to take advantage of them and ended up with just two catches for 28 yards. He has had a disappointing rookie campaign and will likely remain a non-factor for the Chargers heading into the postseason.

news.head: Tre Harris quiet in loss to Houston
news.body: Tre Harris caught his only target for eight yards in the Chargers' 20-16 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.impact: After back-to-back weeks of at least 49 receiving yards, Harris went back to being the WR4 of the offense and came up with a single reception. In fact, of all the Chargers receivers, only Quentin Johnston had more than a single catch. Harris is off the board for fantasy for now, but is a worthwhile stash in dynasty.

news.head: Tre Harris totals 54 yards Sunday
news.body: Tre Harris caught 4-of-5 targets for 54 yards in the Chargers 34-17 win over the Cowboys.
news.impact: Harris has continued to show flashes throughout his rookie season. He'll be a player to monitor in drafts heading into next year.

news.head: AJ Barner catches two passes Wednesday
news.body: AJ Barner caught two passes for 13 yards in Wednesday's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
news.impact: The Seahawks were able to pick up a win over the Patriots on Wednesday, but they didn't need to get Barner very involved in order to do so. He finished the game with just two catches for 13 yards, and there's not much reason to believe that he will bounce back and become a quality week-to-week option anytime soon.

news.head: AJ Barner (oblique) off injury report Wednesday
news.body: AJ Barner is off the injury report for Wednesday’s game against the Patriots.
news.impact: Barner practiced all week in full. He'll be a TE2 for fantasy managers going into the season.

news.head: AJ Barner (oblique) logs full practice Monday
news.body: AJ Barner was a full participant in practice on Monday.
news.impact: Barner remains on track to be a full-go for Wednesday’s season opener against the Patriots.

news.head: AJ Barner (oblique) practices in full Sunday
news.body: AJ Barner was a full participant in practice on Sunday.
news.impact: Barner missed some time early in the offseason program, but he avoided the PUP list during training camp. He heads into the season as a TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.head: Cade Otton quiet Sunday
news.body: Cade Otton caught 3-for-5 targets for 26 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
news.impact: Otton was third on the team in targets, but he was unable to turn it into much production. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.head: Cade Otton re-signs with Bucs
news.body: The Bucs are re-signing TE Cade Otton.
news.impact: Otton was set to hit free agency, but he will be remaining with Tampa Bay and Baker Mayfield as a safety blanket. He should remain on the TE1/TE2 radar for fantasy managers.

news.head: Cade Otton dominates in Week 18
news.body: Cade Otton caught 7-of-9 targets for 94 yards and a touchdown in the Bucs 16-7 win over the Panthers.
news.impact: Hauling in a touchdown on the opening drive of the game, Otton dominated in the passing game for Tampa Bay. He was the only player to surpass even 35 receiving yards on the day for the Bucs. He is set to enter free agency this offseason.

news.head: Cade Otton hauls in four catches in loss
news.body: Cade Otton caught all four of his targets for 33 yards during Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Dolphins. While this marked his highest yardage output since Week 10, the tight end has yet to find the end zone this season and continues to see limited volume with the receiving corps at full health.
news.impact: Otton will look to improve upon his numbers when the Buccaneers face the Panthers in the Week 18 regular-season finale.

news.head: Dylan Sampson (knee) placed on IR
news.body: The Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve.
news.impact: Sampson went down on Sunday with a knee injury. He will miss at least the next four weeks.

news.head: Dylan Sampson (knee) being evaluated
news.body: Browns head coach Todd Monken said the team is still evaluating the severity of RB Dylan Sampson’s knee injury.
news.impact: Sampson did not play in the second half on Sunday. The team is expected to know more on Wednesday.

news.head: Dylan Sampson works with first-team in start of offseason program
news.body: Dylan Sampson was the lead back at the start of the Browns offseason program.
news.impact: Quinshon Judkins was present, but he is still rehabbing his leg injury. Sampson is expected to be the primary backup when Judkins is healthy.

news.head: Dylan Sampson leads backfield in win
news.body: Dylan Sampson ran 10 times for 32 yards and caught two of three targets for 12 yards in the Browns' 20-18 win over the Bengals on Sunday.
news.impact: Sampson led the backfield on Sunday, though not much came of it. Unless Quinshon Judkins suffers a setback in his injury recovery, Sampson will likely open up the 2026 NFL season as the backup running back in Cleveland. If nothing else, he could fill the Jerome Ford role and be useful for fantasy as a pass catcher.

news.head: Jonah Coleman without attempt in NFL debut Monday
news.body: Jonah Coleman did not see a single opportunity in Monday night's 31-10 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.impact: There has been a lot of hype about the potential of the rookie over the course of the offseason, but he didn't see even a single opportunity in the three snaps he played in his NFL debut on Monday night. He will likely see involvement in more favorable matchups moving forward, but this start is very discouraging and indicates that he is squarely behind both J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey in the pecking order at this point.

news.head: Jonah Coleman could earn immediate role in Broncos backfield
news.body: The belief in Broncos camp is Jonah Coleman could earn an immediate role.
news.impact: Coleman would most likely hold a short-yardage and/or goal line role if he is to play right away. This could end up being a three-man committee with J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey.

news.head: Jonah Coleman signs rookie deal with Broncos
news.body: The Broncos signed RB Jonah Coleman to a four-year contract.
news.impact: Coleman is likely to open the season as the RB3 in the Broncos backfield behind RJ Harvey and JK Dobbins, though he could hold an immediate short-yardage role. He'll remain a rookie to monitor heading into OTAs and training camp.

news.head: Jonah Coleman could hold immediate short-yardage role
news.body: The Athletic’s Nick Kosmider believes there will be an “immediate role” for Jonah Coleman as the Broncos’ short-yardage running back.
news.impact: Coleman was a fourth-round pick of Denver this past weekend. He was strong on short-yardage downs during his collegiate career at Washington and Arizona. He'll be a stash in redraft next season and an intriguing long-term selection for those in dynasty leagues.

news.head: Alvin Kamara (knee) inactive for Week 1
news.body: Alvin Kamara (knee) is inactive for Week 1 for the New Orleans Saints against the Detroit Lions according to Nick Underhill.
news.impact: Kamara will sit out the season opener while continuing to work through a knee injury for head coach Kellen Moore, with Travis Etienne Jr. to lead the New Orleans backfield attack and Kendre Miller to also receive touches against the Lions.

news.head: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play against Lions
news.body: Alvin Kamara (knee) is not expected to play against the Lions due to his knee injury. While his practice participation ramped up later in the week, he is still not quite ready.
news.impact: With Kamara out, the team will lean on Kendre Miller as the primary backup to Travis Etienne. Kamara will look to make his way back onto the field next week.

news.head: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to have big role if available in Week 1
news.body: Saints RB Alvin Kamara will not have a “huge role” if he plays in Week 1 against the Lions.
news.impact: Kamara was listed as questionable after he practiced fully on Friday. He'll be eased into the season if he is available.

news.head: Alvin Kamara (knee) officially questionable for Sunday
news.body: Alvin Kamara (knee) is officially questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
news.impact: Kamara will enter the weekend with a questionable tag. This doesn't come as much of a surprise, given that he has been limited at practice all week while dealing with this knee injury. Fantasy managers should expect more work for Kendre Miller if the veteran is ruled out ahead of game time on Sunday.

news.head: DeMario Douglas catches five passes Wednesday
news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 5-of-7 targets for 20 yards in Wednesday's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.impact: Douglas was the most targeted receiver for New England last night, but he wasn't able to turn that into any fantasy success. He ended with just 20 yards on five catches, but he may continue to see high opportunities for the foreseeable future with A.J. Brown (ankle) set to miss some time for the team.

news.head: DeMario Douglas catches two passes Sunday
news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 2-of-3 targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 38-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.impact: Douglas caught two passes on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do much with either of them and ended up with just 29 yards against the Dolphins. He should continue to play a big role for the Patriots moving forward as they look to make a deep push in the playoffs.

news.head: DeMario Douglas quiet in Week 17 win
news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 1-of-2 targets for 10 yards in the Patriots 42-10 win over the Jets.
news.impact: Douglas was active after being questionable due to a hamstring injury. Douglas has been tough to trust this season, and fantasy managers with matchups in Week 18 should look for other options.

news.head: DeMario Douglas (hamstring) officially active for Week 17
news.body: Patriots WR DeMario Douglas (hamstring) is officially active for Week 17.
news.impact: Douglas was considered questionable to play in Sunday's matchup with the Jets. With Mack Hollins on IR and Kayshon Boutte out, Douglas could see an increase in targets.

news.head: Jauan Jennings does not catch pass Sunday
news.body: Jauan Jennings did not catch his lone target in the Vikings 39-22 win over the Packers.
news.impact: Jennings remains off the fantasy radar for now.

news.head: Jauan Jennings agrees to one year deal with Vikings
news.body: Jauan Jennings has agreed to a one year deal with the Minnesota Vikings worth up to $13 million.
news.impact: Jennings will go to a now stacked wide receiver room with Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison. He didn’t receive nearly the market he hoped for in free agency after a down year, and he will look to rebuild his value and likely test the market next year.

news.head: Jauan Jennings concludes visit with Vikings without deal, talks are ongoing
news.body: Free agent WR Jauan Jennings reportedly left his visit with the Vikings without a deal, but talks are ongoing.
news.impact: Minnesota is reportedly interested in a one-year deal with Jennings. This will remain a situation to monitor in the coming weeks as he remains one of the top wide receivers available.

news.head: Jauan Jennings visiting Minnesota Vikings Tuesday and Wednesday
news.body: Jauan Jennings will visit the Minnesota Vikings both Tuesday night and Wednesday.
news.impact: Jennings has finally started to make some rounds after staying out of the first few waves of free agency and the draft. He will now get to see what teams will most want or need his services now that things have largely settled. Minnesota doesn’t have much depth behind Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison, so Jennings could be a nice option for the team. For fantasy, however, it’s not very appealing being the WR3 behind those two names.

news.head: Ryan Flournoy totals 22 yards Sunday
news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught 2-of-4 targets for 22 yards in Sunday's loss to the New York Giants.
news.impact: Flournoy wasn't able to contribute much on Sunday night, being held to just 22 yards in the team's upset loss at the hands of the Giants. He won't have enough opportunities to be a relevant fantasy option anytime soon.

news.head: Ryan Flournoy agrees to one-year, $6 million extension with Dallas
news.body: Ryan Flournoy has agreed to a one-year extension with the Dallas Cowboys worth $6 millloon.
news.impact: Flournoy flashed at times last year and is expected to take on a larger role in 2026. He’s coming off of a great second season in the league that saw him snag 40 passes for nearly 500 yards and four touchdowns, including two games with more than 110 yards.

news.head: Ryan Flournoy seeing more work in slot this offseason
news.body: Ryan Flournoy has reportedly "worked in the slot more” this offseason.
news.impact: Flournoy appears to be the favorite to be the WR3 for the Cowboys heading into training camp. He caught 40 passes for 475 yards and four touchdowns last season. He is still likely to be off the fantasy radar as part of a deep offense.

news.head: Ryan Flournoy hauls in five passes Sunday
news.body: Ryan Flournoy secured 5 of 7 targets for 68 yards in Sunday's loss to the Giants.
news.impact: With multiple other members of the Dallas offense playing very limited snaps Sunday, Flournoy took advantage of the chance to shine in the passing game.
