news.body: The Panthers D/ST allowed 27 points on 288 total yards with one interception, one fumble recovery and three sacks on Sunday against Seattle.
news.impact: Carolina forced an interception and fumble of Sam Darnold. They nearly had another turnover or two as well. They will be needed to step up in Week 18 against Baker Mayfield and the Bucs offense.

news.head: Carolina Panthers D/ST comes in clutch in win
news.body: The Carolina Panthers D/ST managed two sacks on Tampa Bay QB Baker Mayfield on Sunday, as well as a game-sealing interception in the 23-20 win.
news.impact: The Panthers forced the Bucs to move the ball slowly and methodically all game, with only a couple of splash plays being given up. Neither defense managed a turnover in this game until the final moments, when Mayfield threw a pick after expecting his receiver to break left, but he broke right. The errant pass went right into the waiting arms of Lathan Ransom. Fresh off a win, they will face a tough challenge next week against Seattle.

news.head: Cowboys D/ST struggles in loss Sunday
news.body: The Cowboys' D/ST logged two sacks and one fumble recovery while allowing 28 points in Sunday night's loss to the New York Giants.
news.impact: Dallas' defense didn't look great on Sunday night. They allowed New York to put up 28 points over the course of the game, which led to a loss on the road for the Cowboys. This unit is not likely to be worth starting in most fantasy leagues moving forward.

news.head: Cowboys defense records four sacks in Sunday's loss
news.body: The Cowboys defense allowed 34 points on 380 yards of total offense, coming up with four sacks and forcing one turnover in Sunday's loss to the Giants.
news.impact: It was a season of struggling for the Dallas defense, as the unit consistently ranked toward the bottom of the league in yards and points allowed per game. Sunday's effort was par for the course. The Cowboys front office will spend the offseason looking to drastically improve on that side of the ball.

news.head: Cowboys D/ST quiet in Week 17
news.body: The Cowboys D/ST recorded two sacks while also failing to force any turnovers in a 30-23 win over the Commanders in Week 17.
news.impact: The unit was unable to make a substantial impact Christmas Day, allowing an explosive 8.6 yards per carry in the win. The unit could offer fantasy managers a potential streaming option in Week 18 against the New York Giants.

news.head: Cowboys D/ST struggles against pass Sunday
news.body: The Cowboys D/ST allowed 34 points on 452 yards on Sunday against the Chargers.
news.impact: Justin Herbert was able to get whatever he wanted through the air all afternoon against Dallas. The Cowboys did not force any turnovers either. They will draw Josh Johnson and the Commanders next week.

news.head: Cairo Santos perfect in Week 1
news.body: Cairo Santos converted his only field goal attempt as well as all eight of his extra point attempts to finish with 11 points in the Bears' 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers in Week 1.
news.impact: Santos benefited from a high-octane Chicago offensive attack, finishing with double-digit points in the win. The veteran kicker should continue to see plenty of opportunities as the season moves forward for fantasy managers, with a Week 2 contest against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.head: Cairo Santos held off the scoresheet in Week 18
news.body: Cairo Santos did not attempt a field goal or an extra point in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Lions.
news.impact: It was the only time all season that Santos was kept scoreless as the Bears went for two on both of their touchdowns. Santos went 25-of-30 on field goal attempts and 39-of-39 on point after tries during the regular season.

news.head: Cairo Santos perfect in Week 17
news.body: Cairo Santos converted his only field goal attempt as well as all five of his extra point attempts to finish with eight points in a 42-38 loss to the 49ers in Week 17.
news.impact: Santos continues a productive stretch, recording seven or more points in six of his last seven games. The kicker remains a stable option in all formats ahead of a Week 18 contest against the Detroit Lions.

news.head: Cairo Santos racks up 10 points in Week 16
news.body: Cairo Santos converted his only extra point attempt as well as all three of his field goal attempts to finish with 10 points in the Bears' 22-16 win over the Packers in Week 16.
news.impact: Santos continues a productive stretch in the Chicago offense, finishing with seven or more points in five of his last six games. The kicker remains a mostly reliable option in kicker formats ahead of a Week 17 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.head: Trey Smack nails two deep field goals Sunday
news.body: Trey Smack went 3-for-3 on field goal attempts and 1-for-2 on extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: Smack nailed field goals from 59, 43 and 26 yards out. The Packers have found a kicker they can rely on.

news.head: Will Reichard connects on lone field goal Sunday
news.body: Will Reichard made his lone field goal attempt and all four extra points on Sunday.
news.impact: Reichard made his field goal from 38 yards out. He remains a fairly reliable option for fantasy managers.

news.head: Will Reichard boots three field goals in Week 18
news.body: Will Reichard was a perfect 3-for-3 on field goals and also added an extra point in Minnesota's 16-3 win over Green Bay on Sunday.
news.impact: Reichard made field goals from 43, 25, and 37 yards out and closed out the season with three consecutive games of three made field goals. The second-year kicker was nearly perfect in 2025, going 33-of-35 on field goal tries and 31-of-31 on extra point attempts. Reichard has not missed a PAT in his first two seasons in the league (69-of-69).

news.head: Will Reichard racks up 11 points in Week 17
news.body: Will Reichard converted both of his extra point attempts as well as all three of his field goal attempts to finish with 11 points in the Vikings' 23-10 win over the Lions in Week 17.
news.impact: Reichard continues a productive stretch of late, recording seven or more points in each of his last four games. The kicker will look for another productive performance to close out the season in Week 18 against the Green Bay Packers.

news.head: Will Reichard perfect in Week 16
news.body: Will Reichard converted his only extra point attempt as well as all three of his field goal attempts to finish with 10 points in the Vikings' 16-13 win over the Giants in Week 16.
news.impact: Reichard continues a productive stretch of late, picking up seven or more points in each of his last three games. The kicker will look for more success behind an underwhelming Minnesota offense against the Detroit Lions in Week 17.

news.head: Jake Elliott records five points in Week 1
news.body: Jake Elliott converted his lone field goal attempt as well as all three of his extra point attempts to finish with five points in the Eagles’ 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
news.impact: Elliott made the most of his limited opportunities, starting the season without a miss in the win. The kicker should once again see plenty of opportunities kicking behind a Philadelphia offense that hopes to be more explosive moving forward, with a Week 2 contest against the Tennessee Titans up next.

news.head: Jake Elliott restructures deal with Eagles
news.body: The Eagles and K Jake Elliott agreed to a reworked contract.
news.impact: Elliott will now receive $5 million instead of $6 million with all of it being guaranteed. He connected on just 20-of-27 field goal attempts last season.

news.head: Jake Elliott makes one FG in Week 18
news.body: Jake Elliott made his lone field-goal attempt and added two extra points in a 24-17 loss to the Commanders in Week 18.
news.impact: Elliott hit a 39-yard attempt in the contest. He finishes the regular season with 20 field goals on 27 tries. Elliott will now prepare to kick against the 49ers in next week's Wild-Card matchup.

news.head: Jake Elliott perfect in wet conditions against Bills
news.body: Jake Elliott converted all of his kicks during Sunday's 13-12 win over Buffalo, making field goals from 47 and 28 yards while adding an extra point. Despite heavy rain, the veteran kicker delivered his second multi-field goal performance in the last six games.
news.impact: Elliott improves to 19-for-26 on field-goal attempts this season, including a 4-for-8 mark from 50-plus yards, and has missed just one of his 40 extra-point tries. He will look to finish the regular season strong when the Eagles host the Commanders in Week 18.

news.head: Bears D/ST torched through air in Week 1
news.body: The Bears D/ST forced two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) while also registering two sacks in a 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers in Week 1.
news.impact: The unit struggled to stop the Carolina offense through the air, allowing over 350 passing yards and three passing touchdowns in the win. The unit will look to get back on track in a Week 2 divisional contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.head: Chicago Bears D/ST relatively quiet in Week 18
news.body: The Chicago Bears D/ST recorded three sacks and had an interception on Sunday, but did allow 433 yards of total offense in the 19-16 loss to the Lions.
news.impact: The Bears defense has allowed 384, 496, and 433 yards over the last three weeks, but they have registered at least one turnover in 10 consecutive games. Chicago gets Green Bay at home in the opening round of the playoffs.

news.head: Bears D/ST scores touchdown in Week 17
news.body: The Bears D/ST recorded two sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception) that was returned for a touchdown in a 42-38 loss to the 49ers in Week 17.
news.impact: The unit struggled to make an impact after the returning an interception for a touchdown on the first offensive play of the game, allowing three touchdowns on the ground as well as through the air Sunday night. The unit will look to get back on track to close out the season in a Week 18 contest against the Detroit Lions.

news.head: Bears D/ST records two sacks in Week 16
news.body: The Bears D/ST recorded two sacks while also forcing one turnover (one fumble recovery) in a 22-16 win over the Packers in Week 16.
news.impact: The unit came up with key stops on third and fourth down throughout the contest while allowing 384 offensive yards in the win. The defense will be tasked with slowing down superstar running back Christian McCaffrey and the San Francisco 49ers offense in Week 17.

news.head: Tyler Bass has big week in win over Houston
news.body: Tyler Bass hit all three of his PATs and all three of his field goal attempts on his way to 12 kicking points in the Bills’ 36-31 win over Houston.
news.impact: Bass had himself a great week against the Texans defense, spurred by the amount of offense Josh Allen and the rest of the crew were getting. He should be a good value moving forward as part of this high-powered offense.

news.head: Tyler Bass restructures deal with Bills
news.body: Tyler Bass restructured his contract with the Bills.
news.impact: Bass was sidelined for all of last season with a hip/groin injury. He will earn $1 million in guaranteed money next season with a chance to earn up to $3.5 million in incentives.

news.head: Tyler Bass (groin) making progress, unsure if he will return next week
news.body: Bills coach Sean McDermott said it remains unclear if Tyler Bass will be ready to return from IR when first eligible next week.
news.impact: McDermott added that Bass continues to make progress in his return from injury. He is eligible to be activated from injured reserve next week, but he could miss another game or two.

news.head: Tyler Bass (groin) placed on injured reserve
news.body: Tyler Bass (groin) has been placed on injured reserve and will be out for the next four games at least.
news.impact: Bass is going to be out for at least the next four weeks as he nurses a groin injury. The team has placed him on injured reserve, which leaves Matt Prater as the starting kicker for the Bills for the foreseeable future.

news.head: Sam Darnold (glute) estimated to return in four weeks
news.body: Sam Darnold (glute) is estimated to miss four weeks with a glute injury he sustained against the Patriots.
news.impact: With Darnold missing time, Drew Lock is the next man up. He was adequate against the Patriots, getting off to a rough start but finishing decently enough. He’s a low end start in Superflex formats for those in need of a play.

news.head: Sam Darnold dealing with 'unique' soft-tissue injury
news.body: The Seahawks say Sam Darnold has a "very unique" soft-tissue injury.
news.impact: Darnold's hip joint is unaffected. It is considered a short-term injury, meaning likely less than four weeks with him avoiding injured reserve.

news.head: Sam Darnold suffered glute injury Wednesday
news.body: Sam Darnold suffered a glute injury in Wednesday’s win over the New England Patriots according to Ian Rapoport.
news.impact: Darnold was originally believed to have suffered a hip injury in the season-opening contest, but after further evaluation, the quarterback’s hip checked out fine. Drew Lock remains in line to start behind center for head coach Mike McDonald while Darnold tends to his injury.

news.head: Sam Darnold (hip) expected to miss Week 2
news.body: Ian Rapoport reports that Sam Darnold is expected to miss Week 2 against the Cardinals.
news.impact: Darnold is continuing to be further evaluated. He'll miss at least one game with a return by Week 3 seemingly being a possibility.

news.head: Odell Beckham Jr. silent in win Sunday
news.body: Odell Beckham Jr. was held without a target or touch in Sunday night's 28-20 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: There has been some growing hype that Beckham Jr. would be an involved member of this offense after earning a roster spot this preseason, but that wasn't the case on Sunday night at all, as he was held without a target or catch on just 11 snaps played. Fantasy managers should consider him off of the fantasy radar for the time being.

news.head: Odell Beckham Jr. officially makes Giants 53-man roster
news.body: Odell Beckham Jr. has officially made the Giants' 53-man roster.
news.impact: Beckham posted a strong training camp in his return to the Giants organization. He'll enter the season in a depth role in their wide receiver room.

news.head: Odell Beckham Jr. to play in preseason opener
news.body: Odell Beckham Jr. will play in the preseason opener on Saturday against the Vikings.
news.impact: Beckham continues to compete for a depth role in the Giants wide receiver room during training camp.

news.head: Odell Beckham Jr. agrees to a deal with Giants
news.body: Odell Beckham Jr. is signing a deal with the New York Giants. A reunion after several stops by the veteran wide receiver.
news.impact: Beckham’s best years were in a Giants uniform, though he did have some success in Cleveland and LA, including a Super Bowl ring. His role is likely to provide a veteran presence for the team and give advice to another LSU receiver and current Giants star; Malik Nabers. His best fantasy days are behind him, so don’t expect much on that front.
